The labels cover 32 hierarchically organized classes (16 impermeable, 16 permeable surfaces) across more than 380,000 sparsely labeled pixels over a 90 km2 area.

datasets.name: TreeSatAI
datasets.summary: A benchmark dataset pairing aerial and Sentinel-1/2 imagery with forest inventory labels for tree species classification across Germany.
datasets.description: TreeSatAI provides over 50,000 multi-sensor image patches combining 0.2 m aerial RGB+NIR imagery with co-registered Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 time series over forest stands in Lower Saxony, Germany. Each patch is labeled with tree species derived from official forest inventory data, supporting single-label and multi-label classification. It is designed as a benchmark for multi-modal, multi-temporal forest monitoring and species mapping.

datasets.name: TS-SatFire
datasets.summary: A multi-task satellite image time-series dataset for active fire detection, daily burned-area mapping, and next-day wildfire prediction across the contiguous US.
datasets.description: TS-SatFire is a multi-temporal remote-sensing dataset covering wildfire events in the contiguous United States from January 2017 to October 2021. It includes 3,552 surface-reflectance images plus auxiliary weather, topography, land-cover, and fuel data (about 71 GB total), with manually quality-assured active-fire and burned-area labels. The dataset supports three tasks: active fire detection, daily burned-area mapping, and wildfire progression prediction.

datasets.name: TUE-CD
datasets.summary: A bi-temporal WorldView-2 change-detection dataset for building damage estimation after the 2023 Turkey-Syria earthquake.
datasets.description: TUE-CD is a change-detection dataset built for building damage assessment following the February 6, 2023 Turkey-Syria earthquake. It comprises 1,656 bi-temporal WorldView-2 image patches of 256x256 pixels at 1.8 m resolution, with 2,338 labeled destroyed buildings. Coverage focuses on the most severely damaged regions of Turkey including Adiyaman, Kahramanmaras, Hatay, and Gaziantep.

datasets.name: UA-CMDet (DroneVehicle)
datasets.summary: A large cross-modal RGB-infrared aerial dataset for uncertainty-aware vehicle detection from drones across day and night conditions.
datasets.description: The UA-CMDet release provides the DroneVehicle dataset, a large-scale cross-modal benchmark of 28,439 paired RGB and infrared aerial images for vehicle detection. Scenes span urban roads, residential areas, and parking lots under conditions ranging from daytime to night, where infrared complements RGB in low-light. It supports oriented-bounding-box vehicle detection and uncertainty-aware cross-modal learning.

datasets.name: UAV-HSI-Crop-Dataset
datasets.summary: A UAV-borne hyperspectral imagery dataset for semantic segmentation and crop classification.
datasets.description: The UAV-HSI-Crop-Dataset contains UAV-acquired hyperspectral imagery annotated for crop mapping via semantic segmentation. It was released to accompany the HSI-TransUNet study, a transformer-based segmentation model for crop mapping from UAV hyperspectral imagery. The dataset targets fine-grained crop classification and hyperspectral analysis tasks.

datasets.name: UAVOD10
datasets.summary: A 10-category UAV imagery dataset of small and weak objects for aerial object detection at 15 cm resolution.
datasets.description: UAVOD10 is a UAV object-detection dataset annotated with horizontal bounding boxes across 10 object classes: building, ship, vehicle, prefabricated house, well, cable tower, pool, landslide, cultivation mesh cage, and quarry. Imagery is captured at approximately 15 cm spatial resolution. The dataset emphasizes small and weak objects, making it a challenging benchmark for fine-grained aerial detection.

datasets.name: UAVVaste
datasets.summary: A COCO-like aerial drone imagery dataset for detecting litter and waste in natural and urban environments.
datasets.description: UAVVaste is a dataset of aerial drone images annotated in COCO-like format for waste and litter detection. It was created to enable effective detection of rubbish in aerial imagery, complementing existing taco-style ground-level waste datasets. The dataset supports object detection and instance segmentation of waste objects from a UAV perspective.

datasets.name: UBC-dataset
datasets.summary: An urban building classification dataset for object-level detection, segmentation, and roof/use classification from very high-resolution satellite imagery.
datasets.description: The UBC (Urban Building Classification) dataset supports building detection and classification from very high-resolution satellite imagery with a focus on object-level interpretation of individual buildings. Annotations are provided in COCO instance-segmentation format and include roof coarse/fine classification and building use coarse classification. It was introduced at the CVPR EarthVision workshop and has an extended UBCv2 version.

datasets.name: UC Merced Multi-label
datasets.summary: A multi-label re-annotation of the UC Merced Land Use dataset for multi-label aerial scene classification.
datasets.description: The UC Merced Multi-label dataset is a redesigned, multi-label version of the classic UC Merced Land Use benchmark. It consists of 2,100 RGB aerial images of 256x256 pixels at 0.3 m spatial resolution, split into 1,890 training and 210 test images, with each image annotated using 17 land-cover labels. It enables multi-label land-cover scene categorization rather than single-label classification.

datasets.name: Uganda-Tanzania Building Footprints
datasets.summary: A Microsoft-released dataset of nearly 18 million machine-extracted building footprint polygons across Uganda and Tanzania.
datasets.description: This Microsoft AI for Humanitarian Action dataset contains 17,942,345 building footprint polygons across Uganda (6,928,078 buildings) and Tanzania (11,014,267 buildings), delivered in GeoJSON format. Footprints were extracted from Maxar satellite imagery at 30 cm/pixel resolution using a two-stage deep-learning pipeline of semantic segmentation followed by polygonization. The data supports instance segmentation, mapping, and humanitarian planning.

datasets.name: UKFields
datasets.summary: A nationwide dataset of automatically delineated agricultural field boundaries across the United Kingdom derived from Sentinel-2 imagery.
datasets.description: UKFields provides automatically delineated field-boundary polygons across England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland, derived from 2021 Sentinel-2 harmonic composites processed with Meta's Segment Anything Model and masked to cropland. The data is distributed as fiboa GeoParquet and is also available as a Google Earth Engine asset and an interactive web viewer. It supports field-boundary delineation and instance segmentation tasks.

datasets.name: Understanding Clouds from Satellite Images
datasets.summary: A Kaggle competition dataset for segmenting cloud organization patterns in satellite imagery.
datasets.description: The Understanding Clouds from Satellite Images dataset, released for a Kaggle/Max Planck Institute competition, contains satellite images labeled with four cloud organization pattern classes: Fish, Flower, Gravel, and Sugar. The task is to segment regions of each shallow-cloud pattern to help researchers better understand how clouds organize and influence climate. Labels are provided as run-length-encoded segmentation masks.

datasets.name: University-1652
datasets.summary: A multi-view, multi-source benchmark for drone-based geo-localization spanning 1,652 university buildings worldwide.
datasets.description: University-1652 is a benchmark dataset for drone-based geo-localization that contains imagery of 1,652 university buildings collected from three platforms: synthetic drone views, satellite views, and ground-level views. It supports two complementary tasks: drone-view target localization (matching a drone image to a satellite gallery) and drone navigation (matching a satellite image to a drone gallery). The dataset enables training and evaluation of cross-view image retrieval models. It was the first dataset to introduce drone-view imagery for geo-localization research.

datasets.name: Urban Innovation Eclipse Sensor Data
datasets.summary: Low-cost urban air-quality sensor network data (including PM2.5) from Microsoft Research's Project Eclipse, covering over 100 locations in Chicago.
datasets.description: The Project Eclipse Network is a low-cost air-quality sensing network for cities, developed as a research project by the Urban Innovation Group at Microsoft Research. The network currently includes over 100 sensor locations across Chicago, Illinois, deployed starting in July 2021 in collaboration with the City of Chicago, the Array of Things project, and JCDecaux. Each sensor measures pollutants such as PM2.5 along with environmental variables, providing fine-grained urban air-quality observations. The data is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: urban-tree-detection-data
datasets.summary: An aerial imagery dataset for training and evaluating tree detectors in urban environments.
datasets.description: This dataset is designed for training and evaluating models that detect individual trees in urban environments using aerial imagery. It provides annotated aerial image patches where trees are marked, supporting object-detection and point-localization approaches to urban tree mapping. The dataset accompanies research on urban tree detection and is useful for urban forestry, ecosystem monitoring, and city planning applications.

datasets.name: USAVars
datasets.summary: A dataset of ~100k 1 sq km NAIP aerial image crops over the contiguous USA with continuous labels for tree cover, elevation, and population.
datasets.description: USAVars is a reproduction of the dataset used in the paper "A generalizable and accessible approach to machine learning with global satellite imagery". It consists of 1 sq km crops of NAIP aerial imagery resampled to 4 m/px, centered on roughly 100,000 points sampled randomly across the contiguous United States. Each point is associated with three continuous-valued labels: tree-cover percentage, elevation, and population density. The dataset is provided as a TorchGeo dataset class for regression-style learning from satellite and aerial imagery.

datasets.name: US Building Footprints
datasets.summary: Microsoft-generated building footprint polygons covering all 50 US states in GeoJSON format, derived via semantic segmentation of satellite imagery.
datasets.description: This dataset provides computer-generated building footprints for all 50 US states, released by Microsoft in GeoJSON format. The footprints were produced using a deep-learning semantic-segmentation pipeline applied to satellite imagery. Companion datasets covering Australia, Canada, Uganda-Tanzania, Kenya-Nigeria, and the global GlobalMLBuildingFootprints release are also available. The data supports building extraction, mapping, and urban analysis tasks.

datasets.name: USDA Cropland Data Layers (CDLs)
datasets.summary: Annual crop-specific land-cover classification rasters for the United States produced by USDA NASS from satellite imagery.
datasets.description: The Cropland Data Layer (CDL) is a product of the USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS). It is a crop-specific land-cover classification covering more than 100 crop categories grown in the United States. CDLs are derived using supervised classification of satellite imagery, relying first on manually identified training pixels. The collection is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer and spans annual layers from 2008 onward.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Classification
datasets.summary: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs of ASPRS point classifications derived from the USGS 3DEP lidar program.
datasets.description: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC lidar collection and represents the ASPRS (American Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing) lidar point classification, encoded as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs. The classification follows the LAS specification and is based on the Classification PDAL dimension. It enables analysis of ground, vegetation, building, and other point classes across the United States. The data is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Digital Surface Model
datasets.summary: Digital Surface Model (DSM) Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs derived from USGS 3DEP lidar point clouds.
datasets.description: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC lidar collection and produces a Digital Surface Model (DSM) using a PDAL range filter, outputting a collection of Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs. Points classified as noise are removed so the surface model captures the top of features such as vegetation canopy and buildings. The data is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer and supports elevation and terrain analysis across the United States.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Digital Terrain Model
datasets.summary: Digital Terrain Model (DTM) Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs derived from USGS 3DEP lidar using the Simple Morphological Filter.
datasets.description: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC lidar collection and produces a Digital Terrain Model (DTM) using the PDAL Simple Morphological Filter (SMRF), outputting a collection of Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs. The SMRF classifies bare-earth ground points following the approach of Pingel et al. (2013), yielding a terrain surface with above-ground features removed. The data is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Digital Terrain Model (Native)
datasets.summary: Digital Terrain Model GeoTIFFs derived from USGS 3DEP lidar using the vendor-provided (native) ground classification.
datasets.description: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC lidar collection and produces a Digital Terrain Model (DTM) using the vendor-provided (native) ground classification together with a PDAL range filter, outputting a collection of Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs. Points classified as noise are removed, leaving a bare-earth terrain surface based on the original data provider's ground classification rather than a recomputed filter. The data is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Height above Ground
datasets.summary: Height-Above-Ground Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs derived from USGS 3DEP lidar point clouds.
datasets.description: This collection is generated from the Z dimension of the USGS 3DEP COPC lidar data, removing noise and water before applying the PDAL SMRF and Height Above Ground Nearest Neighbor (hag_nn) filters. The hag_nn filter takes a point cloud with ground points classified as class 2 and creates a new HeightAboveGround dimension, which is rendered as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs. This product captures the height of features such as vegetation and structures above the underlying terrain. The data is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Intensity
datasets.summary: Lidar pulse-return intensity Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs derived from the USGS 3DEP program.
datasets.description: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC lidar collection and is a set of Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the lidar pulse-return magnitude. The values are based on the Intensity PDAL dimension, with PDAL outlier and range filters applied to remove outliers and noise. Intensity rasters can be used for surface-material discrimination and feature interpretation. The data is hosted as a STAC collection on the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Point Cloud
datasets.summary: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) lidar point clouds reformatted into the cloud-optimized COPC (Cloud-Optimized Point Cloud) format.
datasets.description: This collection contains source data from the USGS 3DEP program reformatted into the COPC format. A COPC file is a LAZ 1.4 file that stores point data organized in a clustered octree, providing a one-to-one mapping of LAZ to UTM-reprojected COPC files. The data are geospatial lidar point clouds covering the United States and are hosted via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Point Source
datasets.summary: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the lidar point-source ID derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection.
datasets.description: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection and consists of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the file source ID from which each point originated, where zero indicates the point originated in the current file. The values are based on the PointSourceId PDAL dimension and use pdal.filters.outlier and pdal.filters.range to remove outliers. The data are hosted via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Returns
datasets.summary: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the number of lidar returns per pulse, derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection.
datasets.description: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection and consists of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the number of returns for a given lidar pulse. The values are processed using pdal.filters.outlier and pdal.filters.range to remove outliers before rasterization. The data are hosted via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP Seamless DEMs
datasets.summary: U.S.-wide seamless digital elevation models from the USGS 3D Elevation Program at horizontal resolutions from one to sixty meters.
datasets.description: The USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Seamless DEMs are the primary elevation data product produced and distributed by the USGS via The National Map. The program provides raster elevation data for the conterminous United States, Alaska, Hawaii, and the island territories at a variety of resolutions ranging from one to sixty meters. The data are hosted via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: USGS Gap Land Cover
datasets.summary: Detailed national land cover and vegetation map of the United States from the USGS GAP/LANDFIRE National Terrestrial Ecosystems data.
datasets.description: The USGS GAP/LANDFIRE National Terrestrial Ecosystems data, based on the NatureServe Terrestrial Ecological Systems, form the foundation of the most detailed, consistent map of vegetation available for the United States. These data facilitate planning and management for biological diversity on a regional and national scale. The land cover dataset is hosted via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: USGS LCMAP CONUS Collection 1.3
datasets.summary: Land cover mapping and change monitoring products for the conterminous United States from the USGS LCMAP initiative.
datasets.description: The Land Change Monitoring, Assessment, and Projection (LCMAP) product provides land cover mapping and change monitoring from the USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center. LCMAP Science Products are developed by applying time-series modeling on a per-pixel basis to Landsat Analysis Ready Data (ARD). This collection covers the conterminous United States. The data are hosted via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: USGS LCMAP Hawaii Collection 1.0
datasets.summary: Land cover mapping and change monitoring products for Hawaii from the USGS LCMAP initiative.
datasets.description: The Land Change Monitoring, Assessment, and Projection (LCMAP) product provides land cover mapping and change monitoring from the USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center. LCMAP Science Products are developed by applying time-series modeling on a per-pixel basis to Landsat Analysis Ready Data (ARD). This collection covers the state of Hawaii. The data are hosted via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: UV6K
datasets.summary: An urban vehicle segmentation benchmark of high-resolution aerial imagery with hundreds of thousands of annotated vehicle instances.
datasets.description: UV6K is an urban vehicle segmentation dataset containing 6,313 aerial images with 245,141 vehicle instances at 0.1 m resolution in 1024x1024 pixel tiles. It was released alongside the FarSeg++ foreground-aware relation network for geospatial object segmentation in high-resolution remote sensing imagery. The dataset is split into training, validation, and test partitions and is intended for academic research use.

datasets.name: Vaihingen
datasets.summary: ISPRS 2D semantic labeling benchmark of high-resolution true orthophotos and DSMs over Vaihingen, Germany.
datasets.description: The ISPRS Vaihingen dataset is a widely used benchmark for 2D semantic labeling, consisting of 33 high-resolution true orthophoto tiles (near-infrared, red, green) with corresponding digital surface models over the town of Vaihingen, Germany. Pixel-wise reference labels cover urban land cover classes such as impervious surfaces, buildings, low vegetation, trees, and cars. It is commonly used for semantic segmentation, land cover mapping, building detection, and change detection research.
datasets.task: segmentation; classification; land-cover-mapping; detection; change-detection; super-resolution

datasets.name: VDS2RAW
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 dataset for ship detection, edited and redistributed in raw form as VDS2RAW.
datasets.description: VDS2RAW is a Sentinel-2 optical imagery dataset for ship detection, derived and redistributed from the Vessel Detection Sentinel-2 (VDS2) data. It provides raw multispectral imagery suitable for training and evaluating maritime vessel detection models. The dataset is hosted on Zenodo.

datasets.name: VEDAI
datasets.summary: Vehicle Detection in Aerial Imagery (VEDAI), a small-target detection benchmark of aerial RGB and infrared imagery.
datasets.description: VEDAI (Vehicle Detection in Aerial Imagery) is a benchmark for detecting small targets such as vehicles in aerial imagery. It provides co-registered RGB and near-infrared aerial images with annotations for multiple vehicle categories at various orientations, backgrounds, and lighting conditions. The dataset was introduced in 2015 and is widely used to evaluate small-object detection methods in remote sensing.

datasets.name: Vehicle detection from satellite images
datasets.summary: A Kaggle dataset of optical satellite imagery for training vehicle detection models.
datasets.description: This dataset provides optical satellite imagery annotated for vehicle detection, published on Kaggle. It is intended for training and evaluating machine learning models that detect vehicles in overhead satellite scenes.

datasets.name: Vehicle Perception from Satellite
datasets.summary: A large-scale benchmark for traffic monitoring from satellite video, supporting tiny vehicle detection, counting, and density estimation.
datasets.description: Vehicle Perception from Satellite is a large-scale benchmark for traffic monitoring from satellite imagery. It is constructed from 12 real satellite videos and 14 synthetic videos rendered in GTA-V, split into 408 video clips comprising 7,336 real and 1,960 synthetic images with 128,801 annotated vehicles. The benchmark targets the unique challenges of satellite-based vehicle perception, supporting tiny object detection, vehicle counting, and density estimation.

datasets.name: VENuS cloud mask training dataset
datasets.summary: Pixel-wise cloud mask training data for VENμS satellite imagery over Israel.
datasets.description: This dataset provides pixel-wise labelled VENμS satellite scenes over the land of Israel, with a special focus on the southern arid area. Each pixel is classified into one of three categories: cloud-free, thick cloud, or thin cloud. It is designed to train machine learning models for cloud detection in VENμS imagery and is hosted on Zenodo.

datasets.name: VENUS L2A Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs
datasets.summary: AWS-hosted VENμS Level-2A surface reflectance imagery in Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF format.
datasets.description: This collection provides VENμS (Vegetation and Environment monitoring on a New Micro-Satellite) Level-2A surface reflectance products as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs, hosted on the AWS Registry of Open Data. The high-revisit, high-resolution multispectral imagery supports vegetation and environmental monitoring applications.

datasets.name: VHR-10 COCO
datasets.summary: A COCO-format version of the NWPU VHR-10 very-high-resolution remote sensing dataset for object detection and instance segmentation.
datasets.description: VHR-10 COCO repackages the well-known NWPU VHR-10 very-high-resolution geospatial dataset into the MS-COCO annotation format so it can be used directly with standard detection and instance-segmentation frameworks. It covers 10 object categories such as airplanes, ships, storage tanks, baseball diamonds, tennis courts, basketball courts, ground track fields, harbors, bridges, and vehicles. Annotations include both bounding boxes and instance masks, making it suitable for training and evaluating modern detectors and segmentation models on overhead imagery.

datasets.name: VHRV
datasets.summary: A very-high-resolution benchmark dataset of satellite imagery annotated for vessel (ship) detection.
datasets.description: VHRV (Very High-Resolution Vessels) is a benchmark dataset for ship detection in very-high-resolution remote sensing imagery. It contains 1,502 images (4800x2886 pixels) with 10,158 annotated vessel instances at spatial resolutions of 0.1 to 0.25 meters, with annotations provided in YOLO format using horizontal bounding boxes. The repository also includes trained model weights and benchmark results for multiple detectors, and the data is released for academic use only.

datasets.name: VME Dataset
datasets.summary: A large-scale satellite imagery dataset of vehicles across the Middle East for vehicle detection.
datasets.description: VME (Vehicles in the Middle East) is a satellite imagery dataset for vehicle detection comprising over 4,000 image tiles and more than 100,000 vehicles drawn from 54 cities across 12 Middle Eastern countries. It provides oriented bounding box annotations in YOLO format and horizontal bounding box annotations in MS-COCO JSON format. The repository also includes scripts to build the Car Detection in Satellite Imagery (CDSI) benchmark, which combines VME with datasets such as xView, DOTA-v2.0, VEDAI, DIOR, and FAIR1M-2.0.
datasets.license: Images CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; annotations and scripts CC BY 4.0

datasets.name: VRSBench
datasets.summary: A versatile vision-language benchmark for remote sensing image understanding across detailed captioning, visual question answering, and visual grounding.
datasets.description: VRSBench is a vision-language benchmark for remote sensing imagery designed to support multiple multimodal tasks within a single dataset. It is built upon the DOTA-v2 and DIOR datasets and provides detailed image captions, visual question answering pairs, and visual grounding annotations. The benchmark enables training and evaluation of vision-language models on overhead imagery across varied ground sample distances.
datasets.task: Mixed Multi-task (image captioning, visual question answering, visual grounding)

datasets.name: WesternUSALiveFuelMoisture
datasets.summary: A tabular dataset of live fuel moisture measurements paired with remotely sensed variables across the western United States.
datasets.description: WesternUSALiveFuelMoisture contains live fuel moisture (the mass of water in vegetation) together with remotely sensed variables for the western United States, intended for regression-based prediction of fuel moisture. It comprises 2,615 datapoints, each stored as a GeoJSON file, with 138 remote sensing derived variables (some with a time dependency) drawn from sources including Landsat 8 and Sentinel-1. The dataset is available as a TorchGeo dataset class (WesternUSALiveFuelMoisture) for convenient use in machine learning pipelines.

datasets.name: Whole Atmosphere collection Met Office Global 10km deterministic weather forecast
datasets.summary: A global numerical weather prediction forecast collection offering 14 whole-atmosphere parameters at approximately 10km resolution from the Met Office.
datasets.description: This collection offers 14 whole-atmosphere parameters from the Met Office global deterministic 10km forecast, a numerical weather prediction forecast covering the entire globe at approximately 0.09 degree (10km) resolution on a 2,560 x 1,920 grid. The data is provided as NetCDF files with hourly timesteps from 0 to 54 hours for most parameters. It is offered on a free, unsupported basis and is distributed via the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: Whole Atmosphere collection Met Office UKV 2km deterministic forecast
datasets.summary: A high-resolution UK weather forecast collection offering 11 whole-atmosphere parameters at 2km resolution from the Met Office.
datasets.description: This collection offers 11 whole-atmosphere parameters from the Met Office UKV 2km deterministic forecast, a high-resolution gridded numerical weather prediction for the UK at 0.018 degree resolution projected onto a 2km horizontal grid. The forecast covers the UK and Ireland and the data is provided as NetCDF files. It is distributed via the Microsoft Planetary Computer.

datasets.name: WHU-RS19
datasets.summary: A high-resolution satellite image dataset of 19 scene classes exported from Google Earth for remote sensing scene classification.
datasets.description: WHU-RS19 is a set of high-resolution satellite images exported from Google Earth and organized into 19 meaningful scene classes such as airport, beach, bridge, commercial area, desert, farmland, forest, port, railway station, residential area, and river. Each class contains at least 50 samples of 600x600 pixels, with spatial resolution up to 0.5 m, for a total of around 1,005 images. It is a widely used benchmark for evaluating aerial and satellite scene classification methods.
datasets.modality: Satellite imagery (Google Earth), RGB, up to 0.5 m resolution, 600x600 px
datasets.size: ~1,005 images, 19 scene classes, ~50 images per class

datasets.name: WHUS2-CD+
datasets.summary: A cloud detection validation dataset of manually labeled cloud masks and corresponding Sentinel-2 images over mainland China.
datasets.description: WHUS2-CD+ is a cloud detection validation dataset consisting of 36 manually labeled cloud masks at 10 m resolution with their corresponding Sentinel-2A images, evenly distributed over mainland China. The data is split into a training set of 24 images and a testing set of 12 images, with several particularly challenging scenes highlighted. It was used to train the CD-FM3SF cloud detection model and serves as a benchmark for validating cloud detection and cloud removal algorithms.

datasets.name: WHU-SEN-City
datasets.summary: A paired SAR-to-optical image translation dataset covering 34 major cities of China.
datasets.description: WHU-SEN-City is a paired SAR-to-optical image translation dataset that covers 34 big cities of China, providing co-registered synthetic aperture radar and optical satellite image pairs. The repository includes Python processing code to split the images into smaller paired patches for analysis and training. It is intended for research on SAR-to-optical image translation and related SAR analysis tasks, with the data distributed via Google Drive and Baidu Netdisk.

datasets.name: WHU-Stereo
datasets.summary: A large-scale dataset for stereo matching and disparity estimation of high-resolution satellite imagery.
datasets.description: WHU-Stereo is a large-scale dataset for stereo matching of high-resolution satellite imagery, supporting disparity estimation and terrain mapping tasks. The accompanying repository provides several deep learning methods for stereo matching, including StereoNet, Pyramid Stereo Matching Network (PSMNet), and HMSM-Net. It enables research on satellite stereo matching, digital elevation model generation, and related 3D reconstruction tasks.
datasets.task: Stereo matching, disparity estimation, terrain mapping

datasets.name: WiDS Datathon 2019 (Palm Oil Plantations)
datasets.summary: A Kaggle dataset of Planet satellite image chips labeled for the presence of oil palm plantations, created for the 2019 Women in Data Science Datathon.
datasets.description: Provided by Planet and Figure Eight for the 2nd annual Women in Data Science (WiDS) Datathon, this dataset contains roughly 20,000 256x256-pixel satellite image chips at 3-meter resolution. Each image is labeled with whether an oil palm plantation is present (binary), along with annotator confidence scores. The task is to predict the probability that a given satellite image contains an oil palm plantation, in support of deforestation monitoring.

datasets.name: Wildfire-Spread-Dataset (ABNextFire)
datasets.summary: A multi-source deep learning dataset for wildfire spread prediction over Alberta, Canada, combining Landsat imagery with topographic and daily environmental variables.
datasets.description: ABNextFire is a multi-source dataset for wildfire spread prediction covering Alberta, Canada, over the period 2001-2019. It integrates Landsat 7/8 remote sensing imagery at 30-meter resolution (NDBI, NDVI, NDWI), a digital elevation model and slope, and 13 daily environmental variables such as surface pressure, precipitation, wind, and soil temperature. The dataset is paired with ResNet and DeepLabV3 baseline models for predicting next-day fire spread.

datasets.name: WorldStrat
datasets.summary: A globally stratified dataset pairing high-resolution 1.5 m Airbus imagery with temporally matched 10 m Sentinel-2 revisits for multi-frame super-resolution.
datasets.description: WorldStrat covers nearly 10,000 km2 of stratified, globally distributed locations, emphasizing underrepresented areas such as humanitarian sites, illegal mining locations, and vulnerable settlements. Each high-resolution scene at 1.5 m/pixel from Airbus is paired with 16 temporally matched low-resolution Sentinel-2 revisits at 10 m/pixel. It was published at NeurIPS 2022 and is designed for training and benchmarking satellite image super-resolution models using freely available Sentinel-2 data.

datasets.name: WorldView-2 European Cities
datasets.summary: An ESA very-high-resolution optical imagery dataset covering 66 of the most densely populated urban areas in Europe at 40 cm resolution.
datasets.description: Distributed through the ESA Earth Online catalog, this dataset comprises WorldView-2 satellite imagery over 66 urban zones spanning the most densely populated areas of Europe. Imagery is provided at 40 cm very-high resolution with visible and near-infrared bands, acquired between July 2010 and July 2015 at processing level 2a. Data is available to residents of ESA Member and Associate States plus Canada through registration.

datasets.name: WSF (World Settlement Footprint)
datasets.summary: A suite of free, global geo-datasets from DLR mapping the extent of human settlements and built-up areas at high resolution from Sentinel and Landsat imagery.
datasets.description: The World Settlement Footprint (WSF) is a collection of global settlement masks produced by DLR's Earth Observation Center. WSF 2015 is a 10 m binary settlement mask derived from Landsat-8 and Sentinel-1, WSF 2019 uses Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 at 10 m, WSF Evolution provides a 30 m multi-temporal settlement extent from Landsat, and WSF 3D adds settlement height/volume at 90 m. The datasets are widely used as benchmarks for built-up area and human settlement segmentation.

datasets.name: xBD
datasets.summary: A large-scale, bi-temporal satellite imagery dataset for building damage assessment across 19 natural disasters, used in the xView2 challenge.
datasets.description: xBD is a high-resolution, bi-temporal (pre- and post-disaster) dataset for assessing building damage from satellite imagery. It contains 22,068 RGB images covering 45,361.79 km2 from Maxar/DigitalGlobe across 19 natural disasters including floods, wildfires, earthquakes, and hurricanes, annotated with 850,736 building polygons. Damage is labeled per building on a harmonized four-level scale, and the dataset underpinned the xView2 building damage assessment challenge.

datasets.name: xView1
datasets.summary: One of the largest public datasets of high-resolution overhead imagery, with over 1 million annotated objects across 60 fine-grained classes for object detection.
datasets.description: xView (xView1) is a large-scale overhead satellite imagery dataset developed by the Defense Innovation Unit (DIUx) and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency. It contains more than 1 million annotated object instances across 60 fine-grained classes at 0.3 m resolution, with bounding-box annotations oriented toward disaster-response themes. It was released for the 2018 xView Detection Challenge and emphasizes small, rare, and fine-grained objects.

datasets.name: xView2
datasets.summary: The building damage assessment challenge and dataset (xBD) using pre- and post-disaster high-resolution Maxar imagery to classify damage severity.
datasets.description: xView2 is the building damage assessment challenge built on the xBD dataset, hosted at xview2.org. It uses bi-temporal high-resolution Maxar satellite imagery at 0.3 m resolution to localize buildings and classify per-building damage severity across multiple disaster types. The task combines building segmentation with multi-class damage classification to support rapid disaster response.

datasets.name: xView3-SAR
datasets.summary: A large-scale synthetic aperture radar dataset for detecting and classifying maritime vessels engaged in illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing.
datasets.description: xView3-SAR provides Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar imagery covering roughly 43.2 million square kilometers of ocean for the task of dark-vessel detection. Labels combine Global Fishing Watch detection models, AIS analytics, and expert human annotations, and the SAR scenes are paired with contextual ancillary data. Released as part of the xView3 prize challenge, it is described as one of the largest publicly available datasets for maritime object detection.

datasets.name: YieldSAT
datasets.summary: A multimodal benchmark dataset for high-resolution, subfield-level crop yield prediction from Sentinel-2 imagery and environmental data.
datasets.description: YieldSAT pairs Sentinel-2 satellite time series with weather, soil, and topography data to predict crop yield at the field and pixel (10m) level. It comprises 2,173 expert-curated fields spanning 138,288 hectares with 12.2 million yield samples and 113,555 labeled satellite images across four countries (Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, Germany) and four crop types (corn, rapeseed, soybean, wheat) over 2016-2024. The benchmark evaluates deep learning architectures under cross-validation, leave-one-region-out, and leave-one-year-out protocols to test robustness to distribution shift.

datasets.name: Yosemite Tree Dataset
datasets.summary: A benchmark dataset for tree counting from high-resolution aerial imagery of a forested region in Yosemite.
datasets.description: The Yosemite Tree Dataset provides high-resolution aerial imagery (sourced from Google Maps) of a 2,262.5m x 4,525.1m study area (19,200 x 38,400 pixels) with 98,949 individually labeled trees. It is split into training regions (B and D) and test regions (A and C), with a recommended evaluation block size of 960 x 960 pixels. The benchmark evaluates tree-counting models using Mean Absolute Error and Root Mean Square Error.

datasets.name: FloodPlanet
datasets.summary: A manually labeled, multi-sensor high-resolution flood inundation dataset for training and validating deep learning flood-mapping models.
datasets.description: FloodPlanet is a high-quality, manually annotated flood inundation dataset labeled using 3m PlanetScope imagery and aligned with public Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 sensors. It covers 19 globally sampled flood events (2017-2020) as 366 manually labeled 1024x1024 PlanetScope tiles (~3,500 km2) spanning eight ecoregions across five continents, plus 362 Sentinel-1 and 298 Sentinel-2 coincident images within a 72-hour window. Training inundation segmentation models on these high-resolution labels improves flood detection accuracy by up to 15.6% over prior public datasets.
datasets.numSamples: 366 PlanetScope tiles; 362 Sentinel-1; 298 Sentinel-2 images; 19 flood events

datasets.name: ZueriCrop
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 satellite image time-series dataset for crop-type instance and semantic segmentation over Switzerland.
datasets.description: ZueriCrop provides multispectral Sentinel-2 imagery with instance and semantic masks covering 48 crop categories. It contains roughly 116k images (24x24 px at 10 m/pixel) organized into ~28k time series of 142 acquisitions each, packaged as a single HDF5 file. The dataset is designed for time-series crop mapping and is available as a built-in TorchGeo dataset class.

datasets.name: sat-image-boundingbox-sft-full
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 satellite imagery paired with land-cover bounding-box outputs as image-text rows for vision-language fine-tuning.
datasets.description: This dataset packages Sentinel-2 multispectral optical chips (derived from a public STAC catalog and percentile-stretched to uint8) together with aligned land-cover labels formatted as image-text SFT rows. JSONL prompts describe the modality so the data can be used to fine-tune multimodal models on satellite imagery understanding and bounding-box grounding. It contains on the order of 100K-1M rows.

datasets.name: DASP
datasets.summary: A near-global cloud-free Sentinel-2 mosaic dataset of Earth's surface across all spectral bands.
datasets.description: DASP (Distributed Analysis of Sentinel-2 Pixels) consists of cloud-free satellite imagery built from over 30 million Sentinel-2 captures, selecting the most recent non-partial, cloudless acquisition per location in every band. It provides a near-complete cloudless view of Earth's surface for general geospatial applications. Images were converted from JPEG2000 to JPEG-XL for storage efficiency.

datasets.name: sat-vl-sft-training-ready-v1
datasets.summary: A procedural vision-language SFT dataset built from Sentinel-2 chips and per-tile land-cover metadata for multimodal model training.
datasets.description: This metadata-first VLM supervised fine-tuning dataset is built from a sat-bbox style tree of Sentinel-2 chips with per-tile JSON metadata sidecars and optional paired Mapbox stills. It supplies captioning, bounding-box grounding in normalized coordinates, and class-focused captions with absence checks for land-cover regions. The data is shaped as production-ready supervision for multimodal chat models and contains 100K-1M rows.

datasets.name: s2-naip
datasets.summary: A continental-US remote sensing dataset of spatially aligned NAIP, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat imagery.
datasets.description: AI2-S2-NAIP aligns high-resolution NAIP aerial imagery with Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat imagery across the entire continental United States, divided into 512x512 tiles at 1.25 m/pixel across 10 UTM projections. Each tile pairs a NAIP image from 2019-2021 with 16-32 Sentinel-2 L1C acquisitions plus Sentinel-1 and Landsat data captured nearby in time. It is designed for multi-sensor remote sensing tasks such as super-resolution and fusion.

datasets.name: wrf-250m-severe-weather-overlays
datasets.summary: High-resolution 250 m WRF model simulations of severe US weather events ready for plotting.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 18 high-resolution severe-weather simulations from the WRF numerical weather model at 250 m resolution, covering tornadoes, wildfires, hurricanes, blizzards, heat waves, and flooding events across the US. Each event provides surface weather fields at 1-minute temporal resolution on an 800x800 grid, with coordinate arrays (latitude/longitude) supplied per event. The NumPy-ready format is intended for rapid map generation and weather visualization.

datasets.name: GROC
datasets.summary: A geospatial remote-sensing benchmark of paired raster tiles with land-cover and object annotations sourced from PDOK.
datasets.description: GROC is a remote-sensing benchmark providing paired raster tiles together with labels, split files, tile extents, and source vector map data acquired from the Dutch PDOK service. It includes RGB, color-infrared, basemap, and digital surface model image tiles plus land-cover tiles and public annotation files. The dataset supports object detection and related geospatial tasks.

datasets.name: ai4g-flood-dataset
datasets.summary: Global flood detections derived from a decade of Sentinel-1 SAR imagery using deep-learning change detection.
datasets.description: This dataset accompanies the paper 'Mapping global floods with 10 years of satellite radar data' and contains global flood detections derived from Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar imagery via a deep-learning change-detection model. It spans October 2014 to September 2024, offering a longitudinal view of flood-prone areas worldwide. The cloud-penetrating SAR basis enables consistent flood mapping regardless of weather or daylight.

datasets.name: DisasterM3
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing vision-language dataset of bi-temporal satellite imagery for disaster damage assessment and response.
datasets.description: DisasterM3 is a remote-sensing vision-language dataset for disaster damage assessment and response, comprising 26,988 bi-temporal satellite images and 123k instruction pairs across five disaster-related task types. It supports visual question answering and instruction-following over pre- and post-event imagery. The dataset accompanies a published paper with associated code.

datasets.name: WHU-Building-Dataset
datasets.summary: A benchmark for building extraction from 0.3 m high-resolution aerial imagery with pixel-level masks.
datasets.description: The WHU Building Dataset is a widely-used benchmark for building extraction from high-resolution aerial imagery. It provides RGB aerial images at 0.3 m ground sampling distance tiled to 512x512 pixels, with binary pixel-level building masks (background and building classes). The data is organized into standard train/validation/test splits for semantic segmentation.

datasets.name: sat-vl-sft-postprocessed-merged-v1
datasets.summary: A post-processed, merged vision-language SFT dataset built from Sentinel-2 chips and per-tile land-cover metadata.
datasets.description: This is a metadata-first, procedural VLM supervised fine-tuning dataset built from a sat-bbox style tree of Sentinel-2 chips with per-tile JSON metadata sidecars and optional paired Mapbox stills. It provides captioning, normalized-coordinate bounding-box grounding, and class-focused captions with absence checks for land-cover regions. This version is a post-processed and merged release containing 100K-1M rows.

datasets.name: NOAH-mini
datasets.summary: A small sample of the NOAH multi-band Landsat-8 satellite imagery dataset for image-to-image tasks.
datasets.description: NOAH-mini is a compact sample of the larger NOAH dataset, which contains 234,089 multi-band satellite images (~650MB each) across 11 bands that is impractical to host in full. The mini version provides a representative subset across different Landsat-8 spectral bands and modalities for experimentation. It is intended for image-to-image and weather/Earth-observation modeling tasks.

datasets.name: HHDC
datasets.summary: A dataset of 3-D Hyperheight Data Cubes (photon-count canopy volumes) built from NEON discrete-return LiDAR for denoising and super-resolution tasks.
datasets.description: HHDC (Hyperheight Data Cube) is a dataset of 3-D photon-count waveform cubes generated from NEON discrete-return LiDAR using the HHDC-Creator pipeline. Each cube stores a high-resolution canopy volume (by default 0.5 m vertical bins over a 64 m height range, with footprints every 2 m) across a 96 m x 96 m tile. The dataset is designed for canopy-structure denoising and super-resolution research. It is accompanied by an open-source generation pipeline.

datasets.name: GlobalTrace
datasets.summary: A benchmark of GPS trajectories from 73 cities/regions worldwide with masked-segment annotations for evaluating trajectory reconstruction methods.
datasets.description: GlobalTrace is a benchmark of GPS trajectories drawn from 73 cities and regions across the world, designed to evaluate trajectory reconstruction and recovery methods. Each trajectory is provided with three masking strategies (destination, large_gap, and simple_interpolation with a 200 m gap target) to simulate missing data. The dataset is split into train (44 cities, 8,815 trajectories), validation (10 cities, 1,787 trajectories), and test (19 cities, 1,707 trajectories) sets, with the validation and test splits held out for evaluation.

datasets.name: sat-bbox-metadata-sft-v1
datasets.summary: A metadata-first VLM supervised fine-tuning dataset built from Sentinel-2 satellite chips with captioning, grounding, and land-cover annotations.
datasets.description: sat-bbox-metadata-sft-v1 is a procedural vision-language-model SFT dataset built from a "sat-bbox" style dataset tree of Sentinel-2 chips with per-tile JSON metadata sidecars and optionally paired Mapbox stills. It is designed to produce high-signal supervision for multimodal chat models on satellite imagery, including captioning of chips, grounding (bounding boxes in normalized coordinates) for land-cover regions, class-focused captions, and absence checks. The dataset targets production-shaped training for geospatial multimodal models.

datasets.name: brief-composer-sft-v1
datasets.summary: A multi-image VLM supervised fine-tuning dataset of executive-style analytical briefs composed from Sentinel-2 imagery and metadata.
datasets.description: BriefComposer SFT is a multi-image analytical-brief dataset composed from completed FireWatch, OceanScout, LandShift, and FloodPulse Earth-observation dataset folders (metadata plus images). Each of the 8,000 samples stitches 1-4 Sentinel-2 images and metadata-derived headlines into a single executive-style assistant reply, formatted as JSONL chat-style training examples. It is intended for fine-tuning vision-language models on geospatial analysis and reporting tasks. Splits comprise 6,307 train, 851 validation, and 842 test records.

datasets.name: Amfitrite-Open-Waters-HAB-Sentinel2
datasets.summary: Multispectral Sentinel-2 imagery tiles of open-water and coastal marine areas labeled by the potential presence of Harmful Algal Blooms.
datasets.description: Amfitrite-Open-Waters-HAB-Sentinel2 contains multispectral Sentinel-2 satellite imagery tiles focused on open-water and coastal marine environments, classified by the potential presence of Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs). It is designed to train machine-learning and deep-learning models (such as CNNs) for large-scale environmental monitoring and ocean anomaly detection. The dataset supports image-classification approaches to identifying marine algal-bloom events from optical satellite data.

datasets.name: WorldFloodsv2
datasets.summary: 509 paired Sentinel-2 images and flood segmentation masks for global flood-extent mapping from optical satellite imagery.
datasets.description: WorldFloodsv2 is a dataset for global flood-extent segmentation in optical satellite images, released with the publication by Portales-Julia et al. in Scientific Reports (2023). It contains 509 pairs of Sentinel-2 images and corresponding flood segmentation masks, split into train, validation, and test sets, requiring approximately 76 GB of storage. The dataset enables training and benchmarking of semantic-segmentation models for mapping flood extent worldwide.

datasets.name: Major TOM Core-DEM
datasets.summary: A global collection of Copernicus Digital Elevation Model tiles (356 x 356 px) within the Major TOM Earth-observation ecosystem.
datasets.description: Major TOM Core-DEM provides global coverage of the Copernicus Digital Elevation Model (DEM), gridded into tiles of 356 x 356 pixels following the Major TOM grid. It was created to support the development of the MESA terrain-generation model and is part of the Major TOM (Terrestrial Observation Metaset), an expandable framework of interoperable Earth-observation datasets developed by ESA Phi-lab. The dataset is also featured in research on cross-modal retrieval of global satellite images.

datasets.name: Geo_dataset
datasets.summary: A cross-domain semantic-segmentation benchmark for remote-sensing imagery combining ISPRS Potsdam, ISPRS Vaihingen, LoveDA Urban, and LoveDA Rural.
datasets.description: Geo_dataset is a cross-domain segmentation dataset for remote-sensing images, comprising four subsets: ISPRS Potsdam, ISPRS Vaihingen, LoveDA Urban, and LoveDA Rural. It is suitable for conducting domain-adaptation and domain-generalization experiments on aerial and satellite imagery. The dataset accompanies research on cross-domain remote-sensing segmentation.

datasets.name: Global Streetscapes
datasets.summary: A comprehensive dataset of 10 million crowdsourced street-level images across 688 cities, enriched with 300+ attributes for urban science and analytics.
datasets.description: Global Streetscapes is a dataset by the Urban Analytics Lab (UAL) at the National University of Singapore, comprising 10 million street-level images sampled from Mapillary and KartaView across 688 cities worldwide. Images are enriched with more than 300 attributes covering geographical, environmental, and temporal diversity, and the release also includes manually labeled subsets. The Hugging Face repository hosts the tabular portion (CSV and Parquet files plus manual labels), supporting urban classification, segmentation, and feature-extraction research.

datasets.name: Vector-100k
datasets.summary: A multimodal instruction dataset of 100k chat examples derived from Sentinel-2 imagery for vision-language models on geospatial epidemiology tasks.
datasets.description: VectorOS Vector-100k is a multimodal instruction dataset for fine-tuning vision-language models on geospatial epidemiology tasks, built for the VectorOS project with a focus on vector-borne disease surveillance. It contains 100,000 chat-style examples derived from 10,000 geospatial chips across 30 areas of interest, where each accepted chip pairs a Sentinel-2 true-color view and a Sentinel-2 NIR-red-green false-color view with structured outputs such as risk assessments, habitat summaries, and exposure analyses. Splits comprise 72,000 train, 14,000 validation, and 14,000 test rows.

datasets.name: US Corn Belt Maize Yield Dataset and Deep Learning Framework
datasets.summary: A dataset and deep-learning framework pairing MODIS satellite imagery with maize yield data for spatiotemporal yield prediction in the US Corn Belt (2012-2020).
datasets.description: This dataset accompanies a study on integrating deep learning and satellite imagery for spatiotemporal maize yield prediction in the US Corn Belt. It pairs optimization-based data assimilation of MODIS satellite imagery with maize yield records over the period 2012-2020, and includes the associated deep-learning scripts. The dataset supports tabular regression and spatiotemporal crop-yield modeling.

datasets.name: CERRA-t2m
datasets.summary: A subset of the CERRA regional reanalysis (2 m temperature) paired at low and high resolution for climate downscaling experiments.
datasets.description: CERRA-t2m is a subset of the CERRA (Copernicus European Regional ReAnalysis) dataset used for climate-downscaling experiments. It provides paired low-resolution and high-resolution data for the 2 m temperature (t2m) variable, organized into train, validation, and test splits, along with normalization statistics. The dataset is intended for developing and evaluating super-resolution / downscaling models for climate-reanalysis fields.

datasets.name: China Building Footprints (CMAB Mirror)
datasets.summary: A Hugging Face mirror of CMAB, the first national-scale multi-attribute building dataset of China covering ~31 million buildings derived from remote sensing and GeoAI.
datasets.description: This is a Hugging Face mirror of the CMAB (China Multi-Attribute Building) dataset, the first national-scale multi-attribute building dataset of China, derived from open-source data and GeoAI. CMAB covers 3,667 cities and roughly 31 million buildings with attributes including rooftop area, height, orientation, function, quality, and age, generated from billions of remote-sensing images and tens of millions of street-view images. The dataset supports building extraction, urban analysis, and building-stock estimation.

datasets.name: MethaneSET
datasets.summary: Unified multi-sensor, analysis-ready datasets for satellite-based methane plume detection spanning Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and EMIT.
datasets.description: MethaneSET provides unified, analysis-ready datasets for satellite-based methane plume detection across three sensors: Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and EMIT. It includes expert-verified segmentation masks from two independent monitoring systems (IMEO MARS and Carbon Mapper) plus synthetic plume augmentation generated from over one million WRF-LES simulations, totaling more than one million samples. The dataset targets detection of methane super-emitters, the second-largest driver of anthropogenic warming.

datasets.name: Blackline Atlas Training Corpus v1
datasets.summary: A license-aware, normalized vision-language training corpus for building structured satellite-imagery triage systems over civilian disruption scenarios.
datasets.description: Blackline Atlas Training Corpus v1 is a training-ready dataset that combines text-only planning examples, paired image vision-language examples, hard negatives, and audit/provenance notes for supervised fine-tuning and evaluation of satellite-imagery triage systems. Rows are normalized for reproducible SFT and eval rather than serving as a raw mirror of third-party data. The corpus targets structured reasoning over satellite observations of civilian disruption scenarios.

datasets.name: OSM Data (OpenStreetMap Changesets)
datasets.summary: A parsed and enriched dataset of all OpenStreetMap changesets, changeset comments, notes, and note comments.
datasets.description: This dataset provides a parsed and enriched version of OpenStreetMap editing activity, organized into four sub-datasets: changeset_data (all changesets with enriched metadata, partitioned by year and month), changeset_comments_data, notes_data (map notes with locations and status), and notes_comments_data. It captures the full geospatial editing history and discussion of the OpenStreetMap project. The data is useful for analyzing mapping activity, contributor behavior, and the evolution of OSM coverage.

datasets.name: CMAB-Spatial-Join-0.08B
datasets.summary: A lightweight axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) benchmark derived from the CMAB building rooftop dataset for evaluating spatial join pipelines.
datasets.description: CMAB-Spatial-Join-0.08B is a spatial-join benchmark derived from the CMAB building rooftop dataset, designed for evaluating indexing, vectorized filtering, and output materialization in spatial join pipelines. It stores base axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABBs) and expanded influence AABBs for each building under four workload levels. The data is organized as Parquet shards partitioned by level and province.

datasets.name: COP-GEN-Benchmark
datasets.summary: An evaluation dataset for stochastic benchmarking of generative Earth-observation models against real multi-temporal Sentinel-2 observations.
datasets.description: COP-GEN-Benchmark is the evaluation dataset accompanying the COP-GEN paper, enabling stochastic-benchmark evaluation of generative EO models by comparing generated sample sets against real multi-temporal Sentinel-2 observations at 495 geographically diverse locations. It provides three parallel subsets sharing an identical schema and georeferencing on the Major TOM v2 1056x1056 grid, including real cloud-free Sentinel-2 L2A samples and COP-GEN-generated samples. It supports rigorous comparison of generative Earth-observation outputs to ground-truth imagery.

datasets.name: SP Swimming Pools (São Paulo Swimming Pool Detection)
datasets.summary: An aerial imagery object-detection dataset of swimming pools across São Paulo municipal districts.
datasets.description: São Paulo Swimming Pool Detection contains 8,682 image chips with 26,336 bounding boxes across 97 areas of interest spanning 96 GeoSampa municipal districts (about 99% of São Paulo's land area). It provides Roboflow-supervised train/val splits plus weak and high-resolution positives-only splits at varying ground sample distances (0.40 m/px and 0.10 m/px native GeoSampa resolution). The dataset supports training and evaluating object detectors for swimming pools in high-resolution aerial imagery.

datasets.name: HOT Building Segmentation
datasets.summary: A semantic segmentation dataset for building footprint extraction from aerial imagery, built from validated Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team projects.
datasets.description: HOT Building Segmentation is a semantic segmentation dataset for building footprint extraction from aerial imagery, derived from validated Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) Tasking Manager projects that use OpenAerialMap imagery. It pairs 256x256 aerial image tiles at zoom level 19 from OpenAerialMap with building footprint labels from OpenStreetMap. All source projects have been fully validated, making it suitable for training building-extraction models in humanitarian mapping contexts.

datasets.name: Core-S2L2A
datasets.summary: A global Major TOM collection of over 2.2 million Sentinel-2 Level-2A multispectral patches.
datasets.description: Core-S2L2A provides global coverage of Sentinel-2 Level-2A optical multispectral patches, each 1,068 x 1,068 pixels, totaling over 2.24 million patches and more than 2.5 trillion pixels. It includes the full set of Sentinel-2 bands at their native 10 m, 20 m, and 60 m resolutions. As part of the Major TOM project, it serves as an analysis-ready foundation for Earth-observation representation learning and large-scale model training.

datasets.name: TopAir
datasets.summary: An aerial imagery dataset with depth annotations for semantic segmentation, generated with AirSim.
datasets.description: TopAir is an aerial imagery dataset that provides image, video, and depth modalities for semantic segmentation tasks, generated using the AirSim simulation environment. It is tagged for aerial and depth-aware perception research. The dataset supports training and evaluating segmentation and scene-understanding models on aerial scenes.

datasets.name: GroundSet
datasets.summary: A large-scale, cadastral-grounded Earth-observation dataset for fine-grained spatial understanding with multimodal models.
datasets.description: GroundSet is a large-scale Earth-observation dataset grounded in verifiable cadastral vector data, designed to advance fine-grained spatial understanding for multimodal models. It is built on high-resolution (20 cm) optical aerial orthophotos paired with legally verified vector data from the French national mapping agency (IGN). The dataset features high semantic richness and supports spatial reasoning and visual question answering over aerial imagery.
datasets.modality: Aerial imagery (20 cm orthophotos) + cadastral vector data

datasets.name: AORC Texas Downscaling Benchmark
datasets.summary: A climate downscaling (super-resolution) benchmark based on NOAA AORC 1 km reanalysis data over Texas.
datasets.description: AORC Texas Climate Downscaling Benchmark is built from NOAA Analysis of Record for Calibration (AORC) 1 km reanalysis data over Texas for 2021-2024. It supports training and evaluating statistical climate downscaling (super-resolution) models that reconstruct high-resolution 1 km meteorological fields from coarsened low-resolution inputs at five scaling factors (2x, 4x, 8x, 16x, 32x). The data is provided in Zarr format for weather and climate research.

datasets.name: GEWDiff Training Dataset
datasets.summary: A hyperspectral remote-sensing dataset for training super-resolution models.
datasets.description: The GEWDiff training dataset is a hyperspectral remote-sensing dataset used to train super-resolution models, released under a CC-BY-4.0 license. It accompanies the GEWDiff research work on hyperspectral image super-resolution. The dataset supports developing and evaluating generative diffusion-based super-resolution methods for hyperspectral Earth-observation imagery.

datasets.name: PlanetScope
datasets.summary: A large collection of PlanetScope satellite imagery (Planet Labs Earth-imaging constellation).
datasets.description: PlanetScope is a dataset of high-resolution multispectral satellite imagery from Planet Labs' PlanetScope constellation, totaling roughly 476 GB of image data. The imagery captures Earth's surface at high spatial resolution for remote-sensing applications. The dataset is hosted on Hugging Face for use in Earth-observation and computer-vision research.

datasets.name: TerraMesh
datasets.summary: A planetary-scale, multimodal analysis-ready dataset for Earth-observation foundation models.
datasets.description: TerraMesh is a planetary-scale, multimodal, analysis-ready dataset that merges Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, Copernicus DEM, NDVI, and land-cover sources into more than 9 million co-registered patches. It is designed for large-scale representation learning and training Earth-observation foundation models. Detailed sampling and preprocessing information is described in the accompanying TerraMesh paper.
datasets.modality: Multimodal (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, DEM, NDVI, land cover)

datasets.name: SWIFTT Bark Beetle Detection Semantic Segmentation
datasets.summary: Labeled Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellite imagery for semantic segmentation of bark beetle forest damage, produced by the EU SWIFTT project.
datasets.description: A collection of datasets developed for the SWIFTT project (Satellites for Wilderness Inspection and Forest Threat Tracking), funded by the European Union under Grant Agreement 101082732. It contains labeled satellite imagery acquired with Sentinel-2 (optical) and Sentinel-1 (SAR) for developing and evaluating predictive models that detect and map bark beetle infestations in forests. The data supports semantic segmentation of forest threats from multi-sensor Earth observation imagery.

datasets.name: Satellite Images Color Clustered
datasets.summary: A curated collection of 256x256 satellite image tiles from ArcGIS World Imagery, organized into perceptually-uniform LAB color-space clusters.
datasets.description: The Mosaic Library is a curated collection of satellite image tiles harvested from ArcGIS World Imagery and organized into perceptually-uniform LAB color-space clusters. Each tile is a 256x256 PNG snapshot of Earth's surface at zoom level 15 (~4.8 m/pixel), deduplicated and routed into one of 5,000 color buckets using K-Means centroids in CIE LAB space. The dataset currently covers 786 of the 5,000 color clusters.

datasets.name: XHRBench (RSHR)
datasets.summary: A benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on ultra-high-resolution remote sensing imagery.
datasets.description: RSHR (released as XHRBench) is a large-scale ultra-high-resolution benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on remote sensing data, with images ranging from 4K to 300 megapixels. The evaluation framework spans multiple-choice VQA, open-ended VQA, and image captioning across perception and reasoning tasks. The broader benchmark covers 5,329 full-scene images, with 1,932 rows exposed in the dataset viewer.

datasets.name: VIIRS
datasets.summary: A large multidimensional array dataset of VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite) satellite Earth observation data stored in Zarr format.
datasets.description: An Earth observation dataset containing data from the VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite) satellite sensor. The data is organized as a multidimensional array in chunked Zarr format with dimensions of [4328, 142, 116] and blosc/zstd compression. The full dataset totals approximately 97.8 GB.

datasets.name: MSI Drone Crop Surveys
datasets.summary: Multispectral drone aerial surveys capturing a sunflower crop's lifecycle from April to September 2023.
datasets.description: A remote sensing dataset of aerial surveys documenting a sunflower crop's lifecycle from April to September 2023, produced by Sofia University's Faculty of Mathematics and Informatics and SAP LABS Bulgaria. The dataset captures multispectral imagery (MSI) collected by drone over the growing season to support precision agriculture and remote sensing research. It targets efficient food production applications within the remote sensing ecosystem.

datasets.name: TreeSatAI-CHM
datasets.summary: An extension of the TreeSatAI benchmark adding canopy height model labels derived from German LiDAR surveys for joint tree species and canopy height prediction from Sentinel-1 SAR.
datasets.description: TreeSatAI-CHM extends the TreeSatAI benchmark with canopy height model (CHM) labels derived from German LiDAR airborne surveys (LGLN). It supports joint prediction of tree species (15 genera) and canopy height from Sentinel-1 SAR imagery. The study area is Lower Saxony, Germany, and the data is provided as ready-to-use NumPy arrays at 60m resolution (40,292 training samples).

datasets.name: FireScope-Bench
datasets.summary: A wildfire risk raster prediction benchmark combining Sentinel-2 imagery, climate variables, and burnt-area event data across the USA and Europe.
datasets.description: FireScope-Bench accompanies the CVPR 2026 paper 'FireScope: Wildfire Risk Raster Prediction with a Chain-of-Thought Oracle'. It combines Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, wildfire risk rasters, MTBS event data, EFFIS burnt-area information, and NASA POWER climate variables across USA and European regions. The dataset supports image-to-image and image-text-to-image tasks for wildfire risk prediction and totals approximately 127 GB.

datasets.name: Core-S1RTC (Major TOM)
datasets.summary: A global collection of nearly 1.5 million Sentinel-1 Radiometrically Terrain Corrected (RTC) SAR patches at 10m resolution, part of the Major TOM Earth observation dataset family.
datasets.description: Core-S1RTC provides global coverage of Sentinel-1 Radiometrically Terrain Corrected (RTC) synthetic aperture radar patches, each 1,068 x 1,068 pixels at 10m resolution. It contains 1,469,955 patches totaling over 1.676 trillion pixels, with VV and VH polarization power channels plus false-color thumbnails. It is part of the Major TOM family of expandable Earth observation datasets developed by ESA Phi-lab.

datasets.name: GeoSound
datasets.summary: A geo-referenced soundscape dataset pairing satellite/aerial imagery with environmental audio recordings across a wide geographic footprint.
datasets.description: GeoSound is a geo-referenced soundscape dataset that pairs satellite and aerial imagery with environmental audio recordings. It aggregates recordings from four crowdsourcing platforms (Freesound, Aporee, iNaturalist, and Flickr via YFCC100M) and covers a wide geographic footprint. The dataset, associated with the ACM Multimedia 2024 paper on probabilistic multi-scale zero-shot soundscape mapping, contains 293,718 training, 4,999 validation, and 9,931 test samples for research use only.

datasets.name: Hyperspectral Orchard
datasets.summary: A hyperspectral imaging dataset of orchard fruit for classification and detection in agritech applications.
datasets.description: A hyperspectral imaging dataset of orchard fruit published by Living Optics for agritech remote sensing applications. It supports image classification and fruit detection tasks using hyperspectral imagery. The dataset is tagged for agritech, detection, fruit, and hyperspectral modalities.

datasets.name: Fire Progression Dataset
datasets.summary: An Earth observation / remote sensing dataset for segmenting wildfire progression over time.
datasets.description: A remote sensing dataset focused on wildfire progression, supporting image segmentation tasks over Earth observation imagery. It is intended for modeling how fires spread spatially across satellite or aerial scenes.

datasets.name: bali-flood-prevention
datasets.summary: Multi-spectral satellite imagery of Bali, Indonesia paired with structured flood-risk annotations for flood prediction and water-body detection.
datasets.description: Bali Flood Prevention is a geospatial Earth-observation dataset for flood risk assessment in Bali, Indonesia. It contains RGB and SWIR (short-wave infrared) satellite bands captured monthly from January 2024 through July 2025 across monitoring points in nine regions, paired with JSON-formatted flood-risk assessments covering water extent, standing-water presence, and infrastructure exposure. The dataset is split into 1,710 training and 450 test rows and supports machine-learning models for flood prediction and water detection.

datasets.name: HeatCast
datasets.summary: Landsat-derived land-surface-temperature time-series cubes for 124 U.S. cities, packaged as cloud-readable Zarr v3 stores.
datasets.description: HeatCast is a geospatial dataset of Landsat-derived land-surface-temperature (LST) time series for 124 U.S. cities, stored as sharded Zarr v3 raster cubes for efficient cloud access. Each city includes multiple bands (LST, albedo, vegetation indices, reflectance) spanning observations from 2013 through mid-2025. It is a repacked version of the upstream JesseGuerreroML/US-UrbanLST release, reducing the file count from ~14.5M GeoTIFFs to 7,436 Zarr files while preserving byte-exact fidelity, and is intended for urban heat-island and climate trend analysis.
datasets.task: Land surface temperature / urban heat analysis
datasets.modality: Landsat-derived land surface temperature raster time series

datasets.name: landshift-sft-v1
datasets.summary: Temporal Sentinel-2 image pairs with change captions and grounding for supervised fine-tuning of land-cover change-detection vision-language models.
datasets.description: LandShift SFT is a remote-sensing supervised fine-tuning dataset built from temporal Sentinel-2 image pairs over sampled global locations such as Bokeo (Laos), the Western Desert Oasis (Egypt), and MATOPIBA/Formosa (Brazil). NDVI delta highlights land-cover-style change, and each tile emits a change caption plus optional grounding (bounding boxes) for connected change regions. The dataset contains 6,388 JSONL rows split into train (5,114), validation (633), and test (641), and targets training of change-detection VLMs.

datasets.name: oceanscout-sft-v1
datasets.summary: Maritime supervised fine-tuning samples from Sentinel-2 imagery with vessel-candidate captions and grounding for vision-language models.
datasets.description: OceanScout SFT is a maritime remote-sensing supervised fine-tuning dataset derived from Sentinel-2 imagery. Each training row uses a single post-scene RGB chip per tile, with NDWI defining water and bright targets on water flagged as vessel candidates; tiles carry a maritime caption row plus a grounding row when detections exist. It covers global coastal locations (Charleston, Tokyo, New Orleans, Darwin, Rotterdam, and others) with 1,696 rows split into train (1,336), validation (166), and test (194). Labels are heuristic rather than operational truth and are intended for VLM training.

datasets.name: SoundingEarth
datasets.summary: A geo-referenced soundscape dataset pairing aerial/satellite imagery with geotagged environmental audio for self-supervised audiovisual remote-sensing learning.
datasets.description: SoundingEarth is a geo-referenced soundscape dataset that pairs Google Earth aerial/satellite imagery with co-located, geotagged environmental audio recordings sampled at 32 kHz. Originally collected by Heidler et al. for self-supervised audiovisual representation learning on remote sensing data, it contains 49,284 image-audio samples split into train (40,241), validation (3,242), and test (5,801). Splits use a cell-based geographic partitioning strategy to prevent geographic leakage, and the dataset supports audiovisual representation learning, audio classification, and cross-modal retrieval.

datasets.name: climate-trace
datasets.summary: A large-scale geo-referenced global greenhouse-gas emissions inventory with per-sector, per-location records.
datasets.description: Climate-TRACE is a large-scale tabular geospatial dataset tracking global greenhouse-gas emissions with geographic and temporal dimensions. Each of its roughly 396 million records includes geographic references (latitude, longitude, administrative boundaries), emissions quantities (including negative values for removals/offsets), years 2022-2024, and sectoral/subsectoral classification such as buildings, transportation, fossil-fuel operations, and forestry-and-land-use. It supports emissions inventory analysis at regional scales.

datasets.name: LUCAS-MEGA
datasets.summary: A large-scale multimodal soil-environment dataset built on the European LUCAS soil survey fused with dozens of ESDAC environmental sources.
datasets.description: LUCAS-MEGA is a large-scale multimodal dataset for representation learning in soil-environment systems, built by fusing heterogeneous European soil and environmental datasets with the LUCAS soil survey as the backbone. The released dataset contains 72,000+ soil samples, 1,000+ fused soil and environmental features, and 68 integrated ESDAC source datasets, combining scalar, vector-valued, categorical, textual, and visual features (e.g., hydraulic conductivity curves, water-retention curves, particle-size distributions, and site imagery). It is designed to enable models to learn relationships across soil, climate, terrain, land-use, and hydrological variables.

datasets.name: TransCity-VLM-dataset
datasets.summary: A multimodal smart-city dataset pairing map screenshots with QA, dialogue, and chain-of-thought records for map-grounded urban reasoning vision-language models.
datasets.description: TransCity-VLM is a multimodal smart-city dataset combining JSONL text records with map screenshot imagery to support map-grounded vision-language reasoning over urban domains. It spans traffic flow, electricity systems, bus operations, grid management, and map-grounded question answering for cities including Beijing, Glasgow, and Singapore. The dataset comprises roughly 308,642 test records, 101,736 large-scale QA entries, 138,558 multi-turn dialogue examples, and 37,713 chain-of-thought QA records (about 8.18 GB) alongside 28,055 map screenshot files, targeting forecasting, single- and multi-turn QA, decision support, and chain-of-thought reasoning.

datasets.name: anomaly-detection (PhiSat-2 Marine)
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 / PhiSat-2 simulated marine anomaly-detection segmentation dataset for onboard environmental monitoring.
