datasets.description: This dataset supports on-board anomaly detection for marine environmental monitoring as part of the PhiSat-2 OrbitalAI challenge, developed by the IRMA team at IRT Saint Exupery. It contains images generated from Sentinel-2 satellite data using the ESA simulator to replicate the characteristics of the onboard PhiSat-2 sensor, with 8 spectral bands at 4,096x4,096 resolution and segmentation masks. The 50 images (26 normal, 24 anomalies) are labeled with 9 classes including clear/turbid water, land, clouds, and four anomaly types (plastic, oil, algae, sediments), split into 36 train/val and 14 test samples.

datasets.name: ELDOR-sample
datasets.summary: A compact sample of the ELDOR UAV-orthomosaic segmentation dataset and benchmark for detecting illegal gold mining in the Amazon rainforest.
datasets.description: ELDOR-sample is a compact companion to the full ELDOR dataset, a benchmark for detecting illegal gold mining in the Amazon rainforest from UAV-derived orthomosaic imagery. The sample contains one representative site (AcumulacionAaron2B) with 9,849 512x512 image patches and pixel-aligned semantic label maps, plus the full orthomosaic, for quick inspection of imagery, labels, and patch extraction without downloading the full release. The semantic segmentation task covers 12 foreground classes including mining rafts, heavy machinery, buildings, and natural vegetation types.

datasets.name: project-noah-hazard-maps
datasets.summary: A nationwide geospatial collection of flood, landslide, and storm-surge hazard maps covering all 81 provinces of the Philippines.
datasets.description: The Project NOAH (Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazards) Hazard Maps dataset is a comprehensive collection of geospatial natural-hazard assessments across the Philippines, provided as ESRI Shapefiles and cloud-optimized PMTiles vector tiles. It covers three major hazard types: flood inundation maps for 5-, 25-, and 100-year rainfall return periods, landslide susceptibility and debris-flow maps, and storm-surge advisory maps at four severity levels. Coverage spans all 81 Philippine provinces at province-level granularity, supporting disaster risk reduction and hazard assessment.

datasets.name: JL1-CUP-2024-Second-Format
datasets.summary: Bi-temporal Jilin-1 (JL1) RGB image patches with per-pixel semantic maps and binary change maps for semantic cropland change detection.
datasets.description: JL1-CUP-2024-Second-Format provides the second-track format of the JL1 (Jilin-1) CUP 2024 cropland change-detection benchmark. It consists of bi-temporal 256x256 RGB patches with per-pixel semantic land-cover maps at times T1 and T2 plus a binary change map. The data follow the JL1-Second style layout and split described in the associated benchmark literature, built on imagery from the Jilin-1 satellite ecosystem.

datasets.name: core-five
datasets.summary: A multi-modal geospatial dataset unifying Earth observation data from five sensors into spatiotemporally aligned datacubes for foundation models.
datasets.description: core-five is a multi-modal Earth observation dataset that harmonizes data from five complementary sensors into perfectly aligned spatiotemporal datacubes. It includes optical Sentinel-2 (10 m) alongside additional sensing modalities, designed to train next-generation multi-modal vision and geospatial foundation models. The unified time-and-space alignment supports a wide range of downstream tasks such as segmentation, classification, detection, and image-to-image translation.
datasets.modality: Multi-modal Earth observation (Sentinel-2 and other sensors)

datasets.name: landslide-sentinel2-vlm
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 imagery of Italian landslide events paired with vision-language analysis for landslide hazard detection and risk characterization.
datasets.description: landslide-sentinel2-vlm couples Sentinel-2 satellite imagery with vision-language model outputs for landslide risk assessment and monitoring across Italian regions. Each event provides seven derivative visualizations per scene (RGB, SWIR, NIR false-color composites and NDMI/NDVI/BSI/TCT-wetness heatmaps) with multiple pre-event temporal captures. Rich metadata includes geolocation coordinates, cloud cover, capture months, and JSON descriptions of spectral anomalies, terrain features, and exposure risk, supporting movement-type classification and multi-dimensional risk scoring.

datasets.name: TerraMesh-Masks
datasets.summary: Binary segmentation masks with captions for open-vocabulary segmentation of satellite imagery, extending the TerraMesh dataset.
datasets.description: TerraMesh-Masks is a dataset for open-vocabulary segmentation of satellite imagery. It provides binary segmentation masks paired with captions that extend the samples from the TerraMesh dataset. A human-verified evaluation benchmark, TerraMesh-Masks-Eval, is also provided, and the data can be streamed or downloaded with the accompanying data-loading code from GitHub.

datasets.name: VLRS-Bench
datasets.summary: A vision-language reasoning benchmark for remote sensing imagery with 3,180 images and 2,000 question-answer examples.
datasets.description: VLRS-Bench is a vision-language reasoning benchmark for remote sensing imagery. It contains 3,180 benchmark images and 2,000 benchmark examples, each with image paths, question prompts, answers, and task metadata. The dataset ships with machine-readable Croissant metadata including provenance and Responsible AI fields, supporting visual question answering and image-text-to-text evaluation of remote sensing models.

datasets.name: RTM Emulation
datasets.summary: Atmospheric radiative transfer model emulation challenge dataset for hyperspectral Earth observation.
datasets.description: RTM Emulation is the dataset for the Atmospheric Radiative Transfer Emulation Challenge, released by the ISP image processing lab at the University of Valencia. It provides hyperspectral data for training and evaluating machine-learning emulators of computationally expensive atmospheric radiative transfer models used in remote sensing and Earth observation.

datasets.name: b-FLAIR
datasets.summary: A bi-temporal extension of the FLAIR aerial dataset providing orthoimage pairs for semantic change detection over France.
datasets.description: b-FLAIR is a temporal extension of the FLAIR dataset focused on land-cover classification and change detection in France. It provides bi-temporal aerial orthoimage pairs at 0.2 m/px resolution in 512x512 patches with single-temporal semantic annotations. The dataset targets semantic change detection via weak temporal supervision.

datasets.name: weather_france_radar_satellite_gs
datasets.summary: A ready-to-use fusion of ground-station, radar, satellite, and land-cover data for weather modeling over France.
datasets.description: weather_france_radar_satellite_gs fuses multiple geospatial and meteorological datasets for the France region. It combines hourly ground-station data from data.gouv.fr (seven weather KPIs: RR1, FF, DD, T, U, PMER, VV), Meteo-France radar rainfall accumulation imagery, EarthEnv and OpenTopography land-cover and ground-height data, and EUMETSAT satellite imagery. The fusion provides aligned multi-source inputs for weather and climate modeling tasks.
datasets.modality: Weather / climate (ground station, radar, satellite, land cover)

datasets.name: sapnhap-bando-vn
datasets.summary: A structured geospatial atlas of Vietnam's 2025 administrative-merger units in parquet, GeoJSON, and embedding formats.
datasets.description: sapnhap-bando-vn is a complete structured copy of Vietnam's official administrative-merger atlas (sapnhap.bando.com.vn), published following Resolution 202/2025/QH15 and subsequent National Assembly Standing Committee resolutions. Each administrative level is exposed as parquet, GeoJSON, interactive charts, and 384-dimensional UMAP embeddings. The dataset documents Vietnam's post-merger administrative boundaries.

datasets.name: ccrfcd-mrms-hrrr-env-2021-2025
datasets.summary: Hourly rain-gauge accumulation paired with MRMS radar and HRRR environmental variables for synthetic precipitation estimation in the U.S. Desert Southwest.
datasets.description: ccrfcd-mrms-hrrr-env-2021-2025 is a Zarr-based dataset for training and evaluating synthetic quantitative precipitation estimation (QPE) models in the Desert Southwest. It pairs 1-hour gauge accumulations from 220+ tipping-bucket rain gauges with 50+ MRMS radar and HRRR environmental variables, totaling roughly 400k samples. Given input context such as radar fields and environmental parameters, the task is to predict rainfall at a gauge site over a given period.

datasets.name: Core-S2RGB-SigLIP
datasets.summary: Over 20 million SigLIP vision-language embeddings of global Sentinel-2 Level-2A true-color (RGB) imagery from the Major TOM grid.
datasets.description: Core-S2RGB-SigLIP is a collection of more than 20 million SigLIP-SO400M-384 embeddings derived from global Sentinel-2 Level-2A true-color (RGB) imagery. Built on the Major TOM Core-S2L2A source dataset, each record contains a unique geometry/time-based id, the raw embedding array, and Major TOM grid cell coordinates. The 41.3 GB dataset enables vision-language and similarity search over global Sentinel-2 imagery.

datasets.name: b-FLAIR-spot
datasets.summary: A bi-temporal extension of the FLAIR dataset in SPOT-6/7 satellite modality for semantic change detection over France.
datasets.description: b-FLAIR-spot is a temporal extension of the FLAIR dataset in SPOT-6/7 satellite modality, focused on land-cover classification in France. It mirrors b-FLAIR by providing bi-temporal satellite image pairs with single-temporal semantic annotations. The dataset targets semantic change detection via weak temporal supervision.

datasets.name: PanScale
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing pansharpening dataset of paired multispectral and panchromatic images for cross-scale fusion evaluation.
datasets.description: PanScale is a pansharpening benchmark containing 7,559 paired multispectral (MS) and panchromatic (PAN) image patches stored as 8-bit TIFFs across roughly 6.9 GB. It spans multiple sensor subsets (Jilin, Landsat, SkySat) with varying PAN/MS scale ratios to support cross-scale evaluation. The dataset is intended for image fusion research where lower-resolution multispectral imagery is sharpened using higher-resolution panchromatic bands.

datasets.name: Person Detection and Re-Identification from Low Altitude UAV-based platform
datasets.summary: A low-altitude UAV (drone) aerial imagery dataset for detecting and re-identifying people across scenes.
datasets.description: This dataset consists of labeled low-altitude aerial images captured with a DJI Mini drone for two tasks: person detection (localizing people in frames) and person re-identification (matching individuals across frames). It contains roughly 1,624 annotated images organized into detection and re-identification batches. It is aimed at UAV-based surveillance and aerial computer-vision research.

datasets.name: wildfire-prevention
datasets.summary: A geospatial satellite-imagery dataset for wildfire risk assessment across California regions.
datasets.description: The wildfire-prevention dataset contains 1,034 records (862 train / 172 test) of satellite imagery paired with risk annotations for several California regions including Angeles National Forest, Santa Barbara, and Napa Valley. Each record includes RGB and short-wave infrared (SWIR) imagery, timestamps spanning January 2024 to July 2025, and labels for risk level and environmental factors such as dry vegetation, urban interface, steep terrain, and water bodies. It supports wildfire risk classification and prediction modeling.

datasets.name: xbd-damage-qa
datasets.summary: A visual question-answering dataset for building damage assessment from post-disaster satellite imagery, built on xBD/xView2.
datasets.description: xbd-damage-qa is a question-answering dataset for building damage assessment built on the xBD / xView2 post-disaster satellite imagery dataset. It provides around 1,660 QA samples drawn from roughly 219 scenes across multiple disaster types (wind, flooding, fire, tsunami, volcano, earthquake), using several question templates that require counting, area computation, and percentage reasoning. Each sample pairs pre- and post-disaster imagery with damage polygons and structured answer outputs.

datasets.name: climate-learn
datasets.summary: Benchmark weather and climate data used for ClimateLearn's forecasting, downscaling, and projection experiments.
datasets.description: climate-learn hosts the data used for the ClimateLearn library's benchmark experiments, totaling roughly 783 GB. It supports tasks including weather forecasting, statistical downscaling, and climate projection. The dataset and accompanying library are maintained by the Machine Intelligence Group at UCLA.

datasets.name: Core-S2L2A-249k
datasets.summary: A globally sampled subset of 248,719 Sentinel-2 L2A image patches from the Major-TOM Core dataset.
datasets.description: Core-S2L2A-249k is a curated subset of the Major-TOM Core-S2L2A dataset containing 248,719 Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A image patches of 384x384 pixels, uniformly sampled across the globe (about 352 GB total). Patches include the 12 Sentinel-2 spectral bands at 10/20/60 m resolution. It serves as the source imagery for pre-computed embedding datasets used by cross-modal retrieval applications.

datasets.name: Geolife-Spatial-Join-0.15B
datasets.summary: A high-dimensional rectangle-rectangle spatial intersection join benchmark derived from the GeoLife GPS trajectories.
datasets.description: Geolife-Spatial-Join-0.15B is a spatial intersection-join benchmark derived from the GeoLife GPS Trajectories (v1.3) dataset, converting trajectory points into axis-aligned bounding boxes so that 'encounter within spatial and temporal thresholds' can be evaluated as an AABB intersection join. It contains roughly 149 million rectangle records (about 3.66 GB) organized into 3D (x, y, t) and 4D (x, y, z, t) variants at multiple encounter-threshold levels. Coordinates use centimeters in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) with Unix-epoch-millisecond timestamps.

datasets.name: weather_forecast_japan
datasets.summary: A daily-accumulated archive of Japan Meteorological Agency seven-day weather forecasts for all observatories in Japan.
datasets.description: weather_forecast_japan contains daily-collected weather forecasts of up to seven days ahead for all meteorological observatories in Japan, published by the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA). The forecasts are scraped, structured, and accumulated over time (about 725,142 rows), since the JMA page is overwritten on each update, and the dataset is refreshed automatically each day via GitHub Actions. It supports weather forecasting and meteorological time-series analysis.

datasets.name: bci-temporal
datasets.summary: A multi-temporal, multi-modal dataset of tropical tree crowns from Barro Colorado Island, Panama.
datasets.description: The BCI Temporal Crown Dataset is a multi-temporal, multi-modal collection of tropical tree crowns from Barro Colorado Island (BCI), Panama. It contains 1,897 labeled crown polygons across 84 species, with each tree observed across 16 monthly acquisition dates from June 2024 to September 2025 and paired with ground-level close-up photographs. It supports tree-species classification and phenology analysis from remote-sensing time series.

datasets.name: calvdb
datasets.summary: A benchmark dataset for data-driven annual calving-front forecasting across 123 Svalbard glaciers.
datasets.description: calvingdb (calvdb) is the first benchmark dataset for data-driven annual calving front forecasting, covering 123 marine-terminating glaciers in Svalbard (RGI 6.0 region 07) from 2013 to 2023. It contains 17,358 calving-front observations (about 6.02 GB), and each sample asks the model to predict the calving-front position 365 days into the future given five past observations spanning roughly four years. Imagery is provided at 30 m resolution in an Arctic Polar Stereographic projection (EPSG:3995).

datasets.name: Crop-Yield-Prediction-MODIS
datasets.summary: Processed MODIS remote-sensing data for crop-yield regression, prepared for the DFYP project.
datasets.description: Crop-Yield-Prediction-MODIS hosts processed MODIS data (about 101 GB) used for crop-yield regression in the DFYP project. It includes preprocessed yearly samples indexed by year, county, and sample id (as numpy arrays) along with histogram data, derived from MODIS surface reflectance, temperature, and land-cover products spanning roughly 2003-2015. It is designed to support deep-learning crop-yield prediction from satellite time series.

datasets.name: cropmark-disambiguator-s2
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 classification dataset labeling agricultural tiles for the presence of buried-archaeology cropmark stress.
datasets.description: Cropmark Disambiguator (Sentinel-2 half) is a 922-tile classification dataset (767 train + 155 eval) of Sentinel-2 spectral imagery over agricultural land in the UK (Historic England), Italy (Tavoliere), and Norway (Askeladden). Tiles are labeled Yes/No for the presence of buried-archaeological-feature cropmark stress. It was created to fine-tune a vision-language model for an archaeological cropmark-detection task, with only the Sentinel-2 imagery redistributed (the Mapbox half is excluded).

datasets.name: dam-segmentation
datasets.summary: A multispectral UAV remote-sensing dataset for embankment-dam and dike segmentation.
datasets.description: The Dam Segmentation Dataset contains multispectral UAV image slices captured over the embankment dams and dikes of the Belo Monte Hydroelectric Complex in Para, Brazil. Imagery was acquired with a MicaSense RedEdge-P sensor on a DJI M210 V2 drone (six spectral channels including RGB, red edge, and near-infrared), and each image is paired with NDRE vegetation-index values plus binary and multiclass segmentation masks (about 615 images, 735 MB). It supports semantic segmentation of dam infrastructure.

datasets.name: OmniCloudMask-Combined-Training-Dataset
datasets.summary: A combined multi-source Sentinel-2 dataset for training cloud and cloud-shadow segmentation models.
datasets.description: The OmniCloudMask Combined Training Dataset merges multiple sources into 103,548 image-label pairs (100,528 train / 1,070 validation / 1,950 test, about 150 GB) for training cloud and cloud-shadow segmentation models on Sentinel-2 imagery. It draws from CloudSEN12 (in several processing variants), Kappaset, and OCM hard-negative and scribble subsets, using 3-band (Red, Green, NIR) imagery with four semantic classes. It is designed to build sensor-agnostic cloud-masking models.

datasets.name: Nighthawk Mega
datasets.summary: A large-scale multi-condition UAV/drone aerial imagery dataset paired with vision-language model captions.
datasets.description: Nighthawk Mega is a collection of roughly 1.72M aerial/UAV images spanning multiple environmental conditions, organized into subsets such as day2dusk, day2fog, day2night, day2rain, and rgb2thermal. Each image is accompanied by detailed VLM-generated text descriptions, supporting image captioning and multi-condition perception research. The data is provided in WebDataset format and targets drone, surveillance, and thermal-imaging applications.

datasets.name: Thalia
datasets.summary: A global, multi-modal InSAR dataset for machine-learning-based volcanic activity monitoring.
datasets.description: Thalia is a global, multi-modal dataset for volcanic activity monitoring through satellite-based Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) imagery. Building upon the Hephaestus dataset, it provides higher-resolution, multi-source, and multi-temporal data in a machine-learning-ready format, combining InSAR imagery with topographic and atmospheric variables and text descriptions. It supports image classification and semantic segmentation of volcanic deformation signals.

datasets.name: UHR-BAT-SFT-10K
datasets.summary: A supervised fine-tuning dataset of visual question answering samples for ultra-high-resolution remote-sensing imagery understanding.
datasets.description: UHR-BAT-SFT-10K is the supervised fine-tuning dataset used to train UHR-BAT, a budget-aware token compression vision-language model for ultra-high-resolution remote-sensing imagery. The dataset contains visual question answering style instruction-following samples designed to teach efficient and accurate understanding of large remote-sensing images. It supports allocating visual token budgets per instruction while preserving query-relevant regional evidence.

datasets.name: Core-S2L1C
datasets.summary: A near-global collection of Sentinel-2 Level-1C optical multispectral patches from the Major TOM Earth observation dataset family.
datasets.description: Core-S2L1C is part of the Major TOM expandable Earth observation dataset family and provides global coverage of Sentinel-2 (Level-1C) optical multispectral patches, each 1,068 x 1,068 pixels. The dataset contains 2,245,886 patches totaling roughly 2.56 trillion pixels across all 13 Sentinel-2 spectral bands at native 10/20/60 m resolutions. It is designed as a standardized, expandable foundation for large-scale Earth observation modeling.

datasets.name: OmniEarth
datasets.summary: A benchmark for comprehensively evaluating vision-language models on Earth observation and geospatial tasks.
datasets.description: OmniEarth is a benchmark for evaluating remote sensing vision-language models (RSVLMs) on geospatial tasks. It organizes 28 fine-grained tasks across three dimensions (perception, reasoning, and robustness) and supports multiple task formulations including multiple-choice and open-ended VQA. The benchmark comprises 9,275 quality-controlled images and 44,210 manually verified instructions, including proprietary Jilin-1 (JL-1) satellite imagery.

datasets.name: Foursquare Open Source Places x Overture Inner Join
datasets.summary: A Placekey-based inner join linking Foursquare Open Source Places with Overture points-of-interest geospatial data.
datasets.description: This dataset is a Placekey inner join of Overture (2024-11-13.0) and Foursquare Open Source Places (2024-11-19), matching 7,868,660 placekeys across the two global points-of-interest catalogs. It enriches matched records with geometry and confidence fields contributed by Foursquare Open Source Places. The resource is intended for geospatial place/POI analytics that combine the two open location datasets.

datasets.name: XCO2Learn Dataset
datasets.summary: A unified, reproducible benchmark for satellite-based column-averaged carbon dioxide (XCO2) reconstruction and forecasting.
datasets.description: XCO2Learn is a unified, reproducible benchmark for satellite-based column-averaged carbon dioxide (XCO2) reconstruction and forecasting. It standardizes data preprocessing, spatial-temporal splits, evaluation metrics, and model baselines to address the lack of consistent benchmarks in sparse satellite XCO2 research. The data is provided in NetCDF format with global coverage on a 0.25 degree grid.

datasets.name: Flickr-Geo
datasets.summary: A large collection of geotagged Flickr images filtered to those with valid latitude/longitude coordinates.
datasets.description: Flickr-Geo contains 217,646,487 images with associated latitude/longitude coordinates from Flickr. It is a filtered version of the bigdata-pw/Flickr dataset, retaining only rows with a valid lat/lon pair. The geolocated imagery supports geospatial tasks such as image classification, image-to-text, and text-to-image, and can be efficiently queried with tools like DuckDB.

datasets.name: Imageomics 2025 Aerial Orthomosaic
datasets.summary: Aerial orthomosaic tiles captured at three times of day with canopy height and vision-model embeddings.
datasets.description: This dataset contains aerial orthomosaic tiles captured at three different times of day (10:00, 12:00, and 15:00). It is organized into three configurations: default (raw images plus canopy height), dinov2_base (DINOv2 embeddings), and dinov3_sat (DINOv3 embeddings), all sharing consistent train/test splits with matching tile identifiers for cross-referencing. The dataset is designed for training and evaluating vision encoders on aerial imagery.

datasets.name: PCFootprint
datasets.summary: A large-scale benchmark for vectorized building footprint extraction from airborne LiDAR (ALS) point clouds.
datasets.description: PCFootprint is an extensive open-source benchmark engineered for vectorized extraction of building footprints from Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) point clouds. Sourced from the Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board, it spans 540.67 km2 and comprises 33,000 standardized tiles with 227,264 annotated building instances. It is the first benchmark of its kind for this point-cloud-based footprint extraction task.

datasets.name: Africa Sudan Rainfall Subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Sudan aggregated at the subnational administrative level.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Sudan, computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite imagery combined with in-situ station data and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and published by the World Food Programme (WFP) via HDX. It supports climate and food-security monitoring through tabular rainfall regression.

datasets.name: EEA Industrial Emissions - River Proximity
datasets.summary: Links 160,576 European industrial facilities to nearby rivers with upstream/downstream flow analysis for water-pollution impact assessment.
datasets.description: This geospatial dataset associates industrial facilities from the European Environment Agency (EEA) with segments of the HydroRIVERS network, computing upstream/downstream flow relationships to identify which communities and ecosystems lie downstream of polluting facilities. It pairs point geometries for facilities with line/polygon geometries for rivers and adds Sentinel-2-derived water-quality time series (2017-2023) plus detected pollution anomaly events. Underlying sources include HydroRIVERS v1.0, EU-Hydro, and EEA E-PRTR records.

datasets.name: Drone LSR (Light Stable Representations)
datasets.summary: Aerial drone orthomosaic tiles captured at three times of day, paired with canopy height and self-supervised vision embeddings.
datasets.description: This dataset contains aerial orthomosaic tiles captured at three different times of day (10:00, 12:00, and 15:00) over a ranch landscape. It is organized into three configurations: default (raw images plus canopy height), dinov2_base (DINOv2 embeddings), and dinov3_sat (DINOv3 embeddings), all sharing consistent train/test splits with matching tile identifiers for cross-referencing. It is designed for training and evaluating light-stable visual representations from drone imagery.

datasets.name: LUCID (Lunar Captioned Image Dataset)
datasets.summary: A large-scale multimodal dataset pairing real lunar surface imagery with captions and question-answer pairs for vision-language training.
datasets.description: LUCID is a multimodal planetary remote-sensing dataset built on real lunar surface observations, introduced with the paper "LLaVA-LE: Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Lunar Exploration". It contains roughly 116,000 samples across subsets including about 96,000 image captions, 20,000 question-answer pairs, and an evaluation set, with annotations focused on geomorphological features such as impact craters, rim characteristics, and surface materials. It is presented as the first publicly available dataset for multimodal vision-language training on real planetary observations.

datasets.name: NASA Power Daily Weather
datasets.summary: Daily solar and meteorological data over the Americas from 1984 to 2022, downloaded from the NASA Power API.
datasets.description: This dataset contains daily solar and meteorological variables collected from January 1, 1984 to December 31, 2022 over North, Central, and South America. It includes 28 variables downloaded directly from the NASA Power API plus 3 estimated variables, spanning a 5 x 8 grid covering the United States, Central America, and South America. It is intended for climate, weather, and solar-resource modeling tasks.

datasets.name: LK DMC River Water Level and Flood Warnings (Chunks)
datasets.summary: Chunked Sri Lankan river water-level observations and flood warnings extracted from Disaster Management Centre reports.
datasets.description: This dataset compiles river water-level measurements and flood-warning reports for Sri Lanka, sourced from the official Disaster Management Centre (DMC) and extracted from PDF documents into machine-learning-ready chunks. It covers multiple river monitoring stations (such as Kelani Ganga, Mahaweli Ganga, and Badulu Oya) with alert thresholds, flood classifications, and rainfall measurements, with observations spanning roughly June through October 2025. It supports hydrological monitoring and flood-risk analysis.

datasets.name: 500city
datasets.summary: A large-scale (>1 TB) satellite imagery collection in WebDataset format for Earth-observation tasks.
datasets.description: 500city is a substantial satellite remote-sensing dataset exceeding one terabyte in size, distributed in WebDataset format on the Hugging Face Hub. Hosted under an MIT license and tagged as satellite imagery, it represents a large Earth-observation resource intended for geospatial analysis and model training. Detailed documentation is limited, so resolution and exact contents are not fully specified.

datasets.name: S2 AI4LCC (Sentinel-2 Land Cover, Zarr)
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 imagery paired with AI4LCC-derived land-cover labels, converted to Zarr format for scalable land-cover classification.
datasets.description: This dataset contains land-cover labels derived from the AI4LCC benchmark together with corresponding Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. The original labels and Sentinel-2 tiles were converted into Zarr format to enable efficient storage and scalable access for large geospatial workloads. Image tiles corresponding to label locations were added to create a paired dataset suitable for land-cover segmentation and classification.

datasets.name: Core-S1RTC-SSL4EO
datasets.summary: About 36.7 million global Sentinel-1 SAR embeddings generated with an SSL4EO ResNet-50 MoCo encoder, part of the Major TOM embedding collection.
datasets.description: Core-S1RTC-SSL4EO provides dense vector embeddings derived from Sentinel-1 RTC SAR imagery using the SSL4EO-ResNet50-MOCO image encoder, as part of the Major TOM "Global and Dense Embeddings of Earth" effort by CloudFerro and ESA Phi-lab. It contains roughly 36.7 million embeddings (about 332.5 GB) in Parquet format, each record carrying a unique identifier, embedding array, timestamps, geographic coordinates, geometry, UTM footprint, and CRS information. It supports large-scale Earth-observation retrieval and analysis over global SAR data.

datasets.name: Gargano Sentinel-2 (Clear-Sky)
datasets.summary: Cloud-filtered, fully-tiled Sentinel-2 acquisitions over the Gargano peninsula in Apulia, Italy.
datasets.description: This dataset provides cloud-filtered, fully-tiled Sentinel-2 acquisitions over the Gargano peninsula (Apulia, Italy). Each acquisition is split into a regular grid of 40 tiles (5 rows x 8 columns) covering roughly 10 x 10 km each at 1000 x 1000 px, and only complete acquisitions with mean tile cloud fraction at or below 0.5 are included. The data is organized into three splits, one per band combination, with consistent tiling across overpasses.

datasets.name: FireWatch SFT v1
datasets.summary: Temporal Sentinel-2 pre/post image pairs around wildfire events with dNBR-driven change masks, captions, and grounding boxes.
datasets.description: FireWatch SFT provides temporal Sentinel-2 image pairs (pre/post a wildfire-relevant event date) over fixed areas of interest. A dNBR-style burn signal drives a change mask, and each tile emits a change-caption row plus, where burned regions exist, a grounding row with normalized bounding boxes. This build contains 248 JSONL records (200 train, 48 test) derived from 161 processed tiles, intended for fine-tuning vision-language models on wildfire change detection.

datasets.name: MCTED (Mars CTX Terrain-Elevation Dataset)
datasets.summary: A machine-learning-ready dataset pairing Mars CTX optical imagery with digital elevation models for DEM generation and depth estimation.
datasets.description: MCTED is a machine-learning-ready dataset of optical images of the Martian surface paired with corresponding digital elevation models, created from orthoimage-DEM pairs produced with the NASA Ames Stereo Pipeline using Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter CTX imagery. Samples are processed into 518x518 monochromatic patches with masks identifying artifacts and missing values, retaining roughly 47% of available data after quality filtering. It contains 80,898 samples (65,090 train, 15,808 validation) totaling about 117 GB and targets digital elevation model generation and depth estimation from Mars imagery.

datasets.name: PrediTree
datasets.summary: A large-scale multi-temporal, multi-spectral sub-meter canopy height map dataset for forestry and tree-growth prediction.
datasets.description: PrediTree provides multi-temporal, multi-spectral imagery paired with sub-meter canopy height products, all spatially aligned at 0.5 m resolution. It is designed for remote sensing of forests, ecological monitoring, and fine-grained tree growth prediction. The dataset spans multiple yearly observations to enable temporal canopy height modeling.

datasets.name: Brazil Wildfire Geospatial Dataset
datasets.summary: A historical database of about 1.43 million wildfire heat-detection records in Brazil (2018-2025) enriched with meteorological, land-cover, and elevation data.
datasets.description: This dataset compiles roughly 1.43 million heat foci (focos de calor) recorded across Brazil between 2018 and 2025, drawn from official public sources. Each record is enriched with ERA5 meteorological variables, MapBiomas land cover, and SRTM altitude. It is intended to support scientific research on forest fires and wildfire risk in Brazil.

datasets.name: Satellite Trees Wroclaw 2022
datasets.summary: High-resolution satellite orthophoto imagery and tree metadata for Wroclaw, Poland, collected in 2022.
datasets.description: The Satellite Trees Wroclaw 2022 dataset contains high-resolution satellite orthophotomaps of regions in Wroclaw, Poland, along with per-tile metadata describing the trees in each image. It is organized into images, metadata, and results directories, with JSON metadata for each tile. A 2024 companion version is also available for multi-year comparison.

datasets.name: CrisisLandMark
datasets.summary: A large-scale multimodal corpus of over 647,000 Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical images with structured text and geospatial annotations for text-to-remote-sensing image retrieval.
datasets.description: CrisisLandMark is a large-scale, multimodal corpus for Text-to-Remote-Sensing-Image Retrieval (T2RSIR). It contains over 647,000 Sentinel-1 (SAR) and Sentinel-2 (multispectral optical) images enriched with structured textual and geospatial annotations. By moving beyond standard RGB imagery, it enables retrieval systems that leverage the physical information of different satellite sensors for applications such as Land Use/Land Cover (LULC) mapping.

datasets.name: TIRAuxCloud
datasets.summary: A thermal infrared multi-modal dataset combining Landsat and VIIRS observations for all-day (day and night) cloud detection and segmentation.
datasets.description: TIRAuxCloud is a multi-modal dataset designed to support all-day cloud segmentation, with a particular focus on thermal infrared (TIR) imagery. It combines multispectral observations from Landsat and VIIRS with auxiliary information such as elevation, land cover, meteorological variables, and cloud-free reference imagery. The dataset includes both automatically generated cloud masks and manually annotated references.

datasets.name: Core-VIIRS-Nighttime-Light
datasets.summary: Annual VIIRS Day/Night Band nighttime light radiance composites packaged on the Major TOM grid, comprising over 2.1 million patches.
datasets.description: Major TOM Core VIIRS Nighttime Light provides annual radiance composites from the Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Day/Night Band (DNB), packaged on the global Major TOM grid. It contains 2,108,341 patches of 1056 x 1056 pixels at 10 m, totaling over 2.3 trillion pixels. The dataset supports global analysis of human activity, urbanization, and nighttime light dynamics.
datasets.size: 1056 x 1056 px patches (10 m); >2.3 trillion pixels

datasets.name: Llama3-SSL4EO-S12-v1.1-captions
datasets.summary: Automatically generated text captions aligned with the SSL4EO-S12 v1.1 multispectral Earth-observation dataset.
datasets.description: This dataset provides text captions aligned with the SSL4EO-S12 v1.1 satellite imagery dataset, automatically generated using the Llama3-LLaVA-Next-8B model. The captions are released as compressed Parquet files per split and as CSV files of 256 captions each, matching the Zarr Zip files of the source imagery. The captions were created and evaluated as part of the Llama3-MS-CLIP work for vision-language modeling on remote sensing data.

datasets.name: Long Distance Wildfire Smoke Detection Dataset
datasets.summary: A synthetic long-range imagery dataset of early smoke plumes and wildfire ignitions across global biomes for computer-vision-based early warning.
datasets.description: The Long-Range Wildfire & Smoke Detection Dataset is a synthetic, open-source computer vision dataset for environmental monitoring and early warning. It emphasizes long-distance views from high vantage points such as fire towers and ridgelines, with about 90% smoke plumes and 10% active wildfires. It contains roughly 326 high-resolution images with JSONL annotations describing class, distance, biome, and visibility, spanning Mediterranean, North American, and Asian biomes.

datasets.name: 3D LiDAR Segmentation
datasets.summary: A large (~91 GB) 3D LiDAR point-cloud dataset with segmentation labels and train, validation, and test splits.
datasets.description: 3d-lidar-seg is a 3D LiDAR point-cloud segmentation dataset hosted on Hugging Face, totaling roughly 91 GB across train, validation, and test splits. It is intended for point-cloud semantic segmentation tasks. The repository currently has limited documentation describing the exact source and label schema.

datasets.name: Core-S2L1C-SSL4EO
datasets.summary: Over 56 million general-purpose SSL4EO self-supervised embeddings of global Sentinel-2 Level-1C imagery on the Major TOM grid.
datasets.description: Core-S2L1C-SSL4EO provides 56,147,150 general-purpose embeddings computed from global Sentinel-2 (Level 1C) multispectral imagery using an SSL4EO ResNet50-DINO model. The embeddings are organized on the Major TOM grid, with each record keyed by a unique hash of geometry, time, product id, and embedding model. The dataset is roughly 252.9 GB and supports large-scale geospatial retrieval and analysis.

datasets.name: LEVIR-CD+
datasets.summary: An urban building change-detection dataset of 985 high-resolution RGB image pairs from Google Earth covering 20 regions in Texas (2002-2020).
datasets.description: LEVIR-CD+ is an urban building change detection dataset focused on RGB image pairs extracted from Google Earth. It consists of 985 image pairs, each 1024x1024 pixels at 0.5 m spatial resolution, with building and land-use change masks for 20 regions in Texas spanning 2002 to 2020 (about a 5-year span between observations). It extends the original LEVIR-CD benchmark for bitemporal change detection.

datasets.name: wflow.jl-simulations
datasets.summary: Hydrological simulation outputs and Water Requirements Satisfaction Index (WRSI) drought-monitoring visualizations for East African countries.
datasets.description: This dataset contains wflow.jl hydrological model simulation products focused on water-resource and drought monitoring across East Africa. It includes WRSI (Water Requirements Satisfaction Index) event evaluations and drought-response summary imagery covering Burundi, Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Sudan, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Uganda. The data is distributed as an image folder of regional drought visualizations.

datasets.name: SenseBench
datasets.summary: A remote sensing benchmark for evaluating low-level visual perception, image-quality assessment, and description in large vision-language models.
datasets.description: SenseBench is a benchmark for assessing how well large vision-language models perceive and describe low-level visual properties of remote sensing imagery. It provides paired reference and distorted satellite/aerial images with three-level severity labels (no/slight, moderate, severe distortion) and supports visual question answering and text generation tasks. The benchmark targets image-quality assessment in the Earth-observation domain.

datasets.name: Multi-Perspective Dataset of Plains Zebras
datasets.summary: A FAIR multi-drone aerial wildlife-monitoring dataset capturing synchronized UAV video of plains zebras from multiple perspectives.
datasets.description: This dataset provides synchronized aerial footage of plains zebras (Equus quagga) collected by multiple DJI drones during coordinated wildlife-monitoring missions. It includes drone telemetry, GPS coordinates, camera parameters, and taxonomic information, supporting object detection and video classification tasks. The multi-perspective setup enables study of aerial wildlife monitoring from coordinated UAV platforms.

datasets.name: NAIP 16-Day City Cubes
datasets.summary: Materialized 512x512 multi-layer chips combining NAIP, Sentinel-2, and DEM data with indices and semantic masks for urban Earth-observation tasks.
datasets.description: NAIP 16-Day City Cubes provides materialized 512x512 image chips, each with 16 layers spanning composites, single-band indices, and masks. Layers include RGB composites (NAIP, Sentinel-2, DEM), single-channel Sentinel-2 bands and indices (B08, MSAVI, NDVI, NDWI, SCL), NAIP NDVI, and semantic masks (task labels, LANDFIRE family, CDL). Each chip carries metadata such as tile_id, city, bounding box, chip size, and split.

datasets.name: MassGIS 2023 Aerial Imagery
datasets.summary: High-resolution leaf-off aerial photography covering the entire state of Massachusetts, captured in spring 2023.
datasets.description: The MassGIS 2023 Aerial Imagery Dataset contains high-resolution leaf-off aerial photographs covering the entire state of Massachusetts, captured in spring 2023. The imagery has been converted from specialized formats into standard formats suitable for AI and machine learning applications. It provides comprehensive statewide aerial coverage for geospatial analysis and computer-vision tasks.

datasets.name: Ghana: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Ghana derived from CHIRPS satellite-station precipitation data, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Ghana, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and sourced from the WFP via HDX. It supports tabular regression and climate-monitoring analyses.

datasets.name: Runway OBB Mask2Former (300-65-65)
datasets.summary: Aerial airport imagery annotated for runway oriented-bounding-box and instance/panoptic segmentation with Mask2Former.
datasets.description: This dataset provides aerial airport imagery annotated for runway detection and segmentation, intended for use with Mask2Former models. It supports instance segmentation, panoptic segmentation, and oriented-bounding-box tasks for runway features. The data is split into 300/65/65 train/validation/test partitions.

datasets.name: WDS VTAB-EuroSAT
datasets.summary: A WebDataset-formatted version of the EuroSAT Sentinel-2 land-use/land-cover classification benchmark for CLIP-style evaluation.
datasets.description: This is a WebDataset (VTAB) packaging of the EuroSAT benchmark, originally introduced for land use and land cover classification using Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. EuroSAT consists of labeled multispectral image patches across multiple land-cover classes. This version is provided for CLIP-benchmark and VTAB-style evaluation of vision and vision-language models.

datasets.name: Mozambique: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Mozambique derived from CHIRPS satellite-station precipitation data, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Mozambique, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and sourced from the WFP via HDX. It supports tabular regression and climate-monitoring analyses.

datasets.name: FloodPulse SFT v1
datasets.summary: Temporal Sentinel-2 pre/post image pairs for flood-relevant events with MNDWI-derived inundation masks, captions, and grounding annotations.
datasets.description: FloodPulse SFT v1 provides temporal Sentinel-2 image pairs for flood-relevant events, where MNDWI water masks on pre/post scenes define newly inundated areas (water gained). Each tile receives a caption and optional grounding rows for inundation regions, supporting change detection and vision-language supervised fine-tuning. This build contains 294 JSONL records (263 train, 31 validation) across 189 processed tiles.

datasets.name: EU-Hydro Master Skeleton
datasets.summary: Per-basin GeoParquet shards of river centerlines, river-surface and inland-water polygons, and river-basin polygons derived from Copernicus EU-Hydro v1.3.
datasets.description: EU-Hydro Master Skeleton provides per-basin GeoParquet shards derived from the Copernicus EU-Hydro v1.3 GeoPackages. Four layers are published: river centerlines (~1.3 M MultiLineString features), river-surface polygons, inland-water polygons (lakes and wide waters), and river-basin polygons. All layers are reprojected to a common CRS and stripped of admin-only columns for easier querying.

datasets.name: CHOICE
datasets.summary: An extensive multiple-choice benchmark for systematically evaluating the remote sensing capabilities of large vision-language models across perception and reasoning.
datasets.description: CHOICE is a hierarchical benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models on Earth-observation tasks, covering two primary capability dimensions (perception and reasoning), six secondary categories, and 23 leaf tasks. It contains 10,507 multiple-choice problems built from remote sensing imagery spanning 50 globally distributed cities. The benchmark was used to evaluate 24 vision-language models, including proprietary and open-source systems.

datasets.name: Core-S2RGB-DINOv2
datasets.summary: A global collection of DINOv2 embeddings computed from Sentinel-2 Level-2A true-colour (RGB) imagery, organized on the Major TOM grid.
datasets.description: Core-S2RGB-DINOv2 is part of the Major TOM family of Earth-observation embedding datasets. It contains 56,147,150 DINOv2 embeddings generated from Sentinel-2 Level-2A true-colour (RGB) imagery sourced from the Core-S2L2A dataset, providing global coverage. Each record includes a unique id, the raw embedding array, and the Major TOM grid cell reference, totaling 223.1 GB.

datasets.name: S2-100K
datasets.summary: 100,000 globally sampled multi-spectral Sentinel-2 L2A image patches with geo-coordinates, originally used to train the SatCLIP location-embedding model.
datasets.description: S2-100K is a complete re-host of the dataset used to train SatCLIP (Klemmer et al., 2023). It contains 100,000 globally sampled Sentinel-2 L2A image patches of 256x256 px with 12 spectral bands (uint16) at 10 m ground sampling distance. Each patch is paired with its longitude/latitude coordinates, supporting general-purpose location embedding and self-supervised remote-sensing pretraining. This TorchGeo-hosted version is a verified-complete mirror of the original Microsoft Azure blob.

datasets.name: LAE-1M
datasets.summary: A large-scale open-vocabulary remote-sensing object detection dataset of over 1 million annotated images in unified COCO format.
datasets.description: LAE-1M (Locate Anything on Earth - 1 Million) is an open-vocabulary remote-sensing object detection dataset introduced in the AAAI 2025 paper 'Locate Anything on Earth'. It comprises over 1M images with coarse-grained (LAE-COD, 400k+ images, 20+ classes) and fine-grained (LAE-FOD, 600k+ images, 50+ classes) annotations unified in COCO format. The dataset enables zero-shot and few-shot detection of ground objects in satellite imagery and underpins the LAE-DINO detector.

datasets.name: RSHR-Bench
datasets.summary: A benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs on ultra-high-resolution remote-sensing imagery via visual question answering and reasoning.
datasets.description: RSHR-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on ultra-high-resolution remote-sensing data, with native images up to hundreds of megapixels. It contains 1,932 test examples spanning multiple-choice VQA, open-ended VQA, object/region understanding, and multi-turn reasoning tasks. The benchmark targets fine-grained perception and complex reasoning in remote-sensing scenarios. It was released alongside the 2025 RSHR paper.

datasets.name: SyMTRS
datasets.summary: A high-fidelity synthetic multi-task aerial imagery dataset generated with Unreal Engine 5 for super-resolution, depth estimation, and domain adaptation.
datasets.description: SyMTRS (Synthetic Multi-Task Remote Sensing) is a high-fidelity simulation dataset generated with Unreal Engine 5, built on top of the MatrixCity project. It provides multi-modal, perfectly aligned aerial data including high-resolution RGB images (2048x2048), multi-scale low-resolution images, day/night domain pairs, and ground-truth depth maps. It supports super-resolution (x2/x4/x8), monocular depth estimation, and day-to-night image-to-image translation research.

datasets.name: SSL4EO-EU-Forest
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 forest semantic-segmentation downstream dataset over European regions, extending the SSL4EO-S12 pretraining corpus.
datasets.description: SSL4EO-EU-Forest is a downstream segmentation dataset built as an add-on to the globally sampled SSL4EO-S12 pretraining dataset. It provides paired Sentinel-2 L2A imagery (12-band GeoTIFF, 10 m resolution, up to four seasonal timestamps) and forest classification masks (non-tree, broadleaved, coniferous) over European regions. It contains roughly 16,000 spatial patches of 264x264 pixels, with forest labels derived from the 2018 Copernicus High-Resolution Layer. Cloud cover is kept below 10% per scene.

datasets.name: OlmoEarth-v1-FT-Karst-Groundwater-Base
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 fine-tuning dataset for detecting karst terrain features across Pennsylvania.
datasets.description: OlmoEarth-v1-FT-Karst-Groundwater-Base is a fine-tuning dataset for the OlmoEarth-v1-Base model to detect karst terrain features (surface depressions, sinkholes, surface mines, and non-karst terrain) in Pennsylvania. It combines Sentinel-1 SAR backscatter with Sentinel-2 optical imagery and provides 47,020 labeled geographic points across ~50,000 km2 of the state's karst belt. Labels are sourced from Pennsylvania public GIS repositories (PaGEODE) combined with Sentinel imagery via the Microsoft Planetary Computer, with per-label confidence scores and quality flags.

datasets.name: RSTeller Legacy
datasets.summary: A large-scale remote-sensing vision-language dataset of ~1.2M satellite image patches paired with descriptive captions and VQA-style annotations.
datasets.description: RSTeller Legacy is the legacy version of the RSTeller dataset for scaling up visual language modeling in remote sensing. It contains roughly 1.2 million satellite image patches (448x448 px) paired with JSON metadata and descriptive narratives covering landscape elements such as streams, roads, buildings, wetlands, and forests. It supports image-to-text, text-to-image, and visual question answering tasks. This legacy release is kept available for community access; a newer version accompanies the RSTeller paper.

datasets.name: VISQAM
datasets.summary: A dataset of 1,200 geographic thematic maps annotated for visual question answering and legend detection.
datasets.description: VISQAM (Visual Question-Answering for Thematic Maps) is a dataset of 1,200 geographic thematic maps annotated for visual question answering and legend-detection tasks. Each map includes 3-5 geographic QA pairs and bounding-box annotations for map legends. Maps span land use/land cover, climate variables, choropleth socioeconomic data (OWID), and other cartographic layouts, operating at the intersection of computer vision, NLP, and GIS.

datasets.name: EuroSAT MSI
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 multispectral land cover classification dataset of 27,000 labeled, geo-referenced 64x64 patches across 10 classes.
datasets.description: EuroSAT MSI is a land cover classification dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images, covering all 13 spectral bands. It consists of 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced 64x64 px samples across 10 classes (Annual Crop, Forest, Herbaceous Vegetation, Highway, Industrial, Pasture, Permanent Crop, Residential, River, and Sea/Lake), collected over 34+ European countries. This multispectral (MSI) variant retains the full 13-band Sentinel-2 stack rather than RGB only.

datasets.name: PFM-1 Landmine UAV VNIR Hyperspectral Imaging Dataset (IGARSS 2026)
datasets.summary: A UAV-acquired VNIR hyperspectral imaging dataset for surrogate landmine detection, prepared for IGARSS 2026.
datasets.description: The PFM-1 Landmine VNIR Hyperspectral Imaging Dataset is a UAV-collected Visible and Near-Infrared (VNIR) hyperspectral dataset prepared for IGARSS 2026. It was captured with a Headwall Nano-Hyperspec sensor over a test field containing 143 surrogate landmine targets at various burial depths, with 270 spectral bands spanning 398-1002 nm at ~1.29 cm ground sample distance. It provides pixel-wise binary ground-truth masks supporting classification, segmentation, and detection. This refined release is a subset of the original benchmark cubes.

datasets.name: flood-detection-pair-colombia
datasets.summary: 110 paired Sentinel-2 tile samples labeled for flood detection across 9 documented Colombian flood events, built for vision-language model fine-tuning.
datasets.description: flood-detection-pair-colombia contains 110 paired Sentinel-2 satellite tile samples (4 PNGs per row) labeled for flood detection across 9 documented flood events in Colombia (2017-2025), focusing on the La Mojana wetland region and Putumayo department. It is structured as vision-language SFT examples: each row presents four image blocks (RGB and SWIR false-color, baseline and current timestamps) plus a text instruction, with structured JSON flood labels as the target. The paired-tile change-detection design reduces labeler disagreement on chronic wetlands. It is built for fine-tuning a small VLM deployable on a satellite or community ground station.

datasets.name: AlgaeGuard HAB-NDCI
datasets.summary: A vision-language fine-tuning dataset for detecting and classifying Harmful Algal Blooms from Sentinel-2 NDCI imagery.
datasets.description: AlgaeGuard provides Sentinel-2 NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) colormap imagery paired with text annotations for early-warning detection of Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs). It is designed to fine-tune edge-deployable vision-language models for on-board satellite inference, classifying bloom severity across categories such as CLEAR, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, and CRITICAL. The dataset comprises 398 samples split into train (350), eval (19), and holdout (29) sets, mixing real and synthetic imagery.

datasets.name: NTL Urban Expansion
datasets.summary: A nighttime lights satellite imagery dataset for analyzing urban expansion patterns.
datasets.description: NTL Urban Expansion is a geospatial remote sensing collection of nighttime lights (NTL) satellite imagery provided in GeoTIFF format. It supports the study of urban growth and expansion patterns through changes in nighttime light emissions over time. The dataset contains 528 rows totaling roughly 125 MB.

datasets.name: Togo: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Togo aggregated by subnational administrative unit.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Togo computed from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery combined with in-situ station data and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts. Indicators include 10-day rainfall, rolling aggregations, long-term averages, and anomaly percentages, aggregated by subnational administrative units. Published by the WFP - World Food Programme and sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), with data spanning 1981-2025.

datasets.name: Niger: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Niger aggregated by subnational administrative unit.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Niger computed from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery combined with in-situ station data and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts. Indicators include 10-day rainfall, rolling aggregations, long-term averages, and anomaly percentages, aggregated by subnational administrative units. Published by the WFP - World Food Programme and sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: RWY OBB-300-65-65 v2
datasets.summary: An aerial/satellite imagery dataset for airport runway segmentation using oriented bounding boxes.
datasets.description: RWY OBB-300-65-65 v2 is a computer-vision dataset of aerial and satellite imagery focused on airport runways, annotated for segmentation with oriented bounding boxes (OBB). It is organized into train (303), validation (65), and test (65) splits for a total of 866 images. The dataset supports runway detection and segmentation tasks in remote sensing.

datasets.name: Aardvark Weather
datasets.summary: A machine-learning-ready observational dataset of global weather measurements used to train and evaluate the Aardvark Weather model.
datasets.description: Aardvark Weather is a machine-learning-ready version of the observational dataset developed for training and evaluating the Aardvark Weather end-to-end forecasting model. It aggregates observational weather data from multiple sources including satellites, surface stations, and ships, spanning 2007-2019. The release includes a sample timeslice in the model's expected ingestion format for demo runs as well as a full training dataset, and is associated with a peer-reviewed Nature publication.

datasets.name: Italian Parcels (Cartografia Catastale)
datasets.summary: All official Italian cadastral parcel and commune geometries provided as GeoParquet.
datasets.description: Italian Parcels (Cartografia Catastale - ITALIA) provides all official Italian cadastral parcels and commune geometries as a GeoParquet dataset. The data is derived from the Italian national geoportal (geodati.gov.it), which originally distributes it via WFS services and nested zipped GML downloads. The dataset converts this into an analysis-friendly geospatial vector format for direct use in tools such as QGIS.

datasets.name: Runway Thresholds
datasets.summary: A satellite-imagery object-detection dataset of airport runway threshold (piano key) markings.
datasets.description: Runway Thresholds (Runway Piano Markings Dataset) is a computer-vision dataset for detecting airport runway threshold markings, known as piano keys, in satellite imagery. It contains 8,000 satellite images of size 640x640 captured from Google Maps, with all runways oriented upward to simplify the detection task. The dataset is organized into images and labels directories for object detection.

datasets.name: Satellite Building Segmentation
datasets.summary: An aerial/satellite imagery dataset with instance segmentation masks for buildings.
datasets.description: This dataset provides satellite and aerial imagery annotated with building instance segmentation masks. It contains 6,764 training, 1,934 validation, and 967 test images, derived from a Roboflow Universe buildings instance-segmentation project. It is intended for training and evaluating building footprint and instance segmentation models.

datasets.name: HLS Burn Scars
datasets.summary: Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery of burn scars over the contiguous US with segmentation masks.
datasets.description: This dataset contains Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) imagery of burn scars and the associated masks for the years 2018-2021 over the contiguous United States. There are 804 scenes of size 512x512 pixels. Its primary purpose is training geospatial machine learning models for burn-scar detection and segmentation. It is published by the IBM-NASA Prithvi geospatial collaboration.

datasets.name: Archaeological Sites Central Asia
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and FABDEM elevation data for detecting archaeological sites in Central Asia.
datasets.description: This remote-sensing dataset combines Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite imagery with FABDEM elevation data to support archaeological site analysis across Central Asia. It is designed for image classification and object detection tasks aimed at locating and characterizing archaeological features. The dataset totals roughly 3.65 GB of imagery and labels.

datasets.name: FloodSim Simulation Dataset
datasets.summary: A geospatial flood-simulation dataset derived from a 5m digital elevation model for a C++ flood simulation environment.
datasets.description: This dataset was generated via an automated Python pipeline for use in a C++ flood simulation environment. It is a derived work built by processing and aggregating open data sources, notably a 5m Digital Elevation Model from the Spanish Instituto Geografico Nacional (IGN). The data is provided in geospatial and image modalities for flood-modeling experiments.

datasets.name: Low-to-High-Res Weather from Topography
datasets.summary: A dataset for downscaling low-resolution weather forecasts to higher resolution using topography data.
datasets.description: This dataset is structured for the problem of transforming and interpolating low-resolution weather forecasts into higher resolution using topography data. It consists of three data types: historical weather observation data from SMHI stations (evaluation points), historical low-resolution weather forecasts, and topographic data. It supports machine learning approaches to statistical weather downscaling.

datasets.name: CarbonGlobe
datasets.summary: A global-scale, multi-decade machine-learning dataset and benchmark for forecasting carbon dynamics in forest ecosystems.
datasets.description: CarbonGlobe is a global-scale, multi-decade, machine-learning-ready dataset and benchmark for forecasting carbon dynamics in forest ecosystems. It provides harmonized environmental drivers and carbon-related ecosystem outputs simulated by the Ecosystem Demography model version 3 (ED v3), covering roughly 70,000 global grid cells at 0.5-degree resolution with 40+ years of monthly data (1980-2020) and 100+ environmental variables. It enables development and comparison of deep learning models for carbon forecasting and was accepted to the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.

datasets.name: GreenHyperSpectra
datasets.summary: A multi-source hyperspectral reflectance dataset of vegetation for global plant trait prediction.
datasets.description: GreenHyperSpectra is a collection of hyperspectral reflectance data of vegetation gathered from different sources for global vegetation trait prediction. It is intended for regression machine learning tasks using self-supervised and semi-supervised learning, and includes both unlabeled and labeled configurations. The dataset targets plant trait prediction at global scale.

datasets.name: NU-TONIC SFT Satellite Imagery
datasets.summary: Satellite imagery and aligned land-cover outputs packaged as image-text rows for vision-language model fine-tuning.
datasets.description: This dataset packages satellite imagery and aligned land-cover outputs as image-text rows for fine-tuning vision-language models in the leap-finetune vlm_sft format. It includes RGB optical chips (around 224x224) from public STAC catalogs, per-pixel land-cover labels from Earth Engine reprojected to a 10-meter grid, and optional overhead context imagery, paired with structured prompts that identify land-cover classes such as trees, crops, shrub-and-scrub, and bare-ground. The data spans 310 rows split into train (252), validation (29), and test (29).

datasets.name: Hurricane (Prithvi WxC Evaluation)
datasets.summary: MERRA-2 surface and pressure-level weather data for evaluating the Prithvi WxC model on Atlantic hurricanes.
datasets.description: This dataset provides the evaluation data for assessing the Prithvi WxC weather and climate foundation model on hurricanes. It comprises MERRA-2 surface and pressure-level data covering the 160 variables used in training, with 75 different initial conditions for hurricanes that formed in the Atlantic Ocean between 2017 and 2023. The scientific objective is to assess the zero-shot performance of Prithvi WxC on hurricane forecasting. It is published by the IBM-NASA geospatial collaboration.

datasets.name: SEN2MS Optical
datasets.summary: 5-band Sentinel-2 image patches with bounding-box annotations for vessel detection.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 5-band Sentinel-2 patches exported from SEN2MS for vessel detection. It includes 1,161 images (861 non-empty and 300 empty) with 1,553 bounding boxes. Each image is 128x128 pixels with bands B04, B03, B02, B08, and B11, provided as .npy tensors alongside image-level and object-level annotation manifests in Parquet.

datasets.name: MTBench (Weather)
datasets.summary: A multimodal weather benchmark pairing high-resolution meteorological time series with aligned textual context for temporal and cross-modal reasoning.
datasets.description: MTBench is a suite of multimodal datasets for evaluating large language models on temporal and cross-modal reasoning, with a weather domain that aligns historical weather time series (e.g., temperature records) with textual weather reports and QA prompts. The weather subset provides paired time-series and text instances to support tasks such as forecasting, trend analysis, and news/report-driven question answering. It is part of a larger benchmark that also spans the finance domain.

datasets.name: Waste-Dumpsites-DroneImagery
datasets.summary: A drone imagery dataset for detecting illegal waste dumpsites from nadir aerial views.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 2,115 nadir (90-degree, straight-down) drone images of illegal waste dumpsites at 1280x1280 pixel resolution, collected as part of the Raven Scan project. It is organized into train/valid/test splits with COCO-format annotations and parquet files containing embedded images. The data supports object detection models for environmental monitoring of illegal dumping.

datasets.name: Chad: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Chad derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery, aggregated by subnational administrative unit.
datasets.description: This dataset provides dekadal rainfall indicators for Chad, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall amounts and anomalies, published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX). The data supports drought monitoring and food-security analysis.

datasets.name: TAMMs
datasets.summary: A large-scale satellite image time-series dataset for change understanding and future image forecasting, curated from Functional Map of the World.
datasets.description: TAMMs is a dataset derived from the Functional Map of the World (fMoW) benchmark, curated to support multimodal and temporal reasoning over satellite image time series. It contains 37,003 high-quality temporal sequences, each with at least four distinct timestamps, spanning 58 semantic categories. It was built to enable Temporal Change Description and Future Satellite Image Forecasting tasks.
datasets.task: Image captioning / change understanding and forecasting
datasets.modality: Satellite imagery / remote sensing time series

datasets.name: GlobalGeoTree
datasets.summary: A global multi-granular vision-language dataset pairing 6.3 million geolocated tree occurrences with Sentinel-2 time series for tree species classification.
datasets.description: GlobalGeoTree is a comprehensive global dataset for tree species classification, comprising 6.3 million geolocated tree occurrences spanning 275 families, 2,734 genera, and 21,001 species across hierarchical taxonomic levels. Each sample is paired with a Sentinel-2 image time series (12 monthly median composites, 5x5 pixel patches) and 27 auxiliary environmental variables covering bioclimatic, geographic (SRTM), and soil (SoilGrids) data. It includes the GlobalGeoTree-6M pretraining subset and a GlobalGeoTree-10kEval benchmark for zero-shot and few-shot classification.

datasets.name: DALES 2
datasets.summary: A renovated large-scale aerial LiDAR benchmark for 3D scene understanding with re-annotated semantic/instance labels and companion scene-graph structure.
datasets.description: DALES 2 is a renovated large-scale aerial LiDAR benchmark for 3D scene understanding, built on the geographic coverage of the original DALES release with re-annotated semantic and instance labels and a refined taxonomy. It adds a companion scene-graph structure describing objects and their relations, as presented in a USM3D workshop paper at CVPR 2026. The repository distributes annotated point clouds (typically LAZ/LAS per tile) along with graph JSON.

datasets.name: MapEval-Visual
datasets.summary: A map-based visual question-answering benchmark for evaluating geo-spatial reasoning in foundation models.
datasets.description: MapEval-Visual is the visual track of the MapEval benchmark for evaluating geo-spatial reasoning in foundation models. It contains 400 multiple-choice questions paired with map screenshots, covering task categories such as place information (POI identification), nearby/proximity queries, routing, counting, and unanswerable questions. The broader MapEval benchmark spans 180 cities and 54 countries across textual, API-based, and visual modalities.

datasets.name: Urban (Hyperspectral)
datasets.summary: A widely used hyperspectral image of an urban scene for hyperspectral unmixing research.
datasets.description: Urban is one of the most widely used hyperspectral datasets in hyperspectral unmixing studies. The image contains 307x307 pixels, each corresponding to a 2x2 m2 ground area, with 210 wavelengths spanning 400-2500 nm at a 10 nm spectral resolution. After removing channels affected by dense water vapor and atmospheric effects, 162 channels remain. It is commonly used to benchmark spectral unmixing and endmember extraction algorithms.

datasets.name: FAO EVE Global Flood Monitoring System (Africa)
datasets.summary: Satellite-derived flood persistence and impact data from FAO's DIEM Events Visualization in Emergencies (EVE) system, focused on Africa.
datasets.description: The DIEM Events Visualization in Emergencies (EVE) system from the FAO provides resources to understand flood events and their impact on different land cover types, with a particular focus on agricultural areas. It includes flood persistence analysis and estimates of the population affected. The data is derived from satellite observations of flood events and distributed via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: GeoRSCT
datasets.summary: A geospatial regression benchmark of U.S. ZIP Code Tabulation Areas for evaluating representation-solver compatibility.
datasets.description: GeoRSCT is a benchmark and evaluation framework for studying when geospatial model performance reflects solver quality versus target difficulty, spatial leakage, aggregation effects, scale sensitivity, or representation-solver mismatch. The release includes 31,789 U.S. ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTAs) with 106 columns spanning ACS features and geospatial enrichments. It is designed for studying spatial generalization, spatial lag, flood risk, healthcare access, and social vulnerability in geospatial regression tasks.

datasets.name: Guinea Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Guinea, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Guinea, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units. Published by the WFP - World Food Programme and distributed via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Remote Sensing VQA Benchmark
datasets.summary: A remote sensing visual instruction and question-answering benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models.
datasets.description: This benchmark contains remote sensing visual instruction tasks used to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), released as part of the EMNLP 2025 paper 'On Domain-Specific Post-Training for Multimodal Large Language Models'. It targets the remote sensing domain and supports visual question answering over satellite and aerial imagery. The datasets can be loaded directly via the Hugging Face datasets library.

datasets.name: DeepExtremeCubes-video
datasets.summary: A storage-efficient, video-encoded repackaging of Sentinel-2 minicubes for compound-extreme event analysis.
datasets.description: DeepExtremeCubes-video is a storage-efficient, analysis-ready re-packaging of the original DeepExtremeCubes collection following the TACO specification. It contains all 42k Sentinel-2 minicubes (2.56 km x 2.56 km, 2016-2022, 7 bands, 5-daily cadence), transcoded into H.265/HEVC videos for roughly 12x compression. It is intended for studying compound extreme events such as heatwaves and droughts.
datasets.size: 2.56 km x 2.56 km minicubes, 7 bands, 5-daily cadence

datasets.name: Wildfire CA 2023
datasets.summary: An image dataset of California wildfire scenes from 2023.
datasets.description: Wildfire-CA-2023 is a small image dataset capturing California wildfire scenes from 2023. It is stored in an image-folder format and is intended for wildfire detection and analysis tasks. The dataset is geospatially scoped to California in 2023.

datasets.name: Drone Orthomosaic Vehicles YOLO Annotation
datasets.summary: Drone orthomosaic aerial imagery of mining tailings sites annotated in YOLO format for vehicle and instrument detection.
datasets.description: This dataset contains drone-captured orthomosaic aerial imagery of tailings mining sites, annotated in YOLO format for object detection. The annotations cover mining vehicles and instruments. It is intended for training and evaluating object detection models on aerial/drone imagery.

datasets.name: Global Bathymetry PMTiles
datasets.summary: A global bathymetric dataset processed from GEBCO grids into web-native PMTiles for visualization and research.
datasets.description: A global bathymetric dataset optimised for web-native mapping, processed from GEBCO source grids into the PMTiles format. It is intended for visualisation, exploration, education, and research only, and explicitly not for navigation or safety-critical purposes. The dataset was built as part of a visualisation project and is released under a CC0 license.

datasets.name: Major TOM Core AlphaEarth Embeddings
datasets.summary: A prototype subset of AlphaEarth satellite embeddings organized in the Major TOM global grid.
datasets.description: This prototype dataset includes a subset of AlphaEarth embeddings stored in Major TOM grid cells, aimed at experimentation and prototyping. Each record provides a grid cell identifier, year, a 3-dimensional PCA thumbnail image, centre latitude/longitude, embedding vectors, and UTM footprint metadata. It is part of the Major TOM project for Earth observation and is particularly useful alongside other Major TOM datasets.

datasets.name: NYC Sidewalks with Land Use
datasets.summary: NYC sidewalk segments enriched with land use and proximity data to public facilities and licensed businesses.
datasets.description: This dataset integrates New York City sidewalk segments with land use information. Each sidewalk segment is enriched with proximity data to the nearest public facility and nearest licensed business, including distance fields, centroid coordinates (latitude/longitude), and geometry in WKT format. It is a geospatial/GIS dataset suitable for urban analysis.

datasets.name: classify-embeddings-sf-baseball-marinas
datasets.summary: Geospatial Clay foundation-model embeddings of San Francisco Bay Area imagery labelled for baseball-field and marina scene classification.
datasets.description: This dataset contains precomputed geospatial embeddings produced by the Clay Earth-observation foundation model over satellite/aerial imagery of the San Francisco Bay Area. Each record pairs an embedding vector with a class label, enabling lightweight downstream classification of scenes such as baseball fields and marinas. It serves as a worked example for embedding-based geospatial image classification.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Arc of Deforestation
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 monthly composite imagery of the Amazon 'arc of deforestation' for deforestation detection and land-cover analysis.
datasets.description: This dataset provides Sentinel-2 satellite imagery covering the Amazon 'arc of deforestation' region, supplied as monthly composites in GeoTIFF format. Imagery spans 2015 to 2022 at 30 m resolution, with file sizes ranging from a few kilobytes up to roughly 2 GB. It is designed for training machine-learning and deep-learning models for deforestation detection and land-cover change analysis.

datasets.name: GeoZero Train Datasets
datasets.summary: A large multimodal training corpus of satellite/Earth-observation imagery with instruction and reasoning annotations for geospatial visual question answering.
