datasets.description: GeoZero Train Datasets is an aggregated, instruction-tuned training corpus for geospatial reasoning over remote-sensing imagery. It ships three variants: GeoZero-Raw (raw aggregated data across heterogeneous datasets), GeoZero-Instruct (a unified instruction-tuned set for supervised fine-tuning), and GeoZero-Hard (a challenging subset for reinforcement-learning training). Image files accompany the JSON annotations to support visual question answering, image-to-text and feature-extraction tasks on satellite imagery.

datasets.name: FloodNet 2021 - Track 2 Dataset (HF)
datasets.summary: High-resolution post-flood UAV/aerial imagery with VQA annotations for post-disaster scene understanding.
datasets.description: FloodNet 2021 is a high-resolution aerial (UAS/UAV) imagery dataset for post-flood scene understanding, here repackaged as the Hugging Face-hosted Track 2 version. It provides imagery with detailed semantic annotations of flood damage to support classification, semantic segmentation and visual question answering. The dataset was created to advance automated damage assessment in post-disaster scenarios.

datasets.name: Equatorial Guinea Rainfall Indicators (Subnational)
datasets.summary: Dekadal subnational rainfall indicators for Equatorial Guinea derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Equatorial Guinea aggregated by subnational administrative units. The indicators are computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Published by the World Food Programme via HDX, it supports tabular regression and climate/food-security monitoring.

datasets.name: TreeSatAI-Time-Series
datasets.summary: A multi-sensor, multi-temporal extension of the TreeSatAI benchmark for tree-species classification from aerial, Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data.
datasets.description: TreeSatAI-Time-Series is a multi-sensor, multi-temporal remote-sensing dataset for tree-species classification in Central Europe, introduced alongside the ECCV24 OmniSat work and building on the TreeSatAI Benchmark Archive. It combines aerial imagery with Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 multispectral time series, with multi-label annotations of 20 European tree species (15 genera) derived from forest administration data of Lower Saxony, Germany. It targets multi-label, multitemporal image classification.

datasets.name: LandsatQuake
datasets.summary: A large-scale Landsat dataset of 31 landslide inventories across 21 earthquake-prone regions for practical landslide detection.
datasets.description: LandsatQuake is a benchmark dataset for practical landslide detection from Landsat remote-sensing imagery, introduced at the ICLR 2025 Workshop on Machine Learning for Remote Sensing. It compiles 31 landslide inventories from 21 earthquake-prone regions worldwide, with annotations provided in PASCAL VOC and YOLO formats. The dataset supports object detection and image segmentation for rapid post-earthquake landslide response and environmental impact assessment.

datasets.name: CraterBench-R
datasets.summary: An instance-level crater retrieval benchmark built from Mars CTX orbital imagery.
datasets.description: CraterBench-R is an instance-level crater retrieval benchmark constructed from Mars Context Camera (CTX) orbital imagery. It provides a gallery of 25,000 crater identities across 50,000 gallery images (two canonical context crops per crater), plus 1,000 held-out query crater identities with 5,000 manually verified query images (five views per crater). It includes official split files, relevance metadata and a minimal evaluation example for image-feature-extraction and retrieval tasks.

datasets.name: HighBuild-1M
datasets.summary: A multi-continental high-resolution overhead-imagery benchmark for single-view building-height estimation.
datasets.description: HighBuild-1M is a multi-continental, high-resolution remote-sensing benchmark for single-view building-height estimation from overhead imagery. Each sample provides a 1024x1024 RGB overhead image, a spatially aligned float32 building-height mask, and COCO-style building instance annotations. The full benchmark contains 70,266 tiles spanning over 6 million building instances across 26 city groups, 12 countries/regions and 6 continents, supporting segmentation and object detection.

datasets.name: Tiselac
datasets.summary: An annual Landsat-8 satellite image time series of Reunion Island for pixel-level land-cover classification.
datasets.description: Tiselac (Time Series Land Cover) is derived from an annual Landsat-8 time series of 23 high-resolution images of Reunion Island (2014) at 30 m resolution. Each pixel carries 10 features per timestamp (7 surface reflectances plus NDVI, NDWI and brightness index), with cloudy observations interpolated, yielding 99,687 labelled time series across 9 land-cover classes. It is widely used as a satellite image time-series classification benchmark.

datasets.name: Africa Synthetic Flooding & Sea-Level Rise Coastal Health
datasets.summary: A synthetic location-year tabular dataset modelling sea-level-rise impacts on coastal health infrastructure and disease outcomes across Sub-Saharan Africa.
datasets.description: A parameterized synthetic dataset that models sea-level-rise impacts on coastal health infrastructure and disease outcomes across three coastal-zone scenarios in Sub-Saharan Africa. Each record represents a location-year observation describing flood risk, facility damage, and supply disruption. It is generated from published SSA literature rather than real observations, so it is intended for modelling and method development rather than empirical analysis or policy inference.

datasets.name: LiDAR COPC San Antonio
datasets.summary: A LiDAR point-cloud dataset covering San Antonio, distributed in the Cloud-Optimized Point Cloud (COPC) format.
datasets.description: A LiDAR aerial point-cloud dataset for the San Antonio area, distributed in the Cloud-Optimized Point Cloud (COPC) format for efficient streaming and spatial access. It provides 3D elevation and surface structure data suitable for terrain modelling, 3D mapping, and geospatial analysis workflows.

datasets.name: Wildfires - CEMS
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 dataset with burned-area delineation and land-cover segmentation annotations focused on European wildfire events.
datasets.description: A remote-sensing dataset for burned-area delineation and land-cover segmentation, with a focus on European soil. It is curated from the Copernicus Emergency Management System (CEMS) and Sentinel-2 feeds, providing satellite imagery paired with segmentation annotations. The data was prepared to support robust burned-area delineation models.

datasets.name: CONUS 2020 Blocks AEF
datasets.summary: A geospatial tabular dataset of US 2020 census blocks covering the continental United States (CONUS).
datasets.description: A geospatial tabular dataset organized at the US 2020 census-block level across the continental United States (CONUS). It combines geospatial, tabular, and text fields and is distributed in Parquet format with millions of records, suitable for spatial aggregation and demographic or land analysis at fine spatial resolution.

datasets.name: EEA Waterbase Cleaned River Measurements
datasets.summary: A filtered and cleaned subset of EEA Waterbase river water-quality measurements (2015-2017) prepared for training Sentinel-2 water-quality models.
datasets.description: A filtered and cleaned subset of the EEA Waterbase Water Quality ICM (WISE-4) v2018.1, prepared for training Sentinel-2 water-quality models. It retains only river water bodies with valid station coordinates within a 2015-07-01 to 2017-12-31 date window aligned with Sentinel-2A acquisitions. The dataset was produced during the 11th CASSINI Hackathon (EU Space for Water).

datasets.name: Prithvi Burn Scar Severity Dataset
datasets.summary: A curated set of multi-temporal Sentinel-2 image chips for wildfire burn-scar severity segmentation, pre-processed for the Prithvi EO 2.0 foundation model.
datasets.description: A curated dataset of multi-temporal, multi-spectral Sentinel-2 L2A satellite imagery chips for wildfire burn-scar severity segmentation. It contains 108 image chips covering wildfire-affected regions, each pre-processed and ready for semantic segmentation training with the Prithvi EO 2.0 foundation model. It is intended for burn-scar severity mapping research.

datasets.name: ClimateSet
datasets.summary: A large-scale climate-model dataset pairing emissions/forcing inputs with climate-model outputs for training climate emulators.
datasets.description: A large-scale climate dataset built to train and evaluate machine-learning climate-model emulators. It aligns greenhouse-gas and aerosol emissions/forcing inputs with corresponding climate-model outputs across multiple models and scenarios. The data is released under CC-BY-4.0 and is distributed for download via the Hugging Face Hub.

datasets.name: RSEdit Benchmark (Test Split)
datasets.summary: A test-split benchmark of bi-temporal remote-sensing image pairs with textual editing instructions for text-guided Earth-observation image editing.
datasets.description: The test split for RSEdit, a framework for text-guided image editing in the remote-sensing domain. It consists of bi-temporal remote-sensing image pairs and corresponding textual instructions used to evaluate instruction-following editors that simulate changes such as disasters, urban growth, and seasonal variation while preserving geospatial consistency. The underlying RSEdit data is built from over 60,000 bi-temporal image pairs.

datasets.name: Indonesian Wildfire Panel Dataset (AML Indo Fires)
datasets.summary: A spatiotemporal panel dataset of monthly fire activity across Sumatra and Kalimantan, Indonesia on a 0.25-degree grid (2012-2025).
datasets.description: A spatiotemporal panel dataset covering fire activity across Sumatra and Kalimantan, Indonesia, at monthly resolution on a 0.25-degree grid from January 2012 to December 2025. Each observation corresponds to one grid cell in one calendar month, combining NASA FIRMS VIIRS fire detections with land cover, peatland, and climate variables. It is built for machine-learning research into tropical wildfire prediction.

datasets.name: Liberia Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Liberia aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: A dataset of dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Liberia, computed from CHIRPS v2 satellite-plus-station precipitation imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts, aggregated by subnational administrative units. It is published by the WFP and sourced via HDX, providing rainfall totals and anomaly indicators per dekad for climate and food-security monitoring.

datasets.name: LandCover.ai Aerial Imagery for Semantic Segmentation
datasets.summary: An aerial-imagery semantic-segmentation dataset for automatic mapping of buildings, woodlands, water, and roads.
datasets.description: A semantic-segmentation dataset based on LandCover.ai for automatic mapping of buildings, woodlands, water, and roads from high-resolution aerial imagery. It provides aerial RGB tiles with pixel-level land-cover annotations across the four target classes. This Hugging Face release repackages the original LandCover.ai dataset for segmentation training.

datasets.name: Core-S2L2A-MMEarth
datasets.summary: A globally distributed dataset of MMEarth foundation-model embeddings computed over Sentinel-2 Level-2A imagery from the Major TOM Core-S2L2A grid.
datasets.description: Core-S2L2A-MMEarth is a Major TOM dataset providing MMEarth foundation-model embeddings derived from globally distributed Sentinel-2 (Level 2A) multispectral imagery. The Hugging Face release is a spatially pooled (about 10x reduced) version of the full embeddings due to storage constraints, with each sample reduced from a (320, 133, 133) tensor to a (320, 13, 13) pooled shape. Full-resolution embeddings are available via Creodias EODATA. Each record carries metadata such as a unique id linking it back to the Major TOM Core-S2L2A grid.

datasets.name: Pabna City Urban Tree AGB & Carbon Dataset
datasets.summary: Citywide above-ground biomass, carbon stock, and CO2-equivalent raster maps for urban trees in Pabna, Bangladesh derived from PlanetScope 8-band 3m imagery.
datasets.description: This dataset provides urban tree above-ground biomass (AGB), carbon stock, and CO2-equivalent maps for Pabna Municipality, Bangladesh, generated from PlanetScope 8-band 3m satellite imagery on January 12, 2026. The rasters are delivered as GeoTIFFs in EPSG:32645 (UTM Zone 45N) and include per-pixel AGB (Mg/ha), carbon stock (Mg/ha), and CO2-equivalent (Mg/ha) layers ready for use in QGIS, ArcGIS, or Python. It supports urban tree carbon mapping and biomass estimation research.

datasets.name: POA Precipitation Nowcasting
datasets.summary: A multimodal precipitation nowcasting dataset for Porto Alegre, Brazil combining GOES satellite channels with surface meteorological station measurements at 15-minute intervals.
datasets.description: POA Precipitation Nowcasting is a weather dataset for short-term rainfall prediction over Porto Alegre, Brazil, spanning 2017-2021. It integrates 16-channel GOES geostationary satellite imagery with ground-based meteorological station observations including temperature, pressure, humidity, wind, and precipitation, recorded at 15-minute intervals. The data is organized into training, validation, and test splits for nowcasting model development.

datasets.name: Earth Surface Water Dataset (Sentinel-2)
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 surface water segmentation dataset of multi-band scenes paired with binary water masks for training water-detection models.
datasets.description: The Earth Surface Water Dataset is a Sentinel-2 segmentation dataset for detecting surface water from satellite imagery. It contains 64 training and 31 validation Sentinel-2 scenes provided as 6-band uint16 GeoTIFFs, each paired with a binary water/no-water ground-truth mask (uint8 GeoTIFF). It is intended for training and evaluating deep learning models for water-body extraction.

datasets.name: Eswatini Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Eswatini aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset, published by the World Food Programme via HDX, contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Eswatini aggregated by subnational administrative units. The indicators are computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite-plus-station precipitation estimates and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts. It supports drought monitoring, food security analysis, and climate risk assessment at the subnational scale.

datasets.name: MGRS-200k
datasets.summary: The first multi-granularity remote sensing image-text dataset, providing object-level textual supervision for fine-grained region-category alignment.
datasets.description: MGRS-200k is a multi-granularity remote sensing (RS) image-text dataset introduced with the paper FarSLIP, designed to address the limited spatial awareness of existing RS vision-language datasets. It pairs remote sensing images with both short global-level captions and object-level category annotations to enable fine-grained region-category alignment. The dataset supports open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, zero-shot classification, and image-text retrieval.

datasets.name: geoai-cogs
datasets.summary: A small collection of geospatial cloud-optimized GeoTIFF (COG) imagery hosted as an image folder.
datasets.description: geoai-cogs is a small geospatial imagery dataset distributed in image-folder format, with its name referencing cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) commonly used in remote sensing. It contains a small set of geographic image samples and is intended for GeoAI and geospatial machine-learning experimentation. The dataset card is minimal, so detailed metadata on region and exact content is limited.

datasets.name: WaterBench
datasets.summary: A benchmark for evaluating geospatial foundation models on coastal and marine tasks using Sentinel-1/2/3 radar and optical satellite imagery.
datasets.description: WaterBench is a benchmark and evaluation protocol for assessing geospatial foundation models (GFMs) on high-resolution radar and optical satellite imagery for coastal and marine applications. It draws on Sentinel-1 SAR (VV/VH), Sentinel-2 optical (12 bands at 10m), and Sentinel-3 OLCI (16 bands at 300m) data across two task families: image-level regression/classification (e.g., ocean state, bathymetry via GEBCO, oil-slick detection) and pixel-level segmentation (e.g., coral reefs, seagrass meadows, mangroves). The full benchmark spans roughly 175 GB across 44 archives.

datasets.name: Pre-Landslide Risk Assessment 2024 Blind Test
datasets.summary: A blind-test set of Sentinel-2 spectral composites for evaluating vision-language models on pre-landslide risk detection over 2024 Italian landslide events.
datasets.description: This dataset is a blind-test set for evaluating vision-language-model-based pre-landslide risk detection on 2024 Italian landslide events. It contains 29 events from January-December 2024, each represented by 6 spectral composites generated from Sentinel-2 L2A imagery (RGB, SWIR, NIR, and various vegetation and moisture indices) at 512x512 resolution in PNG and JSON formats. It contains no ground-truth labels by design, intended for evaluating model predictions against future landslide occurrences.

datasets.name: NWM Hydrology ML Benchmark (Zarr)
datasets.summary: A streamflow and precipitation machine-learning benchmark derived from the NOAA National Water Model Retrospective v2.1 reanalysis, delivered as Zarr.
datasets.description: This benchmark is derived from the NOAA National Water Model (NWM) Retrospective v2.1 data hosted on AWS Open Data and is delivered in Zarr format. It pairs CHRTOUT streamflow (m3/s) at basin-outlet reaches with RAINRATE precipitation forcing (mm/hr) sampled at the nearest grid points, supporting hydrological time-series modeling. It is intended as a machine-learning benchmark for streamflow forecasting from precipitation inputs.

datasets.name: RS-DATASET
datasets.summary: A large-scale remote-sensing land-cover dataset of 512x512 satellite/aerial image tiles in WebDataset format.
datasets.description: RS-DATASET is an Earth-observation collection of land-cover imagery, primarily drawn from the DGLandCover collection, organized by geographic identifiers. Images are 512x512 PNG tiles distributed in WebDataset (tar.gz) shards and auto-converted to Parquet for access. The dataset totals roughly 220 GB and is intended for land-cover mapping and remote-sensing machine-learning tasks.

datasets.name: landslide-prevention-italy
datasets.summary: A multi-image vision-language dataset for pre-landslide risk assessment from Sentinel-2 imagery over Italy.
datasets.description: This dataset supports vision-language fine-tuning for predicting pre-landslide risk from Sentinel-2 spectral composites. Each sample contains six 512x512 images (one RGB plus five spectral indices) paired with a structured JSON assessment of slope hazard, human-impact exposure, and pixel-level areas-of-interest where future failure is most likely. It was generated for fine-tuning the LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M model.

datasets.name: eurosat-embed
datasets.summary: A processed version of the EuroSAT satellite land-use dataset with precomputed image embeddings.
datasets.description: EuroSAT-Embed provides EuroSAT Sentinel-2 satellite imagery for land-use and land-cover classification together with precomputed embeddings for efficient downstream use. It contains 54,000 samples split into 32,400 training, 10,800 validation, and 10,800 test rows. Imagery is provided in JPG format with filenames indicating land-use categories such as PermanentCrop.

datasets.name: geo_viewer_tropomi_locations
datasets.summary: A geospatial dataset of TROPOMI atmospheric-monitoring satellite observation locations and imagery.
datasets.description: This dataset contains geographic data and imagery related to TROPOMI (Tropospheric Monitoring Instrument) satellite observations, which measure air quality and atmospheric parameters from space. It is organized as an ImageFolder with 378 rows totaling roughly 4.3 GB and is intended for geospatial visualization and analysis of TROPOMI measurement locations.

datasets.name: vhr-building-segmentation
datasets.summary: A very-high-resolution aerial imagery dataset for building footprint segmentation built from HOT and OpenStreetMap data.
datasets.description: This semantic segmentation dataset supports building footprint extraction from very-high-resolution aerial imagery. It pairs 256x256 aerial image tiles (zoom level 19) from OpenAerialMap with building footprint labels from OpenStreetMap, sourced from validated Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) Tasking Manager projects. All source projects have been fully validated through the HOT workflow.

datasets.name: SatCLIP S2-100K
datasets.summary: A dataset of 100,000 cloud-free multispectral Sentinel-2 images sampled globally for training location embeddings.
datasets.description: The S2-100K dataset contains 100,000 multispectral satellite images sampled approximately uniformly over landmass from Sentinel-2 via the Microsoft Planetary Computer, captured between January 2021 and May 2023 and including only cloud-free scenes. It was created for the SatCLIP work on global, general-purpose location embeddings, enabling contrastive training of image and location encoders. The dataset is available for research purposes only.

datasets.name: ClimateNet
datasets.summary: A climate Earth-observation dataset for detecting and segmenting extreme weather events such as tropical cyclones and atmospheric rivers.
datasets.description: ClimateNet is a climate dataset associated with expert-labeled extreme weather phenomena, including tropical cyclones and atmospheric rivers, for pixel-level detection and segmentation in climate model output. The Hugging Face release totals roughly 21.1 GB. It is intended for machine-learning-based climate analytics and extreme-event identification.

datasets.name: africa-cog-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for the Republic of the Congo aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for the Republic of the Congo, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) v2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: EarthVLSet
datasets.summary: A large-scale Earth vision-language dataset for remote-sensing understanding and generation tasks.
datasets.description: EarthVLSet is the dataset behind EarthVL, a progressive Earth vision-language understanding and generation framework for remote sensing. It supports vision-language tasks including question answering and segmentation over Earth-observation imagery, building on prior work such as EarthVQA and LoveDA. The project also includes a global-scale segmentation leaderboard (Global-LoveDA).

datasets.name: FireMPC (MPCFire)
datasets.summary: A pan-Canadian wildfire forecasting benchmark integrating 55 multimodal drivers at 1 km daily resolution from 2000 to 2025.
datasets.description: FireMPC is a pan-Canadian wildfire risk forecasting benchmark covering approximately one billion hectares across all fifteen Canadian terrestrial ecozones at 1 km daily resolution from 2000 to 2025. It integrates 55 drivers across fuel, terrain, anthropogenic, and meteorological families, derived from public sources including MODIS, ERA5-Land, ASTER, WorldPop, and OpenStreetMap. The release provides roughly 71,760 samples (~1.12 TB) in four pre-built caches using different negative-sampling strategies, with train (2000-2019), validation (2020-2022), and test (2023-2025) splits.

datasets.name: RS-Taxonomy Labels
datasets.summary: GSD-sensitive task taxonomy labels and inter-annotator agreement data for four public remote-sensing visual-question-answering benchmarks.
datasets.description: RS-Taxonomy provides per-task D / M1 / M2 taxonomy labels, inter-annotator agreement (IAA) data, and reproducibility artifacts for four public remote-sensing VQA benchmarks. The taxonomy partitions tasks via a single counterfactual: whether doubling the ground sample distance (GSD) would change the answer value (M1) or its semantic class (M2). It accompanies the paper 'Identifying the Measurement Gap in Remote Sensing VQA with a GSD-Sensitive Taxonomy'. The dataset supports analysis of how spatial resolution affects answerability in remote-sensing VQA.

datasets.name: Core-S1RTC-DeCUR
datasets.summary: A global collection of self-supervised DeCUR embeddings computed over Sentinel-1 RTC SAR imagery, organized on the Major TOM grid.
datasets.description: Core-S1RTC-DeCUR contains roughly 36.7 million general-purpose embeddings derived from Sentinel-1 Radiometrically Terrain Corrected (RTC) SAR imagery using a DeCUR self-supervised model. Each record carries a unique id, the raw embedding array, and Major TOM grid-cell coordinates linking it to a geographic location and acquisition time. The embeddings provide a compact, globally distributed representation of SAR observations for downstream Earth-observation tasks. It is part of the Major TOM family of embedding datasets.

datasets.name: Jasper Ridge
datasets.summary: A widely used hyperspectral image of the Jasper Ridge site for spectral unmixing and endmember extraction research.
datasets.description: Jasper Ridge is a popular hyperspectral dataset used across many unmixing studies (e.g. SS-NMF, DgS-NMF, RRLbS, L1-CENMF). The full image is 512 x 614 pixels with each pixel recorded across 224 channels spanning 380-2500 nm at up to 9.46 nm spectral resolution. Because the full scene is too complex for reliable ground truth, a 100 x 100-pixel subimage is commonly used, starting at the (105,269)-th pixel of the original, after removing noisy channels. It is a standard benchmark for hyperspectral spectral unmixing.

datasets.name: G-NAF 2022 (Geocoded National Address File)
datasets.summary: The Geoscape Geocoded National Address File for Australia, providing over 15 million geocoded physical address records.
datasets.description: The Geoscape G-NAF is Australia's authoritative geocoded address database, distilling more than 50 million contributed addresses into 15.4 million validated G-NAF addresses. Each record contains state, suburb, street, number and geocoded coordinates, built and maintained by Geoscape Australia from independently examined and validated government data. This 2022 release is a foundational geospatial reference dataset for geocoding, address matching, and location analytics across Australia.

datasets.name: KFGOD (KOMPSAT Fine-Grained Object Detection Dataset)
datasets.summary: A large-scale fine-grained object detection benchmark built from high-resolution KOMPSAT-3/3A satellite imagery.
datasets.description: KFGOD is a fine-grained object detection dataset built from high-resolution KOMPSAT-3 and KOMPSAT-3A satellite imagery at roughly 0.55-0.7 m GSD. It provides 33 fine-grained classes and around 882,399 annotated object instances, with annotations supplied as both oriented bounding boxes (OBB) and horizontal bounding boxes (HBB). It was designed as a homogeneous benchmark by using a single, consistent satellite source. The dataset targets fine-grained object detection in satellite remote-sensing imagery.

datasets.name: Landslide UAV-SAT
datasets.summary: A landslide segmentation dataset pairing UAV and satellite optical imagery with pixel-level binary landslide masks.
datasets.description: Landslide UAV-SAT provides georeferenced optical imagery of landslide-affected terrain captured from both UAV and satellite sources, paired with pixel-level binary annotation masks indicating landslide presence. It contains roughly 19,800 image tiles of 512 x 512 pixels split into training (12,600), validation (3,160) and test (3,950) sets, stored in Parquet format. The dataset supports development of computer vision models for automated landslide hazard identification and segmentation.

datasets.name: LandVote
datasets.summary: A GIS-enabled geospatial database of U.S. land conservation finance ballot measures, organized by jurisdiction.
datasets.description: LandVote is a comprehensive, GIS-enabled database of conservation finance ballot measures in the United States, originally developed by the Trust for Public Land and republished here by the Boettiger Lab. It catalogs conservation ballot measures by state, finance mechanism, and jurisdiction type, with spatial linkage to the relevant administrative units. The dataset enables geospatial analysis of conservation funding decisions across communities and over time.

datasets.name: Core-S2L1C-DeCUR
datasets.summary: A global collection of self-supervised DeCUR embeddings computed over Sentinel-2 Level-1C multispectral imagery, on the Major TOM grid.
datasets.description: Core-S2L1C-DeCUR contains roughly 56.1 million general-purpose embeddings derived from Sentinel-2 Level-1C multispectral imagery using a DeCUR self-supervised model, totaling about 342.7 GB. Each record carries a unique id, the raw embedding array, and Major TOM grid-cell coordinates linking it to a geographic location and acquisition time. The embeddings provide a compact, globally distributed representation of optical Earth observations for downstream tasks. It is part of the Major TOM family of embedding datasets.

datasets.name: Cuprite
datasets.summary: An AVIRIS hyperspectral reflectance image of the Cuprite mining district, a classic benchmark for mineral mapping and unmixing.
datasets.description: Cuprite is a hyperspectral dataset retrieved from the AVIRIS NASA archive, corresponding to the f970619t01p02_r02_sc03.a.rfl reflectance file. It captures the Cuprite mining district in Nevada, a well-studied site for mineral identification and spectral unmixing research. The data was originally collected and prepared by Manuel Grana, Miguel-Angel Veganzones and Borja Ayerdi. It is a standard hyperspectral benchmark for endmember extraction and mineral mapping.

datasets.name: Angola Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Angola aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Angola, computed from CHIRPS v2 satellite-and-station precipitation imagery together with CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts, aggregated by subnational administrative units. It is published by the World Food Programme via HDX. Indicators include rainfall totals and anomalies for each dekad. The dataset supports climate, drought, and food-security monitoring at the subnational level.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Arc of Deforestation CSV Data
datasets.summary: A tabular CSV dataset derived from Sentinel-2 imagery over the Brazilian Amazon "arc of deforestation" region.
datasets.description: This dataset provides tabular (CSV) data derived from Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite imagery covering the "arc of deforestation" region of the Amazon, where forest clearing is most concentrated. It is intended for monitoring and analyzing deforestation patterns from Earth-observation data. The release is a small CSV table suitable for tabular analysis and machine-learning experiments.

datasets.name: Satellite Multi-Task Omni Dataset
datasets.summary: A unified multi-task satellite/aerial imaging dataset converting 10 source datasets into a consistent ChatML image+text conversational format for omni-models.
datasets.description: Satellite Multi-Task Omni is a unified satellite and aerial imaging dataset designed for training omni-models that handle image and text as both input and output modalities. It aggregates 10 source datasets into a consistent ChatML conversational format, totaling 34,894 samples (31,404 train / 1,744 val / 1,746 test) across 9 distinct task types. Tasks span image classification, object detection, segmentation, region/image captioning, and visual question answering on remote-sensing imagery.
datasets.task: Multi-task vision-language (classification, detection, segmentation, VQA, captioning)

datasets.name: DurhamTrees (Durham Urban Canopy Analysis)
datasets.summary: A geospatial urban tree canopy dataset for Durham, NC combining the Trees & Planting Sites inventory with environmental data for canopy analysis.
datasets.description: DurhamTrees, from the Durham Urban Canopy Analysis and Enhancement Initiative (DUCAEI), is a geospatial dataset that unifies Durham, North Carolina's Trees & Planting Sites inventory with related environmental information for urban tree-canopy analysis. It supports identifying locations for canopy expansion, evaluating the impact of urban development on green spaces, and informing sustainable urban-forest planning. The data is provided in tabular/geospatial parquet form.
datasets.task: Token classification / table question answering (urban canopy analysis)

datasets.name: Foursquare OS Places 100M
datasets.summary: A full dump of the open-source Foursquare Places point-of-interest dataset (~100M global places) as a single geo-parquet file.
datasets.description: Foursquare OS Places 100M is a complete dump of the open-source Foursquare Places point-of-interest (POI) dataset, consolidated from the 81 individual parquet files into a single ~10 GB (geo-)parquet file for easy querying. It contains roughly 100 million global places with attributes and geographic coordinates, queryable via modern tools such as httpfs and DuckDB. It is well suited for geospatial feature extraction, place search, and location-based machine learning.

datasets.name: PANGAEA2-VHR
datasets.summary: An unofficial mirror collection of very-high-resolution remote-sensing benchmark datasets (PureForest, xView2, SpaceNet 3 Roads, GEO-Bench) for reproducible evaluation.
datasets.description: PANGAEA2-VHR is a curated mirror of several very-high-resolution (VHR) remote-sensing datasets bundled for hash-based versioning and reproducibility of foundation-model evaluation results. It aggregates datasets including PureForest, GEO-Bench (m-pv4ger), xView2 building-damage assessment, and SpaceNet 3 Roads. It supports image classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection benchmarking on aerial/satellite imagery; note this is an unofficial mirror, not the original source.

datasets.name: Remote Sensing Test Datasets
datasets.summary: A test/evaluation collection of remote-sensing imagery covering classification, detection, captioning, grounding, and visual question answering tasks.
datasets.description: Remote Sensing Test Datasets is an evaluation collection of remote-sensing imagery spanning multiple vision and vision-language tasks. It covers image classification (IC), object detection (OD), region captioning (RC), grounding description (GD), image captioning, and visual question answering (VQA). It is intended as a test bed for evaluating remote-sensing models across these task types.
datasets.task: Remote-sensing classification / detection / captioning / VQA (test set)

datasets.name: Global OpenStreetMap Extraction Slippy Tiles (tar)
datasets.summary: A global extraction of OpenStreetMap data organized as slippy map tiles packaged in WebDataset tar format.
datasets.description: This dataset is a global extraction of OpenStreetMap (OSM) data organized as slippy map tiles and packaged in WebDataset tar archives. It provides worldwide geographic map information suitable for geospatial machine learning, mapping, and location-based tasks. The tiles are delivered in a streaming-friendly WebDataset format for efficient large-scale processing.

datasets.name: Jena Climate
datasets.summary: A meteorological time-series dataset of 10-minute-interval weather measurements recorded at Jena, Germany from 2009 onward.
datasets.description: Jena Climate is a weather time-series dataset containing 10-minute-interval meteorological measurements recorded at the Max Planck Institute weather station in Jena, Germany, starting January 1, 2009. It comprises 420,551 records with variables including atmospheric pressure, air temperature, dew point, relative humidity, vapor pressure, specific humidity, air density, wind velocity, and wind direction. It is widely used for weather forecasting and time-series modeling.

datasets.name: GPSBench
datasets.summary: A benchmark of 57,800 samples across 17 tasks for evaluating geospatial reasoning over GPS coordinates in large language models.
datasets.description: GPSBench is a geospatial reasoning benchmark dataset of 57,800 samples across 17 tasks designed to evaluate how well large language models understand GPS coordinates. It is organized into a Pure GPS track (coordinate manipulation such as format conversion, distance, bearing, area, interpolation, and bounding boxes) and an Applied track (real-world geographic reasoning such as place association, terrain classification, proximity, and spatial patterns). Data is provided in JSON with train/dev/test splits.

datasets.name: STARCOP-fast-products
datasets.summary: Curated hyperspectral data products for onboard satellite methane-plume detection, generated from 72 channels in the 2122-2488 nm range.
datasets.description: STARCOP-fast-products hosts curated hyperspectral data products used for training and evaluating methane-detection models in the paper "Optimizing Methane Detection Onboard Satellites: Speed, Accuracy, and Low-Power Solutions for Resource-Constrained Hardware." The products are generated exclusively from 72 hyperspectral channels in the 2122-2488 nm shortwave-infrared range, where methane absorption features appear. It is intended for image segmentation of methane plumes for climate and emissions monitoring on resource-constrained onboard hardware.

datasets.name: Climate Data (NDSI Snow Index)
datasets.summary: A satellite-derived Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) dataset of 750x750 monthly snow-cover image arrays from 2005 onward.
datasets.description: This climate dataset contains satellite-derived Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) data measuring snow and ice cover. Records are organized by year and month, each containing a 750x750 pixel NDSI array derived from satellite imagery, spanning from 2005 onward. It is suitable for snow-cover monitoring and climate/cryosphere analysis from Earth-observation data.

datasets.name: Guinea-Bissau Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Guinea-Bissau aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset, published by the World Food Programme via HDX, contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Guinea-Bissau aggregated by subnational administrative units. The indicators are computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite-plus-station precipitation estimates and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It supports drought monitoring, food security, and climate-risk analysis at the subnational scale.

datasets.name: Morocco Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Morocco aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset, published by the World Food Programme via HDX, contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Morocco aggregated by subnational administrative units. The indicators are computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite-plus-station precipitation estimates and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It supports drought monitoring, food security, and climate-risk analysis at the subnational scale.

datasets.name: Amfitrite Inland Waters HAB Sentinel-2
datasets.summary: Multispectral Sentinel-2 image tiles of inland water bodies labeled by Harmful Algal Bloom (HAB) severity for environmental monitoring.
datasets.description: Amfitrite-Inland-Waters-HAB-Sentinel2 is a specialized dataset of multispectral Sentinel-2 satellite imagery tiles focused on inland water bodies, classified by the severity of Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs). It is designed to train deep-learning models (such as CNNs) for water-quality and environmental monitoring. The dataset supports detection and classification of harmful algal blooms from Earth-observation imagery.

datasets.name: SenseBench (subset)
datasets.summary: A remote sensing benchmark for evaluating low-level visual perception, image-quality assessment, and description in large vision-language models.
datasets.description: SenseBench is a remote sensing benchmark designed to test how well large vision-language models perceive and describe low-level visual properties of satellite and aerial imagery. Each example pairs a reference remote sensing image (and degraded variants exhibiting distortions such as clouds, compression, noise, stretching, and color shifts) with quality-related questions, supporting visual question answering and image classification tasks. This published subset contains roughly 1,000 image-question samples. It is intended for evaluating distortion identification and perceptual quality reasoning in remote sensing VLMs.

datasets.name: SpaceNet Rio de Janeiro (Building Detection)
datasets.summary: High-resolution satellite imagery of Rio de Janeiro with building-footprint annotations for semantic segmentation and footprint extraction.
datasets.description: This dataset packages the Rio de Janeiro portion of the SpaceNet Building Detection Challenge, containing high-resolution satellite imagery and corresponding building-footprint polygon annotations. It includes 6,940 image tiles delivered as 3-band (RGB) pan-sharpened GeoTIFFs along with 8-band multispectral options. The data is designed for training deep learning models for semantic/instance segmentation and automated building-footprint extraction. The dataset is roughly 8.45 GB in size.

datasets.name: Satellite-Detected Surface Water Extents, Region III, Philippines (Nov 2022)
datasets.summary: UNOSAT TerraSAR-X satellite-derived surface water (flood) extents across Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, and Tarlac provinces, Philippines, following a tropical cyclone.
datasets.description: This dataset maps the extent of surface waters observed across Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, and Tarlac provinces in Region III, Philippines, as of 3 November 2022, in the aftermath of tropical cyclone flooding. The water extents were derived from TerraSAR-X synthetic aperture radar imagery by the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT, code TC20221028PHL; GDACS Id 1000942). It provides vector flood-extent data suitable for disaster-response and surface-water analysis. The dataset was sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Moffett Field (AVIRIS Hyperspectral)
datasets.summary: An airborne hyperspectral AVIRIS image cube acquired over Moffett Field, California, on 20 August 1992.
datasets.description: This dataset is a hyperspectral 'image cube' from JPL's Airborne Visible/Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS), acquired on 20 August 1992 from a NASA ER-2 aircraft flying at 20,000 meters over Moffett Field at the southern end of San Francisco Bay, California. The data illustrates the volume of spectral information returned by the instrument, with a false-color top surface accentuating water structure and evaporation ponds. It is a classic reference scene used in hyperspectral imaging research.

datasets.name: Chikusei (Airborne Hyperspectral)
datasets.summary: An airborne hyperspectral dataset over agricultural and urban areas in Chikusei, Ibaraki, Japan, with 128 spectral bands.
datasets.description: The Chikusei dataset was captured by a Headwall Hyperspec-VNIR-C imaging sensor over agricultural and urban areas in Chikusei, Ibaraki, Japan, on 29 July 2014. It contains 128 spectral bands spanning 363 nm to 1018 nm, with a scene of 2517 x 2335 pixels at a ground sampling distance of 2.5 m. Ground-truth land-cover annotations accompany the imagery, making it a widely used benchmark for hyperspectral classification and unmixing.

datasets.name: Canada Geological Maps Collection
datasets.summary: A collection of Canadian geological and mineral-exploration maps drawn from GEOSCAN and the British Columbia MINFILE mineral inventory.
datasets.description: The Canada Geological Maps Collection is a dataset of Canadian geological and mineral-exploration maps assembled from two primary sources: GEOSCAN (Geological Survey of Canada) and MINFILE (British Columbia Mineral Inventory). It includes both historical and contemporary geological maps covering various provinces and territories across Canada. The dataset supports tasks such as image classification, object detection, and feature extraction for geoscience and mineral-exploration research.
datasets.task: Image classification / object detection / feature extraction

datasets.name: RESIDUALS - LiDAR DEM Residual Fingerprints
datasets.summary: 39,716 residual images derived from a LiDAR-based Digital Elevation Model of Fairfield County, Ohio, paired with their generating algorithm and parameters.
datasets.description: RESIDUALS is a dataset of 39,716 residual images produced by applying 593 distinct decomposition configurations across 25 upsampling methods to a single LiDAR-derived Digital Elevation Model of Fairfield County, Ohio (1500 x 375 at 3.33 ft/px). Each row pairs a 256 x 256 PNG of the residual (rendered with the RdBu_r colormap and 99th-percentile symmetric clipping) with the algorithm and parameters that produced it, plus a 40-dimensional signature vector and pre-computed 2D/3D projections. It is intended for studying terrain decomposition and DEM processing fingerprints.

datasets.name: Eritrea: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Eritrea aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Eritrea, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. The indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include measures such as 10-day rainfall totals and anomalies. Published by the World Food Programme (WFP) and sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), it supports drought and food-security monitoring.

datasets.name: HLS MERRA-2 GPP Flux
datasets.summary: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 imagery paired with MERRA-2 observations and eddy-covariance Gross Primary Productivity data for geospatial foundation-model fine-tuning.
datasets.description: This dataset combines Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) multispectral reflectance imagery with MERRA-2 atmospheric reanalysis observations centered around eddy-covariance flux towers, alongside the corresponding Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) measurements at those towers. It is designed to serve as a fine-tuning dataset for geospatial foundation models tasked with regressing GPP flux from HLS and MERRA-2 inputs. The data is structured as 6-band HLS GeoTIFFs paired with MERRA-2 records and tower GPP labels. It was produced by the IBM-NASA geospatial collaboration.

datasets.name: Global Streetscapes (Tabular/Parquet)
datasets.summary: The tabular portion of the Global Streetscapes dataset of crowdsourced and mapping-platform street-level imagery and contextual attributes.
datasets.description: This repository hosts the tabular portion of the Global Streetscapes dataset created by the Urban Analytics Lab (UAL) at the National University of Singapore. The full collection (62+ GB) includes 21 CSV files describing 346 unique features across roughly 10 million rows of street-level imagery metadata, plus manual contextual-attribute labels split into training and test sets. It supports tasks such as image classification, image segmentation, and image feature extraction for urban and street-level scene understanding.

datasets.name: Flood Susceptibility Map
datasets.summary: A geospatial cloud-optimized GeoTIFF raster of flood susceptibility used for flood hazard mapping.
datasets.description: Flood Susceptibility Map is a geospatial dataset distributed as a cloud-optimized GeoTIFF (COG) raster representing flood susceptibility across an area of interest. It is intended for flood hazard and risk mapping workflows in GIS tools such as QGIS, ArcGIS, or Python. The dataset card is minimal, so detailed metadata on the exact region and methodology is limited.

datasets.name: Wildfire Prediction
datasets.summary: A small multimodal dataset of RGB and SWIR satellite image patches across global regions for wildfire prediction.
datasets.description: Wildfire Prediction is a geospatial dataset pairing satellite-derived RGB and SWIR (short-wave infrared) image patches with tabular metadata for wildfire risk modeling. It covers multiple fire-prone regions worldwide (for example Alentejo, Portugal and Alpine Switzerland) with multi-scene, multi-timestep imagery. The dataset is delivered as Parquet tables alongside PNG image files and is intended for experimentation with wildfire prediction models.

datasets.name: Multimodal Monsoon Indian Dataset
datasets.summary: A high-resolution (about 1 km) multimodal Earth-observation dataset for monsoon precipitation classification across Indian states.
datasets.description: The Multimodal Monsoon Indian Dataset is a curated, high-resolution (about 1 km) Earth-observation dataset for monsoon precipitation classification and analysis across Indian states. It integrates satellite imagery, ERA5 climate reanalysis variables, and static geospatial features (LST, LULC, NDVI, relative humidity, soil moisture, wind speed) into a unified state-wise structure, with CHIRPS precipitation as ground truth. The data is organized per state as GeoTIFF rasters and is designed for multimodal deep learning and precipitation nowcasting.

datasets.name: OlmoEarth-v1-Potomac-Sewage-Spill-2026
datasets.summary: A validated, time-aligned reference dataset supporting GeoAI tracking of the 2026 Potomac River sewage spill with Sentinel-1/2 plume detection.
datasets.description: OlmoEarth-v1-Potomac-Sewage-Spill-2026 is a geospatial reference dataset supporting GeoAI tracking of the January 2026 Potomac River sewage spill near Glen Echo, Maryland. It provides an event timeline, hydrologic context, monitoring station locations, and area-of-interest corridor polygons to underpin downstream Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 plume detection with AI2's OlmoEarth-v1 model. It includes 8 USGS gauges with 846 daily flow records, 4 Chesapeake Bay Program/Foundation water-quality stations in the AOI, and NHD hydrography features, delivered as Parquet, CSV, and GeoJSON.

datasets.name: Street-Level Imagery Dataset (streetview)
datasets.summary: Metadata for over 900,000 geotagged street-level images across Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, with coordinates, orientation, and timestamps.
datasets.description: This dataset provides metadata for street-level imagery across Eastern Europe and Northern Asia. Each record includes image URLs, coordinates, camera orientation, timestamps, and links to similar images captured at the same location over time. It contains 934,191 total records covering 905,940 unique images spanning 2016-2025, delivered as Parquet shards, and is intended for geospatial mapping, image retrieval, and computer-vision research.

datasets.name: HSI Datasets Collection
datasets.summary: A curated collection of 24 publicly available hyperspectral image datasets bundled for land-use/land-cover and remote-sensing classification research.
datasets.description: HSI Datasets Collection is a curated bundle of 24 publicly available hyperspectral image (HSI) remote-sensing datasets for hyperspectral classification, land use/land cover (LULC) mapping, and deep-learning benchmarking. It packages well-known scenes such as Indian Pines, Botswana, Kennedy Space Center, Houston 2013/2018, Augsburg, Berlin, Chikusei, Dioni, Loukia, and MUUFL as MATLAB .mat data and ground-truth files. The total size is approximately 20.1 GB and the collection is intended as a one-stop resource for HSI remote-sensing experimentation.

datasets.name: OlmoEarth-v1-Chesapeake-Bay-Nutrient-Loads
datasets.summary: Annual and monthly water-quality nutrient and sediment loads at 121 USGS monitoring stations across the Chesapeake Bay watershed for GeoAI regression.
datasets.description: OlmoEarth-v1-Chesapeake-Bay-Nutrient-Loads provides annual and monthly water-quality loads (Total Nitrogen, Total Phosphorus, and Suspended Sediment) at 121 USGS Nontidal Network monitoring stations across the Chesapeake Bay watershed from 2014 to 2023. It is built for use with AI2's OlmoEarth-v1-Base remote-sensing embeddings plus classical regression, with optional fine-tuning via quantile-binned classes. It contains 14,166 monthly records and 1,208 annual records across 118 watershed polygons and 6 sub-basins, delivered as Parquet and GeoJSON.

datasets.name: Soybean Pest Resistance Orthomosaic Dataset
datasets.summary: UAV-derived orthomosaic plot imagery for soybean genotype performance analysis under contrasting pest-management conditions.
datasets.description: The Soybean Pest Resistance Orthomosaic Dataset supports UAV-based soybean genotype performance analysis under contrasting pest-management treatments (Controlled and NoControl). It contains orthomosaic-derived plot-level imagery for multi-temporal phenotyping across six time points, with georeferenced orthomosaics generated from raw UAV RGB imagery using WebODM. Plot boundaries and labels are provided as GeoPackage and PNG grids alongside GeoTIFF orthophotos, supporting high-throughput phenotyping and plant-breeding analysis.

datasets.name: Global Monthly VIIRS Nighttime Lights (1992-2024)
datasets.summary: A global nighttime-lights GeoTIFF archive spanning 1992-2024 for remote-sensing analysis of human activity and development.
datasets.description: This dataset packages global nighttime-lights imagery as GeoTIFF rasters spanning 1992 to 2024, organized into per-year archives with manifest and source metadata. Derived from VIIRS-era and harmonized nighttime-lights products, it is widely used as a remote-sensing proxy for urbanization, economic activity, electrification, and human settlement dynamics. It supports time-series forecasting and segmentation tasks over Earth-observation rasters.

datasets.name: Aerial Bird Detection (Nexus LA DevDays 2nd Place)
datasets.summary: An aerial and UAV/drone imagery dataset of top-down (nadir) views for detecting and classifying birds and nesting sites.
datasets.description: Aerial Bird Detection is an object-detection dataset of aerial, drone, helicopter, and UAV imagery captured from top-down (nadir) and ground-level perspectives, focused on birds and bird-nesting sites. The dataset was a second-place winner at the Nexus LA DevDays hackathon and is provided in YOLO format along with training run artifacts. It supports aerial wildlife detection and classification across many avian categories.

datasets.name: GeoChat_bench_split
datasets.summary: A curated subset of the GeoChat_Bench remote-sensing benchmark containing samples with multiple ground-truth bounding boxes for visual grounding in satellite imagery.
datasets.description: GeoChat_bench_split is a curated subset of the GeoChat_Bench benchmark (from the EarthDial dataset), specifically containing samples with multiple ground-truth bounding boxes. It totals 1,840 samples pairing RGB satellite imagery with text for visual grounding and object localization. It supports visual question answering and object-detection evaluation of vision-language models on remote-sensing imagery, delivered as Parquet shards.
datasets.task: Visual question answering / object detection (visual grounding)

datasets.name: SHAPEFILES (Pakistan Administrative Boundaries)
datasets.summary: A geospatial vector dataset of Pakistan administrative district boundary polygons.
datasets.description: This dataset provides administrative boundary geometries for districts of Pakistan, derived from shapefiles. Each record includes administrative identifiers (province, district, admin unit), geometric measurements (shape length and area), and polygon geometry coordinates. It is intended for mapping, geographic analysis, and administrative boundary visualization.

datasets.name: Landsat-8-Somalia-2013-2020
datasets.summary: A catalogued collection of Landsat-8 satellite imagery covering Somalia from 2013 to 2020.
datasets.description: Landsat-8-Somalia-2013-2020 is a collection of Landsat-8 satellite imagery covering Somalia over the 2013-2020 period. It provides multispectral Earth-observation data suitable for environmental monitoring, land-cover analysis, and time-series studies of the region.

datasets.name: remote-sensing-visual-instructions
datasets.summary: A visual instruction-tuning dataset for adapting multimodal LLMs to the remote-sensing domain.
datasets.description: This dataset contains remote-sensing visual instructions used for post-training multimodal large language models, introduced in the paper "On Domain-Specific Post-Training for Multimodal Large Language Models" (EMNLP 2025). The visual instruction tasks were synthesized from image-caption pairs drawn from remote-sensing datasets such as NWPU-Captions, RSICD, and RSITMD. It supports visual question answering and instruction following on satellite and aerial imagery.

datasets.name: RSTeller
datasets.summary: A large-scale remote-sensing image-caption dataset for vision-language pretraining.
datasets.description: RSTeller is a large-scale remote-sensing image captioning dataset designed for training and benchmarking vision-language models in the Earth-observation domain. It pairs satellite/aerial imagery with rich textual descriptions and contains on the order of millions of image-caption pairs. The dataset was introduced alongside a research paper, with generation workflow and metadata documented in its GitHub repository.

datasets.name: DynamicEarthNet-video
datasets.summary: A storage-efficient video re-packaging of the DynamicEarthNet daily PlanetFusion satellite image cubes.
datasets.description: DynamicEarthNet-video is a storage-efficient re-packaging of the original DynamicEarthNet collection, following the TACO specification. It covers seventy-five 1024x1024 px regions at roughly 3 m ground sample distance across the globe, sampled daily from 1 January 2018 to 31 December 2019. Each day is delivered as four-band PlanetFusion imagery compressed as video, supporting dense time-series Earth-observation tasks such as semantic change detection and land-cover analysis.
datasets.size: 75 regions of 1024x1024 px at ~3 m GSD, daily 2018-2019

datasets.name: EarthSynth-180K
datasets.summary: A multi-task, diffusion-based generative dataset for remote-sensing image synthesis and understanding.
datasets.description: EarthSynth-180K is a multi-task, conditional, diffusion-based generative dataset designed for remote-sensing image synthesis and understanding. It was introduced in the paper "EarthSynth: Generating Informative Earth Observation with Diffusion Models" (arXiv 2025). The dataset supports text-to-image generation, mask-conditioned synthesis, and multi-category augmentation for Earth-observation research.

datasets.name: FloodSimBench
datasets.summary: A high-resolution (1 m) physical flood inundation benchmark for AI surrogate modeling.
datasets.description: FloodSimBench is a standardized, high-resolution (1 m) benchmark dataset designed for urban flood inundation modeling. It bridges complex physical hydraulic modeling and deep-learning foundation models such as CNNs and Transformers. The dataset provides high-fidelity data for training and evaluating AI surrogate models for flood risk assessment and real-time inundation prediction, supporting image-segmentation and time-series-forecasting tasks.

datasets.name: HierGeo-Data
datasets.summary: A large-scale satellite image-caption dataset with geographically conditioned captions spanning 140 countries.
datasets.description: HierGeo-Data is a large-scale satellite image-caption dataset of 464,553 image-caption pairs spanning 140 countries and more than 2,000 distinct named locations. It was introduced as the training corpus for the HierGeo geographically conditioned retrieval framework. Unlike existing Earth-observation datasets that rely on short category labels or generic synthetic captions, HierGeo-Data captions incorporate geographic context and physical attributes for richer remote-sensing image understanding and retrieval.

datasets.name: MODIS Lake Powell Toy Dataset
datasets.summary: A small tabular dataset of MODIS surface reflectance bands and derived indices labeled for water/not-water classification over Lake Powell.
datasets.description: This dataset provides MODIS surface reflectance bands (b01-b07) together with calculated spectral indices and a binary water/not-water label. It is intended as a lightweight teaching and prototyping example for surface-water detection from MODIS satellite observations. Surface reflectance values range from -100 to 16000 across the included bands.

datasets.name: Geo_BeyondCaptioning
datasets.summary: A large multimodal dataset pairing bi-temporal satellite imagery with structured change-detection reasoning text.
datasets.description: Geo_BeyondCaptioning combines satellite observations across two temporal phases (T1 and T2) with structured model responses that follow a multi-step reasoning framework covering global perception, instance analysis, relational modeling, reasoning, future inference, and confidence scoring. Sample scenes span rural agricultural zones, peri-urban transitions, industrial complexes, and aquaculture areas. It is designed for image-text-to-text and text-generation tasks focused on geospatial change detection.

datasets.name: LakeIce
datasets.summary: A SAR satellite time-series dataset of lake-ice backscatter in Yukon, Canada for bedfast/floating ice classification.
datasets.description: LakeIce contains pixel-level synthetic aperture radar (SAR) backscatter time series extracted over three decades from the ERS-1/2, Radarsat, and Sentinel-1 satellites. Each univariate series spans ~161 daily time steps covering October to March, labeled into three classes (bedfast ice, floating ice, land). Pixel resolutions are a mixture of 12.5 m, 30 m, and 50 m. The dataset is part of the MONSTER time-series classification collection.
datasets.modality: Satellite imagery / SAR (radar backscatter time series)

datasets.name: Crop Burn Detection - Labeled (Sentinel-2, India)
datasets.summary: Labeled paired RGB + SWIR Sentinel-2 tiles across northern India for crop-residue burn detection.
datasets.description: This dataset provides paired RGB and SWIR Sentinel-2 satellite image tiles across agricultural districts of northern India, each with per-tile burn annotations. It covers the paddy (Oct-Nov 2025) and wheat (Mar-May 2025) stubble-burning seasons across 68 districts. It was built to train and benchmark vision models for real-time crop residue burn detection. An unlabeled raw version is available as munish0838/crop-burn-detection-raw.

datasets.name: Starlink Ground Stations & Points of Presence
datasets.summary: A geospatial tabular dataset of Starlink gateway earth stations and internet Points of Presence with coordinates.
datasets.description: This dataset catalogs Starlink ground infrastructure, including 303 gateway earth stations (250 operational, 53 planned) and 14 internet Points of Presence across 9 countries. Records include location names, WGS-84 latitude/longitude coordinates, operational status, and DNS/country codes. Data is sourced from Starlink Insider, FCC IBFS filings, and OpenStreetMap geocoding, with global coverage from -53.2 to 70.3 degrees latitude.

datasets.name: Cote d'Ivoire: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Cote d'Ivoire aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite-and-station product, along with CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units of Cote d'Ivoire. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Africa Land Use 3-Class v1
datasets.summary: A POI-based global land-use classification dataset labeling areas as residential, non-residential, or open space at 500 m resolution.
datasets.description: This POI-based land-use dataset was generated and shared by the Geospatial Science and Human Security Division at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (MapSpace). It classifies land use into three classes: residential, non-residential, and open space. The dataset has a spatial resolution of 500 meters and covers all countries and regions of the world except the US and Greenland.

datasets.name: b-IAILD
datasets.summary: A bi-temporal extension of the Inria Aerial Image Labeling Dataset for building change detection.
datasets.description: b-IAILD is a temporal extension of the IAILD (Inria Aerial Image Labeling Dataset) focused on building change detection in urban areas. It provides bi-temporal orthoimage pairs with binary building-footprint annotations, covering locations in the USA and Austria. The dataset supports building change detection via weak temporal supervision.

datasets.name: PovertyMap (WILDS)
datasets.summary: Multispectral satellite imagery with survey-derived asset wealth indices for poverty estimation across African villages.
datasets.description: PovertyMap-WILDS assembles satellite imagery and Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) data at 19,669 villages across 23 African countries from 2009 to 2016. Each input is a multispectral LandSat image with 8 channels (7 LandSat bands plus a nighttime-light channel), resized to 224x224, and the target is a real-valued asset wealth index. It is a benchmark for evaluating geographic distribution shift in poverty estimation from satellite imagery.

datasets.name: Changen2-S9-27k
datasets.summary: An urban land-use/land-cover change dataset with 27k high-resolution image pairs and 38 change types.
datasets.description: Changen2-S9-27k is an urban land-use/land-cover change dataset containing roughly 27,000 image pairs spanning 38 change types at 0.25-0.5 m spatial resolution with RGB bands. Segmentation masks follow the OpenEarthMap class scheme (background, bareland, rangeland, developed space, road, tree, water, agriculture land, building). It is associated with the pytorch-change-models repository and the Changen2 generative change-modeling work.

datasets.name: CityShiftBench Scale-122
datasets.summary: An OSM-derived tabular benchmark for low-shot cross-city urban regression of road and connectivity targets under strict city isolation.
datasets.description: CityShiftBench Scale-122 is a benchmark for low-shot cross-city urban regression under strict city isolation. The active surface contains 118 OSM-integrity-passing cities and 8,359 tile records, with paper-core targets being OSM-derived road segments and intersection (connectivity) nodes. It provides tile-level targets, city descriptors, and split registries (shots of 0, 1, 5, 10, 20) for transfer-learning evaluation, released as a NeurIPS 2026 datasets review artifact.

datasets.name: Ship Detection Roboflow 2024-2025
datasets.summary: A collection of remotely sensed scenes annotated with ships for remote-sensing ship detection.
datasets.description: This dataset is a collection of remotely sensed scenes containing ships, assembled for a ship-detection remote-sensing project at Grenoble-INP ENSE3 (2024/2025). The images were originally collected on Roboflow. The related project archive is hosted on the Universite Grenoble Alpes GitLab.

datasets.name: CityPOIs
datasets.summary: A geospatial dataset combining European city tourism statistics with OpenStreetMap points-of-interest geometries for location-based recommendation.
datasets.description: CityPOIs is a geospatial dataset pairing city-level tourism metrics (tourist counts, overnight stays, museum visitors, OSM IDs) with OpenStreetMap polygon/multipolygon geometries and point-of-interest fields such as name, tourism type, phone, and opening hours. It covers numerous European cities including Setubal, Perugia, Halle an der Saale, Debrecen, and Malaga. It is intended for location-based and tourism recommendation tasks.

datasets.name: Pollution 2024-2025 (Sentinel-5P TROPOMI)
datasets.summary: A collection of Sentinel-5P TROPOMI atmospheric pollution acquisitions (CO, NO2) over Canada and Paris collected for a remote sensing course at Grenoble-INP.
datasets.description: This dataset contains Sentinel-5P satellite acquisitions from the TROPOMI sensor, gathered for a pollution-monitoring project in the remote sensing course at ENSE3, Grenoble-INP during the 2024/2025 academic year. It includes carbon monoxide (CO) acquisitions over Canada (May 2025) and Paris (May 2025) plus additional random CO scenes, as well as nitrogen dioxide (NO2) acquisitions over Paris. It supports atmospheric pollution monitoring and trace-gas remote sensing experiments.

datasets.name: MusselGooseneckSeg
datasets.summary: A high-resolution drone imagery dataset for semantic segmentation of mussel and gooseneck barnacle habitat in rocky intertidal zones.
datasets.description: MusselGooseneckSeg is a semantic segmentation dataset for rocky intertidal mussel and gooseneck barnacle habitat, built from high-resolution drone imagery collected by the Hakai Institute. It provides pixel-wise annotations distinguishing mussels and gooseneck barnacles in coastal intertidal scenes. The data is released in RGB tiles (640x640 and 1024x1024 variants) for training and evaluating habitat segmentation models.

datasets.name: Samson (Hyperspectral)
datasets.summary: A classic hyperspectral image dataset widely used for spectral unmixing, providing 156 spectral bands over a 95x95 pixel scene.
datasets.description: Samson is a standard hyperspectral remote-sensing image used as a benchmark for spectral unmixing. Each pixel is recorded across 156 spectral channels covering wavelengths from 401 nm to 889 nm at a spectral resolution of about 3.13 nm. To reduce computational cost, a 95x95-pixel region (starting at pixel (252,332) of the original 952x952 image) is commonly used, and the data is not degraded by blank or noisy channels. It is widely used for evaluating endmember extraction and abundance estimation methods.

datasets.name: EO4WildFires
datasets.summary: A multimodal wildfire dataset integrating Sentinel-2 multispectral, Sentinel-1 SAR, and NASA POWER meteorological data annotated with EFFIS, covering over 31,000 wildfire events across 45 countries.
datasets.description: EO4WildFires is a multimodal Earth-observation dataset for wildfire analysis that combines Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, Sentinel-1 SAR data, and NASA POWER meteorological variables, annotated using EFFIS fire data. It covers 45 countries and includes 31,730 wildfire events spanning 2018 to 2022. It supports tasks such as burned-area segmentation, classification, object detection, and time-series forecasting of fire behavior.

datasets.name: UC Merced LandUse MultiLabel
datasets.summary: A multi-label version of the UC Merced Land Use aerial imagery dataset for multi-label land-use classification and retrieval.
datasets.description: UC Merced LandUse MultiLabel is a multi-label re-annotation of the well-known UC Merced Land Use dataset, which consists of high-resolution aerial RGB image tiles extracted from USGS National Map imagery. Whereas the original dataset assigns a single land-use class per image, this version provides multiple object/land-cover labels per image to support multi-label classification and image retrieval. It builds on the bag-of-visual-words land-use work and the semisupervised graph-theoretic multilabel retrieval annotations.
datasets.license: other (USGS National Geospatial Program, public domain imagery)

datasets.name: Somalia Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived satellite rainfall indicators for Somalia aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: Published by the World Food Programme via HDX, this dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Somalia aggregated by subnational administrative units. The indicators are computed from Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It supports drought monitoring, food security, and climate-risk analysis at the subnational scale.

datasets.name: MapEval-API
datasets.summary: A geospatial map-based question-answering benchmark built with MapQaTor to evaluate models on real-world map and location reasoning via map API data.
datasets.description: MapEval-API is a geospatial benchmark for evaluating foundation models on map-based question answering, constructed using the MapQaTor tool over real-world map/location API data. Each example is a multiple-choice question requiring reasoning over geographic places, points of interest, and spatial relationships. It is part of the broader MapEval suite for assessing geospatial reasoning capabilities of large models.

datasets.name: RSFaith-Bench
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing vision-language benchmark for grounded visual reasoning, covering perception, relational, and temporal reasoning over satellite/aerial imagery.
datasets.description: RSFaith-Bench is a remote-sensing vision-language benchmark designed to evaluate grounded visual reasoning beyond surface-level object recognition. It spans perception, relational reasoning, and temporal reasoning over remote-sensing imagery, with each example formulated as a multiple-choice question paired with a compact scene graph, supporting evidence, and an executable reasoning program. The release contains 13,511 question-answer records over 16,288 images.

datasets.name: Uni10K
datasets.summary: An aerial and aerial-to-ground imagery dataset for ultra-large-scale 3D reconstruction, multi-view stereo, and structure-from-motion.
datasets.description: Uni10K is an aerial-imagery dataset released with the paper 'A LoD of Gaussians: Unified Training and Rendering for Ultra-Large-Scale Reconstruction with External Memory.' It provides aerial and aerial-to-ground imagery intended for ultra-large-scale 3D scene reconstruction, supporting tasks such as image-to-3D, depth estimation, multi-view stereo, and structure-from-motion (SfM). The data is distributed in WebDataset format.

datasets.name: Wildfire Global
datasets.summary: A geographically balanced Sentinel-2 wildfire dataset of paired pre/post-fire RGB chips with dNBR ground truth for benchmarking vision-language models on burn-severity estimation.
datasets.description: Wildfire Global is a geographically balanced dataset of wildfire events captured with Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, designed to benchmark vision-language models on wildfire detection and burn-severity estimation across diverse global regions. Each sample pairs a pre-fire and post-fire RGB chip (224x224 px at 10 m GSD) with continuous dNBR ground truth derived from Sentinel-2 NIR/SWIR bands. It targets image classification and visual question answering with an emphasis on geographic bias evaluation.

datasets.name: FISK_KV_ZON_SHP
datasets.summary: A small geospatial shapefile dataset of Latvian geographic zone features distributed in Esri shapefile / ArcGIS format.
datasets.description: FISK_KV_ZON_SHP is a compact vector geospatial dataset containing geographic feature (zone) data with ArcGIS-format XML metadata and Latvian-language attributes. The original Esri shapefile data has been auto-converted to Parquet on the Hugging Face Hub for easier access. It is a small reference dataset comprising a handful of vector feature records.

datasets.name: Ships in Satellite Imagery
datasets.summary: A satellite imagery classification dataset of image chips labeled as ship or no-ship, extracted from PlanetScope imagery over the San Francisco Bay and San Pedro Bay areas.
datasets.description: Ships in Satellite Imagery is an image classification benchmark of small RGB chips cropped from PlanetScope satellite scenes. Each chip is labeled to indicate whether it contains a ship, supporting automated detection of vessels in port and coastal regions. The dataset was originally published on Kaggle by Robert Hammell and mirrored to the Hugging Face Hub.

datasets.name: MusselSeg (mussel-seg-1024-1024)
datasets.summary: A large-scale semantic segmentation dataset of high-resolution drone imagery with pixel-wise annotations of rocky intertidal mussel beds.
datasets.description: MusselSeg is a semantic segmentation dataset for mapping mussel habitat using high-resolution drone (aerial) imagery, tiled to 1024x1024. It covers coastal mussel habitat on the central coast of British Columbia, Canada, with additional areas in California, USA, and provides pixel-wise annotations of mussel beds. Imagery was collected by the Hakai Institute and the University of California Santa Cruz to support intertidal ecology and coastal habitat monitoring.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMaps (open2roam)
datasets.summary: A geospatial dataset derived from OpenStreetMap containing vector map features with their associated key-value tag attributes.
datasets.description: This dataset packages OpenStreetMap (OSM) vector geographic data on the Hugging Face Hub, with features carrying their OSM tag key-value attribute maps. It is distributed in Parquet format and totals roughly 9.74 GB. The data is released under the Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL), consistent with OpenStreetMap source data.

datasets.name: EFFIS Wildfire (Sentinel-2)
datasets.summary: A dataset of Sentinel-2 satellite imagery of European wildfire events drawn from the European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS).
datasets.description: effis-wildfire contains Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite imagery associated with fire events catalogued by the European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS). The dataset is intended to support wildfire detection, burned-area mapping, and related remote-sensing research. It pairs EFFIS fire event records with the corresponding Sentinel-2 image acquisitions.

datasets.name: Greater Sydney Trees and Buildings
datasets.summary: A geospatial dataset of building footprints and tree-canopy patches for the Greater Sydney region derived from aerial imagery.
