datasets.description: The Greater Sydney Trees and Buildings dataset provides building footprint polygons and tree-canopy patch annotations over the Greater Sydney region, derived from high-resolution aerial imagery. It supports semantic segmentation and footprint extraction tasks for urban mapping. The data can be explored interactively as PMTiles map layers and was produced using the AIGIS annotation/segmentation tooling.

datasets.name: Glacier Scopes Segmentation (scopes)
datasets.summary: An image segmentation dataset of glacier imagery paired with segmentation masks for delineating glacial features.
datasets.description: The Glacier Scopes Segmentation dataset provides paired images and pixel-wise segmentation masks for identifying and delineating glacial features. It contains roughly 36,900 samples (about 35,100 training and 1,850 test) at 400px width, supporting training of glacier-boundary detection models. Imagery derives from expedition reel-based footage collected during glacier surveys.

datasets.name: Sentinel-3 SAR Altimetry Lakes
datasets.summary: A geospatial dataset of Sentinel-3 SAR radar altimetry measurements over inland lakes for water-level monitoring.
datasets.description: sentinel3-sar-altimetry-lakes is a catalogued dataset of Sentinel-3 SAR Radar Altimeter (SRAL) measurements acquired over inland lakes. It is intended to support hydrology and water-level / surface-height estimation from satellite radar altimetry. The data is hosted on the Hugging Face Hub.

datasets.name: EuroSAT (Lance Format)
datasets.summary: A Lance-formatted version of the EuroSAT Sentinel-2 RGB land-cover classification benchmark with inline images and OpenCLIP embeddings.
datasets.description: eurosat-lance is a Lance-formatted repackaging of EuroSAT, the canonical Sentinel-2 RGB land-cover classification benchmark, sourced from blanchon/EuroSAT_RGB. Each row holds a single 64x64 RGB tile with its integer class id, human-readable class name, and a cosine-normalized OpenCLIP image embedding, all stored inline (JPEG bytes) with no sidecar TIF folders. The format enables direct streaming access from the Hub for land-cover classification and embedding-based retrieval.

datasets.name: Malawi Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: A climate dataset of dekadal rainfall indicators for Malawi derived from CHIRPS satellite-plus-station precipitation data, aggregated by subnational administrative unit.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Malawi, computed from Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall totals and related precipitation metrics. The dataset is published by the WFP World Food Programme via HDX to support drought and food-security monitoring.

datasets.name: Remote Sensing Change Detection Dataset
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing change-detection dataset of registered and aligned image groups with change annotations.
datasets.description: This dataset is built for remote sensing change-detection research and includes a complete image-processing pipeline with annotation information. It contains 24 groups of registered and aligned remote-sensing image samples, with each group holding five different image file types plus corresponding annotation files. The dataset is documented in both English and Chinese.

datasets.name: DesignEarth
datasets.summary: A large-scale multimodal dataset of georeferenced high-resolution aerial images with condition images and semantic text descriptions for controllable aerial image generation.
datasets.description: DesignEarth is a multimodal dataset for controllable aerial image generation, providing 265,247 georeferenced high-resolution (1.2 m) aerial images. It pairs these with 1,060,988 corresponding condition images (four condition types per aerial image) and 530,494 semantic text descriptions totaling more than 38.4M tokens. The dataset targets text- and condition-driven generative modeling of aerial imagery.

datasets.name: IOAI 2025 At-Home Satellite Images (GOES-16 ABI)
datasets.summary: A multi-spectral GOES-16 ABI satellite image dataset with labels, provided at 128x128 and 256x256 resolutions for the IOAI 2025 at-home challenge.
datasets.description: ioai2025-athome-satellite-images is a satellite image dataset built from GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) multi-spectral imagery, with each image containing 16 spectral channels and corresponding labels. It provides training and test splits at two resolutions, 128x128 and 256x256, for image segmentation tasks. The underlying data is sourced from NOAA and NESDIS.

datasets.name: East Africa CHIRPS Seasonal Rainfall Accumulation Anomaly by Pentad
datasets.summary: A climate dataset of CHIRPS seasonal rainfall accumulation anomalies for East Africa computed by pentad for drought and trend monitoring.
datasets.description: This dataset provides CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) seasonal rainfall accumulation anomalies for East Africa, reported by pentad (5-day periods). CHIRPS is a 35+ year quasi-global gridded rainfall time series spanning 50S-50N across all longitudes from 1981 to near-present, used for trend analysis and seasonal drought monitoring. The anomaly values represent departures of seasonal rainfall accumulation from the long-term baseline, published via HDX.

datasets.name: BigEarthNetV2-Lithuania-Summer-LMDB
datasets.summary: A Lithuania-summer subset of the BigEarthNet v2 (reBEN) Sentinel multispectral land-cover classification dataset, pre-converted to LMDB.
datasets.description: This dataset is a regional subset of BigEarthNet v2 (reBEN), the refined and updated version of the BigEarthNet multi-label land-cover classification benchmark built from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery. It isolates patches covering Lithuania during the summer season and packages them in LMDB format for fast loading during model training. It is intended for multi-label remote-sensing image classification.

datasets.name: Africa Synth Climate Urban Heat Island Mapping
datasets.summary: A synthetic dataset of urban heat island characteristics across 20 major African cities for urban climate planning and heat-risk assessment.
datasets.description: This is a synthetic climate dataset of urban heat island (UHI) characteristics across 20 major African cities, with spatially distributed sampling across urban-rural gradients and three climate scenarios. It includes geospatial and tabular variables such as surface temperature, heat vulnerability indices, NDVI vegetation data, building characteristics, and population exposure metrics. The data is parameterized from published Sub-Saharan African literature rather than real observations, and is intended for urban climate planning, heat-risk assessment, and adaptation research rather than empirical analysis.

datasets.name: AerialExtreMatch-Localization
datasets.summary: The localization split of the AerialExtreMatch benchmark for extreme-view aerial image matching and localization.
datasets.description: This is the localization set accompanying the AerialExtreMatch benchmark for extreme-view image matching and localization. It provides two different-quality reference maps (high-quality and low-quality GeoTIFF) and 264 query images for evaluating aerial visual localization under large viewpoint changes. Companion train and benchmark splits are also released by the authors.

datasets.name: Global 70m Sea Level Rise Vulnerability Layer
datasets.summary: A planet-wide vector layer of all land at or below 70 meters elevation, representing the upper-bound envelope for long-term sea level rise.
datasets.description: This dataset is a global vector layer delineating all land at or below 70 meters elevation, the upper-bound geographic envelope for maximum-possible long-term sea level rise under multi-millennial-scale ice loss. It is distributed as a single PMTiles archive (world-70m.pmtiles) suitable for direct use in MapLibre GL, deck.gl, Leaflet, QGIS, and other modern geospatial tools that support HTTP range requests. It supports sea-level-rise visualization and coastal vulnerability analysis.

datasets.name: OSCD MSI
datasets.summary: The Onera Satellite Change Detection dataset of registered Sentinel-2 multispectral image pairs with binary change masks.
datasets.description: The Onera Satellite Change Detection (OSCD) dataset is a change-detection benchmark focused on multispectral images taken by the ESA Sentinel-2 satellite. It provides 24 registered image pairs from various continents captured between 2015 and 2018, along with binary change masks highlighting areas where changes have occurred. Pixel-level change ground truth is provided for 14 training and 10 test pairs. This is the multispectral (MSI) variant of the dataset.

datasets.name: USGS Significant Earthquakes
datasets.summary: A geospatial catalog of significant magnitude 4.5+ earthquakes across North America from 2000 to 2025, sourced from USGS.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 3,742 significant earthquakes (magnitude 4.5 and above) across North America between 2000 and 2025, derived from the USGS Earthquake Hazards Program. Minor tremors are filtered out to highlight earthquakes of scientific and public interest. Each record includes geospatial location and event attributes, intended for hazard analysis and feature-extraction tasks.

datasets.name: Aerial Zebra Herds (Ol Pejeta, Kenya)
datasets.summary: Aerial/UAV imagery of zebra herds captured over Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya, annotated for object detection.
datasets.description: This dataset contains aerial imagery of zebra herds captured by UAV over the Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya. The imagery is annotated with object-detection labels for individual animals, supporting wildlife monitoring and counting from the air. It is intended for training and evaluating aerial animal-detection models.

datasets.name: Gambia Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal satellite-derived rainfall indicators for The Gambia aggregated by subnational administrative units, from WFP/HDX.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for The Gambia, computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite precipitation imagery combined with in-situ station data and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include measures such as 10-day rainfall totals and anomalies. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: EO Crop Type Belgium
datasets.summary: A machine-learning-ready Sentinel-2 crop-type segmentation dataset covering most of Belgium at 10m resolution.
datasets.description: This Earth observation dataset provides ESA Sentinel-2 imagery at 10m ground sample distance with per-pixel crop-type segmentation labels covering the majority of Belgium. The spectral bands provided follow the ESA WorldCereal documentation (bands 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12), and each image is 256x256 pixels. It is intended for crop-type segmentation in agricultural remote sensing.

datasets.name: Sea-Undistort
datasets.summary: A synthetic dataset for through-water image restoration in high-resolution airborne bathymetry.
datasets.description: Sea-Undistort is a synthetic dataset for through-water image restoration in high-resolution airborne bathymetry. It contains 1,200 scenes, each with four 512x512 RGB images: ground/no water, undistorted/no waves, no sunglint, and distorted (all effects), plus structured per-image metadata describing camera, water, sky/illumination, and seafloor parameters. Images were procedurally rendered in Blender to emulate real airborne bathymetric capture, supporting research on correcting water-column and sunglint distortions in remote-sensing imagery.

datasets.name: Spatial-Reference-Grid (Major TOM)
datasets.summary: The Major TOM global spatial reference grid of about 5 million cells, distributed as GeoParquet and GeoPackage.
datasets.description: This dataset provides the Major TOM spatial reference grid as vector spatial data in both GeoParquet and GeoPackage formats. It is a global grid containing 5,091,140 cells, each described by metadata fields including the Major TOM cell identifier, grid row and column, the UTM CRS of the original product, and the centre latitude and longitude of the cell. It underpins the Major TOM family of large-scale Earth-observation datasets by providing a consistent global gridding system.

datasets.name: Dubai Aerial Semantic Segmentation
datasets.summary: Aerial imagery over Dubai, UAE, labeled for semantic segmentation into six land-cover classes.
datasets.description: This open-access dataset provides high-resolution aerial imagery captured over Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with pixel-level semantic segmentation annotations across six land-cover classes. It was produced by Humans in the Loop in collaboration with the Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC) to support urban analysis, environmental monitoring, and remote-sensing machine-learning research.

datasets.name: UNOSAT Vientiane Flood Water Extent (Sept 2024)
datasets.summary: Sentinel-1 derived satellite water-extent mapping of the September 2024 floods in Vientiane Capital, Lao PDR.
datasets.description: Produced by the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT, code FL20240913LAO), this dataset maps flood water extents in Vientiane Capital, Lao PDR using Sentinel-1 SAR imagery acquired on 13 September 2024. Within an analysed area of about 7,000 sq km, roughly 180 sq km of land was detected as flood-affected. It supports humanitarian flood-response and disaster monitoring.

datasets.name: Catasto GML (Italian Cadastral Data)
datasets.summary: Machine-readable Italian cadastral (land-registry) records structured hierarchically by region, province, and municipality.
datasets.description: Catasto GML is a geospatial cadastral dataset containing official Italian land-registry information organised by regions (regioni), provinces, and municipalities with their administrative codes and names. Distributed as JSON (auto-converted to Parquet) for use with pandas and Polars, it supports geospatial and administrative-boundary analysis of Italy.

datasets.name: CryoSentinel-GLOF v3
datasets.summary: Multimodal Earth-observation chips of glacial lakes across High Mountain Asia with water-extent segmentation masks.
datasets.description: CryoSentinel-GLOF v3 is a multimodal remote-sensing dataset of 42,237 image chips centred on glacial lakes across twelve High Mountain Asia sub-regions. Each chip co-registers Sentinel-1 SAR (VV, VH), Sentinel-2 optical (12 L2A bands), and a Copernicus DEM band, together with a binary water-extent mask derived from the Kumar & Vijay (2026) PANGAEA glacial-lake inventory. It is built for glacial-lake mapping and glacial-lake-outburst-flood (GLOF) hazard research.

datasets.name: Urbex Global Abandoned Locations
datasets.summary: A global geospatial dataset of about 101,000 abandoned and derelict locations sourced from OpenStreetMap.
datasets.description: Urbex is a geospatial dataset of roughly 101,000 abandoned and derelict locations worldwide, combining real places sourced from OpenStreetMap with geographic coordinates and KML/Google Earth-compatible records. Tagged as geospatial and provided as Parquet, it is intended for research and documentation of urban-exploration sites. The maintainers note that urban exploration can be illegal and dangerous and that the data is for research only.

datasets.name: Crop Burn Detection Raw (Sentinel-2 India)
datasets.summary: Paired RGB and SWIR Sentinel-2 tiles over northern India for detecting crop-residue burning.
datasets.description: Crop Burn Detection Raw provides paired RGB and SWIR Sentinel-2 satellite image tiles across agricultural districts of northern India (Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan), capturing the paddy (Oct-Nov 2025) and wheat (Mar-May 2025) crop-burning seasons. It is built to train and benchmark vision models for real-time crop-residue burn detection, including models intended to run directly on satellites.

datasets.name: CMEZ S-P High-Resolution Earthquake Catalog
datasets.summary: A high-resolution relocated earthquake catalog for the Culberson-Mentone Earthquake Zone in the Delaware Basin, Texas.
datasets.description: The CMEZ-SPHighResCatalog is a geophysical earthquake catalog for the Culberson-Mentone Earthquake Zone (CMEZ) in the Delaware Basin, West Texas, an area of induced seismicity. It provides high-resolution earthquake hypocenter depths relocated using the S-P (S-minus-P) travel-time method, including original and relocated depths and basement-depth references. It accompanies a Seismological Research Letters (SRL) publication.

datasets.name: Deforestation Amazon (Sentinel-2)
datasets.summary: A time series of Sentinel-2 satellite acquisitions over an area of interest in the Amazon forest captured at different times of the year.
datasets.description: This dataset contains a multi-temporal collection of imagery from the Sentinel-2 satellite platform covering an area of interest in the Amazon rainforest. The acquisitions are taken at different times of the year, supporting analysis of seasonal change and deforestation monitoring. It was produced as part of a remote-sensing student project at Grenoble INP / Universite Grenoble Alpes.

datasets.name: Prague REALMAP Demo
datasets.summary: A demo subset of georeferenced street-level panoramic imagery captured in Prague with a synchronized multi-camera rig.
datasets.description: The Prague REALMAP Demo dataset contains 9,114 images collected with a panoramic multi-camera rig using global-shutter sensors. Each image carries position information in EXIF metadata populated from a paired IMU device, and the sensors are electrically synchronized to nanosecond precision so the rig acts as a single multicamera device. The release includes camera calibration (COLMAP format), GPS tracks, and anonymization masks (GDPR-compliant face/license-plate blurring), and is a demo of the full Mosaic Prague REALMAP capture of over 1.26 million images.

datasets.name: WildfireIA
datasets.summary: An event-level geospatial benchmark for predicting whether a reported natural wildfire escapes initial attack using information available at fire discovery time.
datasets.description: WildfireIA is a multimodal, event-level benchmark for predicting whether a reported natural wildfire escapes initial attack, using only public information available at the time of fire discovery. It provides canonical event-level, source-level, and patch-level feature tables alongside imagery, supporting tabular classification/regression and image-classification tasks. The benchmark is designed for evaluating models for early wildfire-risk assessment over geospatial data.

datasets.name: Burundi Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Burundi derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Burundi, computed from Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery together with CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall totals and anomalies. The data is published by the WFP (World Food Programme) via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Aerial-D
datasets.summary: A large-scale referring expression segmentation dataset for aerial imagery with over 1.5 million natural-language expressions across 37,288 image patches.
datasets.description: Aerial-D is a large-scale generalized referring expression segmentation dataset for aerial imagery, comprising 37,288 high-resolution aerial image patches (480x480) with 1,522,523 referring expressions covering 259,709 annotated targets across individual instances, groups, and semantic categories spanning 21 classes. The patches are drawn from the iSAID and LoveDA aerial sources, with instance segmentation masks and natural-language expressions generated through an automatic pipeline combining rule-based generation with LLM enhancement. It targets language-driven segmentation of objects in remote-sensing imagery.

datasets.name: South Africa Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for South Africa derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for South Africa, computed from Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery together with CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall totals and anomalies. The data is published by the WFP (World Food Programme) via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: TreeFinder
datasets.summary: A US-scale benchmark dataset for individual dead-tree mortality monitoring built from 0.6 m NAIP high-resolution aerial imagery.
datasets.description: TreeFinder is a large-scale, high-resolution benchmark dataset for mapping individual dead trees across the contiguous United States (CONUS). It is built from 0.6 m National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP) aerial imagery and provides pixel-level annotations of individual dead trees, ecological metadata, and benchmark evaluation settings. The dataset supports research at the intersection of computer vision, remote sensing, ecological monitoring, and carbon assessment, and was accepted to the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.

datasets.name: Weather Dataset (Ankara)
datasets.summary: Daily weather measurements for Ankara, Turkey, spanning 2016-2022.
datasets.description: A tabular weather dataset covering Ankara, Turkey from 2016-04-01 to 2022-04-01, with each row representing a single day's observations. Variables include temperature, precipitation, wind speed and direction, and other meteorological parameters. It is suitable for time-series forecasting and climate analysis tasks.

datasets.name: Wildfire Korea Embedded 300m
datasets.summary: Model-ready 16-channel environmental feature tiles at 300 m resolution for wildfire spread prediction over the Korean Peninsula.
datasets.description: A geospatial dataset of 300 m embedded environmental feature tiles covering the Korean Peninsula, designed for wildfire spread prediction and reinforcement-learning research. Each tile is a 16-channel tensor combining DEM-derived slope and aspect, weather features, NDVI, and forest-structure variables representing static and quasi-static conditions for fire simulation. It is paired with the wildfire-korea-episodes-300m dataset and supports an A3C-LSTM wildfire spread model. It is intended for research rather than operational real-time forecasting.

datasets.name: Cal-FF
datasets.summary: A near-complete census of Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations (CAFOs) in California built from satellite imagery and computer vision.
datasets.description: Cal-FF is a comprehensive dataset of Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations (CAFOs) across California, compiled using satellite imagery, computer vision, and human validation to address gaps in administrative records. It contains roughly 2,120 facilities with construction dates spanning 1949-2017. Some publicly available information such as facility addresses has been redacted to protect privacy. The dataset accompanies a manuscript accepted at Nature Scientific Data and was produced by Stanford's RegLab.

datasets.name: Geonames
datasets.summary: A Parquet conversion of the GeoNames global place-name and ZIP-code database.
datasets.description: A simple Parquet conversion of the GeoNames place database and ZIP/postal-code tables, derived from the allCountries dumps published by GeoNames. The main geoname table provides fields such as geonameid, name, alternate names, latitude/longitude coordinates, feature class and code, and country information for millions of populated places and geographic features worldwide. It is useful for geocoding, gazetteer lookups, and place-name resolution.

datasets.name: Geneva Satellite Images (Rooftop Segmentation)
datasets.summary: High-resolution satellite imagery of Geneva, Switzerland with rooftop segmentation labels for solar-suitability assessment.
datasets.description: This dataset contains high-resolution satellite imagery tiles of Geneva, Switzerland (imagery from 2015) paired with rooftop segmentation labels. It was created for research on automated solar panel installation assessment using deep learning, organized into residential, industrial, and mixed building categories with train/validation/test splits. The associated study was published in the Journal of Physics: Conference Series (CISBAT 2021).

datasets.name: weatherDatasetProject
datasets.summary: Hourly weather measurements including temperature, precipitation, and wind.
datasets.description: A tabular weather dataset of hourly observations, with columns for 2 m temperature, precipitation, 10 m wind speed and direction, and timestamps. It contains roughly 9,300 hourly rows in Parquet format. It is suitable for short-term weather forecasting and time-series modeling experiments.

datasets.name: World Languages
datasets.summary: Geographic coordinates, linguistic features, and demographics for over 7,000 living languages.
datasets.description: World Languages documents roughly 7,130 living languages with geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude) for language homelands, typological features, and demographic data. It integrates three authoritative sources: Glottolog (language catalog with ISO 639-3 codes and Glottocodes), WALS (World Atlas of Language Structures), and Ethnologue/UNESCO data on speaker populations and endangerment status. It supports geospatial and linguistic analysis of where the world's languages are spoken.

datasets.name: HMA Glacier Data
datasets.summary: Glacier simulation and measurement data for High Mountain Asia keyed to RGI glacier identifiers.
datasets.description: A geospatial dataset of glacier metrics for High Mountain Asia, organized by Randolph Glacier Inventory (RGI v6) identifiers. It includes 200+ fields tracking glacier mass balance, area, volume, thickness, and elevation changes across decades (1950s-2020s), compiled alongside OGGM glacier-simulation outputs and RGI shapefiles. It is intended for glaciology and cryosphere change analysis.

datasets.name: Remote Sensing SFT Data (RSCoVLM)
datasets.summary: Supervised fine-tuning data for training vision-language models on remote sensing multi-task understanding.
datasets.description: A large-scale supervised fine-tuning (SFT) corpus for training multimodal large language models on remote sensing tasks, released with the RSCoVLM project. It supports remote sensing image understanding, ultra-high-resolution image reasoning, and oriented object detection across multiple domains. It was used to train the RSCoVLM 7B vision-language models, with an associated paper in the journal Remote Sensing.

datasets.name: DVL Suite (DynamicVL)
datasets.summary: A remote sensing benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs on long-term urban dynamics understanding.
datasets.description: DVL Suite is the benchmark behind DynamicVL, a framework for advancing long-term urban dynamics analysis from remote sensing imagery. It evaluates multimodal large language models across urban understanding tasks such as basic change analysis, change-speed estimation, environmental assessment, and temporal captioning over multi-temporal satellite imagery. It was introduced at NeurIPS 2025.

datasets.name: JL1-CD
datasets.summary: A large-scale sub-meter satellite-image change-detection benchmark covering diverse surface changes in China.
datasets.description: JL1-CD is a large-scale, sub-meter, all-inclusive open-source benchmark for remote sensing image change detection. It contains 5,000 pairs of 512x512 pixel satellite images at 0.5-0.75 m resolution (4,000 training and 1,000 testing pairs), covering multiple regions of China. It captures both human-induced changes such as buildings and roads and natural changes, and is released with a multi-teacher knowledge distillation framework.

datasets.name: Landslide UAV (All)
datasets.summary: Drone-captured aerial imagery with segmentation masks for landslide detection.
datasets.description: A UAV-based aerial imagery dataset for landslide detection and segmentation. Each entry pairs a drone-captured 512x512 image with an annotation mask delineating landslide areas. It contains about 13,400 samples split into training (8,600), validation (2,150), and test (2,690) sets in Parquet format, supporting geohazard monitoring and disaster-management applications.

datasets.name: FranceCrops
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 satellite image time-series dataset for crop type classification of agricultural fields across France.
datasets.description: FranceCrops provides Sentinel-2 time series sampled within agricultural fields in France for crop classification. Each sample is a 3D array of shape (100, 60, 12): 100 pixel time series per field, 60 temporal steps (every 5 days from Feb to Nov 2022), and 12 spectral bands, paired with integer crop class labels. It is designed for training and benchmarking temporal crop-type classification models.

datasets.name: Low-Altitude Drone Remote Sensing Dataset
datasets.summary: A high-resolution UAV image dataset captured at a consistent low altitude over coastal residential neighborhoods in Galveston, Texas.
datasets.description: The Low-Altitude Drone Remote Sensing Dataset is a collection of high-resolution drone images acquired at a consistent low altitude over residential neighborhoods in coastal Galveston, Texas. Unlike many UAV datasets captured under highly diverse viewpoints, it maintains a uniform acquisition geometry. The dataset targets remote sensing image compression, image restoration, and downstream visual understanding tasks such as object detection.

datasets.name: Major-TOM-TACO
datasets.summary: A TACO-formatted multimodal Earth observation dataset built on Major TOM, aligning co-registered Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Copernicus DEM patches.
datasets.description: Major-TOM-TACO is a TACO-formatted multimodal dataset derived from the Major TOM core datasets. Each sample aligns Sentinel-2 L2A optical, Sentinel-1 RTC radar, Copernicus DEM 30m elevation, and optional Major TOM embeddings under a single grid so patches are spatially matched. The data is co-registered and packaged for ready use in training and evaluation of multimodal remote sensing models.

datasets.name: weatherAUS
datasets.summary: A tabular dataset of daily weather observations from numerous weather stations across Australia.
datasets.description: weatherAUS contains daily weather observations recorded at weather stations across Australia, with meteorological variables such as temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind, and pressure. It is commonly used for weather and climate analysis and for predictive tasks like next-day rain prediction. The data is provided in tabular form on the Hugging Face Hub.

datasets.name: Pabna Urban Tree (Phase 7)
datasets.summary: Tree-crown segmentation outputs over three UAV orthomosaic fields in Pabna, Bangladesh, including crown polygons and canopy statistics.
datasets.description: Pabna Urban Tree Phase 7 provides tree-crown segmentation results for three UAV orthomosaic fields in the urban forest of Pabna, Bangladesh. The dataset includes binary masks and probability heatmaps in GeoTIFF format, detected crown polygons in GeoJSON, and per-crown and per-field canopy statistics (counts, canopy area, mean crown size, cover percentage). Results were produced with an S4 SegFormer (MIT-B2) RGB+ExG model achieving IoU 0.87 and F1 0.93.

datasets.name: Wildfire (Smoke and Fire Detection)
datasets.summary: A collection of remotely captured images of smoke plumes and fire for training forest-fire detection systems.
datasets.description: This wildfire dataset contains images of smoke plumes and fire captured remotely, intended to train computer vision systems to detect forest fires. It is structured for object detection, with roughly 1,785 images in imagefolder format at widths ranging from 640 to 1,024 pixels. The dataset is openly available under the Apache 2.0 license.

datasets.name: Tunisia Rainfall Indicators (Subnational)
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Tunisia, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset provides dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Tunisia at the subnational administrative level, published by the World Food Programme via HDX. Indicators are computed from CHIRPS v2 satellite-plus-station precipitation imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts, aggregated per administrative unit. It supports drought monitoring and rainfall analysis and is released under a CC-BY license.

datasets.name: Satellite Imagery Segmentation
datasets.summary: A satellite imagery dataset for semantic segmentation tasks.
datasets.description: Satellite Imagery Segmentation is a dataset of satellite images paired with segmentation annotations for land-cover and scene segmentation tasks. It is hosted on the Hugging Face Hub for use in training and evaluating remote sensing segmentation models.

datasets.name: SynRS3D
datasets.summary: A large synthetic remote sensing dataset for global 3D semantic understanding from monocular high-resolution imagery.
datasets.description: SynRS3D is a synthetic remote sensing dataset of 69,667 high-resolution (512x512) images spanning 17 terrain types and ground sampling distances. Each sample provides RGB optical imagery, a normalized digital surface model (nDSM) for height, semantic land-cover masks (8 classes), and building change-detection masks. It supports height estimation, land-cover mapping, and building change detection, and was presented as a NeurIPS 2024 Spotlight.

datasets.name: Stereo DEM ICESat-2 (Terminal-Bench-Science)
datasets.summary: Input and validation data for generating a digital elevation model from ASTER stereo imagery and validating it against ICESat-2 laser altimetry.
datasets.description: This dataset provides the input and held-out validation data for the stereo-dem-icesat2 task in Terminal-Bench-Science. It includes an ASTER L1A VNIR stereo pair (Band 3N nadir and 3B backward, single-band Float32, ~15 m GSD) used to generate a digital elevation model, plus ICESat-2 ATL08 laser altimetry for validating the resulting DEM. The data supports photogrammetric DEM generation and elevation-accuracy assessment over Earth-observation scenes.

datasets.name: Disaster Recognition RemoteSense (EN/CN/JA)
datasets.summary: A multilingual vision-language dataset derived from xBD/xView2 satellite imagery for building-damage and disaster recognition.
datasets.description: This dataset is derived from the xBD (xView2) Building Damage Assessment Dataset and reformatted for vision-language model training. It pairs satellite imagery with multi-language conversational annotations supporting disaster recognition in English, Chinese, and Japanese. It is intended for visual question answering and instruction tuning of remote sensing VLMs.

datasets.name: France Radar Rainfall (5-minute)
datasets.summary: High-resolution 5-minute radar-based rainfall accumulation data over mainland France from Meteo-France.
datasets.description: fr-radar-rainfall provides high-resolution radar-based rainfall accumulation over mainland France produced by Meteo-France. Each file contains the rainfall accumulation (in hundredths of millimeters) over the past 5 minutes at a 1 km spatial resolution, derived from the national radar precipitation mosaic. It is released under the Etalab Open License 2.0 for precipitation analysis and nowcasting.

datasets.name: PhilEOBench Land Cover Classification
datasets.summary: A simulated PhiSat-2 land cover classification dataset derived from Sentinel-2 imagery at 10 m resolution.
datasets.description: This dataset is part of the PhilEO Bench suite and provides a simulated PhiSat-2 dataset derived from Sentinel-2 data for land cover classification at 10 meters per pixel. Each pixel is labeled with its dominant land cover class following the ESA WorldCover PUM V1.1 classification scheme (11 classes including tree cover, shrubland, grassland, cropland, built-up, and water). It is intended for applications such as land cover mapping, urban planning, environmental monitoring, and resource management.

datasets.name: BigEarthNetV2-LMDB
datasets.summary: An LMDB-format pre-converted version of the reBEN (BigEarthNet v2.0) Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 multi-label land cover benchmark.
datasets.description: BigEarthNetV2-LMDB is a community-converted, LMDB-format distribution of the refined BigEarthNet (reBEN / BigEarthNet v2.0) remote sensing benchmark, prepared for convenient training pipelines. It contains roughly 480,000 paired Sentinel-1 (SAR, VV/VH) and Sentinel-2 (12 multispectral bands) patches covering diverse European regions. The dataset supports multi-label image classification for land cover and land use recognition. This is an unofficial pre-converted version; the official files take precedence as the authoritative reference.

datasets.name: NC Weather Analysis Dataset
datasets.summary: A weather dataset for North Carolina compiled from OpenWeatherMap for climate research and forecasting.
datasets.description: This dataset compiles weather observations for North Carolina sourced from OpenWeatherMap.org, including measurements such as temperature, humidity, and related variables. It is intended for climate research, weather forecasting, and predictive model development. The data is organized for tabular analysis and modeling tasks.

datasets.name: Multi-City POI Multimodal Benchmark
datasets.summary: A large-scale multimodal benchmark pairing points of interest with street-view, aerial, and satellite imagery across 10 global cities.
datasets.description: The POI Benchmark is a large-scale multimodal dataset that pairs Points of Interest (POIs) with visual imagery across major cities on three continents (e.g. Beijing, Shanghai, Hong Kong, London, Melbourne, Sydney, New York). It combines street-view panorama grids, aerial/storefront photos, and multi-tile satellite imagery with enriched POI metadata, totaling roughly 2.6 million images (3.4 TB) and about 685,000 POI records. It supports vision-language grounding, POI recognition and retrieval from visual context, urban scene understanding, and cross-city generalization benchmarks.
datasets.task: POI recognition / retrieval and urban scene understanding

datasets.name: Geolayers
datasets.summary: A collection of three benchmark satellite-imagery datasets augmented with auxiliary geographic inputs for data-efficient and OOD-robust ML.
datasets.description: Geolayers releases modified versions of benchmark remote sensing datasets spanning land-cover segmentation, tree-cover regression, and multi-label land-cover classification, augmented with auxiliary geographic inputs such as OpenStreetMap rasters, digital elevation models, and location embeddings. Source datasets include SustainBench (Sentinel-2), EnviroAtlas (NAIP aerial), BigEarthNet v2.0 (Sentinel-2), and USAVars (NAIP). It accompanies the paper 'Using Multiple Input Modalities can Improve Data-Efficiency and O.O.D. Generalization for ML with Satellite Imagery' (TerraBytes workshop, ICML 2025). The total release is approximately 248 GB.
datasets.modality: Satellite + aerial imagery with geographic auxiliary layers

datasets.name: S2Agri-17
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 satellite image time-series dataset for 17-class agricultural land cover classification over France.
datasets.description: S2Agri-17 is a satellite image time-series classification dataset built from a single Sentinel-2 tile (T31TFM) covering a 12,100 km2 area in France. It provides ten spectral bands at 10 m resolution across 24 observations (sampled every 10 days, January-October 2017), organized from 191,703 land parcels and roughly 59.3 million pixels. The task is pixel-level land cover classification into 17 categories, with labels derived from the French Land Parcel Identification System. It is distributed as part of the MONSTER (Monash Scalable Time Series Evaluation Repository) benchmark.

datasets.name: Djibouti Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Djibouti aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Djibouti, computed from CHIRPS v2 satellite-and-station precipitation imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts, aggregated by subnational administrative units. It is published by the WFP (World Food Programme) via HDX. The indicators support climate monitoring, drought analysis, and food-security applications.

datasets.name: COP-GEN Edinburgh Subset
datasets.summary: A small pre-compiled multimodal Copernicus (Major-TOM) subset over the Edinburgh region for COP-GEN development.
datasets.description: COP-GEN Edinburgh Subset is a small, ready-to-use subset of Major-TOM Copernicus data covering the Edinburgh region, intended as a development and demonstration dataset for the COP-GEN model with no download scripting or preprocessing required. All modalities are spatially aligned and patchified, including Sentinel-1 RTC (VV, VH), Sentinel-2 L1C (all bands plus cloud mask), Sentinel-2 L2A (all bands), DEM, and LULC. It is suited to multimodal Earth-observation image generation and analysis.

datasets.name: S2 AI4LCC Precomputed Clay
datasets.summary: A precomputed Sentinel-2 land cover dataset reformatted for direct use with the Clay Earth-observation foundation model.
datasets.description: This dataset is a derived version of the Sentinel-2 Land Cover Dataset (Zarr format), precomputed and reformatted specifically for use with the Clay foundation model for Earth observation. Operations that normally occur during data loading (such as tiling and label preparation) are precomputed so the data can be used directly in Clay training or inference pipelines without additional preprocessing. It targets land cover segmentation tasks over Sentinel-2 imagery.

datasets.name: Global Trash and Debris Index
datasets.summary: A global geospatial dataset of trash, litter, and environmental debris locations with latitude and longitude.
datasets.description: The Outerview Global Trash & Debris Index is a large-scale geospatial dataset mapping trash, litter, and environmental debris worldwide, each record tagged with latitude and longitude. The public subset contains roughly 30,000 entries (the full platform spans millions of locations), with imagery sourced from Mapillary and labels generated by Outerview's AI models. It supports detection of waste accumulation hotspots, environmental monitoring, image classification, and object detection, and is distributed in Parquet, CSV, and GeoJSON formats.

datasets.name: Land Use App Data
datasets.summary: A global gridded land-use and land-use-change emissions (ELUC) dataset from 2012 onward used in the Land Use demo app.
datasets.description: This dataset, published by Project Resilience, is a global subset of gridded land-use and emissions data from 2012 onward prepared for the Land Use demo application. Each row is indexed by latitude/longitude and time and includes land-use category fractions (C3/C4 annual and perennial crops, pasture, primary and secondary forest, rangeland, urban) along with Emissions from Land-Use Change (ELUC) values and differences. Covering 176 countries with about 2.4 million rows, it supports land-use modeling and climate/emissions analysis. The field structure resembles harmonized land-use products such as LUH2.
datasets.task: Tabular regression / land-use and emissions modeling

datasets.name: Ethiopia Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) 2020-2024
datasets.summary: Palmer Drought Severity Index values for Ethiopia from 2020 to 2024 for monitoring drought conditions.
datasets.description: This dataset provides Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) values for Ethiopia covering 2020 to 2024, offering insight into drought conditions across the country. The PDSI is a widely used drought index measuring deviations in soil-moisture conditions from the long-term average, helping identify both drought and wet conditions. Published by 3iS and sourced from HDX, it supports climate monitoring, drought analysis, and food-security applications.

datasets.name: Bangladesh Flood PDNA 2022
datasets.summary: District- and upazila-level post-disaster needs assessment data for the 2022 Bangladesh floods, including hydrological and damage indicators.
datasets.description: This dataset compiles research data from the 2022 Bangladesh floods as a post-disaster needs assessment (PDNA), organized at district and upazila administrative levels. It combines hydrological and environmental attributes (flood depth, duration, inundation percentage, distance to rivers) with damage and loss figures, vulnerability indicators, and infrastructure-impact metrics across affected regions such as Sylhet, Sunamganj, and Moulvibazar. Curated by Farjana Yesmin, it accompanies the paper 'Toward Equitable Recovery: A Fairness-Aware AI Framework for Prioritizing Post-Flood Aid in Bangladesh' (CCAI 2026, IEEE) and supports flood-impact modeling and tabular regression/classification.

datasets.name: Canadian Cropland
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing dataset of RGB satellite image patches for 10-class agricultural land classification in Canada.
datasets.description: The Canadian Cropland Dataset provides labeled RGB image patches for agricultural land-use classification across Canada. This Hugging Face distribution contains the 2017 RGB split with 14,111 examples across 10 crop classes (barley, canola, corn, mixedwood, oat, orchard, pasture, potato, soybean, and spring wheat). It accompanies the paper 'Towards the Creation of a Canadian Land-Use Dataset for Agricultural Land Classification' and supports image classification for crop mapping.

datasets.name: South Africa Crop Type Clouds
datasets.summary: Cloud masks for Sentinel-2 imagery of the South Africa Crop Type dataset, supporting cloud-aware crop field segmentation.
datasets.description: This dataset contains cloud masks generated for Sentinel-2 imagery of the South Africa Crop Type dataset, produced with the s2cloudless library. The masks provide a quality assessment for multispectral imagery so that samples with large cloud-covered areas of interest can be excluded, since multispectral imagery is ineffective through clouds. Curated by Daniele Rege Cambrin, it accompanies the paper 'KAN You See It? KANs and Sentinel for Effective and Explainable Crop Field Segmentation' and supports image segmentation tasks.

datasets.name: Lesotho Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Lesotho aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Lesotho, computed from CHIRPS v2 satellite-and-station precipitation imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts, aggregated by subnational administrative units. It is published by the WFP (World Food Programme) via HDX. The indicators support climate monitoring, drought analysis, and food-security applications.

datasets.name: Rock Glacier Dataset
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 satellite image classification dataset for detecting rock glaciers in the Chilean Andes.
datasets.description: The Rock Glacier Dataset contains Sentinel-2 satellite imagery of rock glaciers in the Chilean Andes, provided as 128x128 pixel RGBA PNG images for binary image classification between 'cordillera' (mountain range) and 'glaciar' (glacier). It includes 7,875 training, 1,125 validation, and 2,700 test examples and was created by the CMM Glaciares group at the University of Chile. The dataset supports rock glacier detection and segmentation tasks.

datasets.name: Glacier-Dataset
datasets.summary: A bitemporal remote sensing dataset of polar glaciers for glacier change detection via image segmentation.
datasets.description: Glacier-Dataset contains paired bitemporal Landsat-8 RGB composite imagery from two representative polar regions (the southeastern coast of Greenland and the Svalbard Archipelago), along with binary change masks. It comprises 683 bitemporal image pairs of 256x256 pixel patches focused on glaciers, icefields, crevasse systems, and exposed bedrock. The dataset accompanies the VPGCD-Net paper and supports glacier change detection, image segmentation, and classification.

datasets.name: NDVI (Sentinel-2, Hungary)
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 derived NDVI vegetation-index sample data over Hungary in Parquet, GeoTIFF, and CSV formats.
datasets.description: This dataset provides Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) sample data computed from Sentinel-2 imagery over Hungary, covering January 2024. The data was resampled from a native 10m x 10m resolution to 107m x 107m, totaling roughly 10.7M rows, and is distributed as Parquet, GeoTIFF, and CSV files. It is intended for vegetation monitoring and remote sensing experimentation rather than fine-grained small-scale crop or soil health analysis.

datasets.name: DRC Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite-derived rainfall indicators for the Democratic Republic of the Congo aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators for the Democratic Republic of the Congo, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units to support drought and food-security monitoring. Published by the World Food Programme and sourced via HDX, it was curated into an ML-ready format on Hugging Face.

datasets.name: CarbonFluxBench
datasets.summary: A global benchmark of 1.3M+ daily eddy-covariance carbon flux observations with remote sensing and meteorological features for zero-shot upscaling.
datasets.description: CarbonFluxBench comprises over 1.4 million daily observations from 573 eddy covariance flux tower sites globally spanning 2000-2024. It pairs three carbon flux targets (GPP, RECO, NEE) with MODIS satellite reflectance, ERA5-Land meteorological features, and site metadata on vegetation and climate. The benchmark provides stratified evaluation protocols that test generalization across unseen vegetation types and climate regimes, with reproducible baselines for zero-shot upscaling of carbon fluxes.
datasets.modality: Climate / Earth observation (MODIS, ERA5-Land, flux towers)

datasets.name: Cyclone Enawo - Madagascar - Windspeed, Track and Rainfall
datasets.summary: Geospatial windspeed, storm track, and rainfall data for Cyclone Enawo over Madagascar.
datasets.description: This dataset provides windspeed, storm track, and rainfall data for Tropical Cyclone Enawo as it affected Madagascar. The windspeed and track data cover only the portion of the event where Enawo was classified as a tropical cyclone. Provided by the Netherlands Red Cross (510) and sourced via HDX, it was curated into an ML-ready format on Hugging Face.

datasets.name: Dist_Uncertainty
datasets.summary: Hyperspectral remote sensing case studies with land cover labels for evaluating uncertainty in deep-learning plant trait retrieval.
datasets.description: Dist_Uncertainty contains hyperspectral remote sensing imagery and associated land cover labels used as out-of-domain test cases for evaluating uncertainty estimation methods in deep-learning-based plant trait retrievals. The data covers an EnMAP scene over Leipzig, Germany and a NEON scene in Wisconsin, USA, including roughly 1,522 training spectra plus hyperspectral test images. It accompanies Cherif et al. (2025, Biogeosciences) and supports evaluation of a distance-based uncertainty method against ensemble and dropout approaches.

datasets.name: Low Altitude Satellite Image Dataset (500 samples)
datasets.summary: A small set of 499 low-altitude satellite/aerial images of urban areas with rich geographic and street-level metadata.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 499 low-altitude satellite/aerial images of urban areas worldwide, each accompanied by comprehensive metadata. Metadata fields include geographic information (latitude, longitude, urban classification), street-level features (road, building, and vegetation coverage; green-view and sky-view indices; vehicle presence), and infrastructure details such as highway type, number of lanes, and road width. It supports image classification, object detection, and segmentation for urban-planning and geospatial analysis.

datasets.name: govgis_nov2023-slim-spatial
datasets.summary: A georeferenced, spatially-enriched subset of government GIS server data with vector embeddings in GeoParquet format.
datasets.description: govgis_nov2023-slim-spatial is a curated, georeferenced subset of the larger govgis_nov2023 collection scraped from government GIS servers. It includes diverse geospatial data types such as ecological data, census information, administrative boundaries, transportation networks, and land use maps, enriched with vector embeddings (BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5) for semantic search. The data is distributed as two GeoParquet files, one with core spatial data and one with detailed embeddings.

datasets.name: HabitAlp2.0
datasets.summary: An ecological habitat mapping dataset of aerial imagery and annotated polygons for an Austrian alpine national park.
datasets.description: HabitAlp2.0 is an ecological habitat mapping dataset for the Gesause National Park and Natura 2000 area in Austria, covering approximately 154 km2. It includes 30,241 polygons annotated via aerial photo stereo-interpretation for the years 1954, 2003, and 2013, alongside remote sensing layers such as orthophotos and LiDAR elevation data. The dataset supports AI-driven habitat classification and change-detection tasks across decades.

datasets.name: UAVid-3D-Scenes
datasets.summary: A depth-estimation extension of the UAVid aerial dataset with undistorted RGB frames paired with metric depth maps.
datasets.description: UAVid-3D-Scenes is a depth-estimation-focused extension of the UAVid semantic dataset, reorganizing the original UAV sequences by the larger scenes in which they were captured. It provides undistorted RGB frames (512x1024) paired with metric depth maps obtained through COLMAP reconstructions and scaling, plus camera intrinsics, poses, and calibration across 12 scenes. The dataset accompanies the paper TanDepth: Leveraging Global DEMs for Metric Monocular Depth Estimation in UAVs.

datasets.name: Mozambique: Impact of Cyclones
datasets.summary: Tabular records of cyclone impacts (people affected and injured) across Mozambique from 2017 to 2025.
datasets.description: This dataset captures the impact of cyclones, including the number of people affected and injured, across Mozambique from 2017 to 2025. Each row represents a tabular record of cyclone impact within the geographic scope of Mozambique. Published by OCHA Mozambique and sourced via HDX, it was curated into an ML-ready Parquet format on Hugging Face.

datasets.name: Sahel Crops, Vegetation and Standardized Precipitation Index
datasets.summary: Geospatial precipitation, vegetation, and crop indices for the Sahel region of Senegal and Mauritania.
datasets.description: This dataset contains precipitation indices (including the Standardized Precipitation Index) useful for analyzing and comparing variations in precipitation over time and across geographic regions, alongside vegetation and crop indices used to monitor activity and detect crop presence in the Sahel. It focuses on Senegal and Mauritania. Provided by Accion contra el hambre - GIS4tech and sourced via HDX, it was curated into an ML-ready format on Hugging Face.

datasets.name: Landmine Detection in Antioquia, Colombia
datasets.summary: A geospatial grid dataset combining remote sensing, environmental, and socio-economic features for landmine risk estimation in Colombia.
datasets.description: This dataset supports landmine risk estimation across 15 municipalities in the Antioquia department of Colombia, dividing the region into 26,761 grid cells of 500 x 500 meters each. Each cell carries 63 predictive features derived from open geospatial, remote sensing, environmental, socio-economic, and conflict-related sources, including latitude/longitude, elevation, nighttime lights, rainfall, temperature, land use, and infrastructure distances. Each grid cell is labeled with a binary outcome indicating whether landmines were found.

datasets.name: LiDAR L3CAM Omniverse
datasets.summary: Synthetic LiDAR point clouds and paired RGB images of a port scene generated with NVIDIA Omniverse.
datasets.description: A simulated sensing dataset created in NVIDIA Omniverse using a custom extension that models Beamagine's L3CAM device. It contains LiDAR point clouds paired with RGB images of a port scene featuring shipping containers and a container ship. The simulated L3CAM has two LiDAR modules (each with a 30x20 degree field of view, 60x20 degrees total) plus a narrow-FOV RGB camera. It is intended for testing point-cloud and sensor-fusion pipelines on a synthetic 3D scene.

datasets.name: NYC Sensitive Sites
datasets.summary: GeoJSON boundaries of sensitive sites such as parks and recreational areas across New York City.
datasets.description: A geospatial vector dataset describing sensitive sites across New York City, primarily parks and recreational areas managed by the Department of Parks and Recreation. Each record is a GeoJSON feature with MultiPolygon geometry plus properties such as address, jurisdiction, acreage, zip code, and council district. It contains roughly 2,000 site polygons and is suitable for mapping and spatial analysis of NYC site boundaries.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Arc of Deforestation (10m)
datasets.summary: Monthly Sentinel-2 GeoTIFF composites over the Amazon arc of deforestation for forest-loss analysis.
datasets.description: A Sentinel-2 satellite imagery dataset focused on the arc of deforestation in the Amazon forest, intended for deforestation detection and land cover analysis. Each file is a monthly composite in GeoTIFF (.tif) format at 10 m resolution, spanning roughly 2015-2016, with per-file sizes ranging from a few kilobytes up to about 2 GB. It is designed for training machine learning and deep learning models on forest-change tasks.

datasets.name: AI4Arctic Sea Ice Challenge
datasets.summary: Ready-to-train Arctic sea-ice dataset pairing Sentinel-1 SAR with passive-microwave data and ice-chart labels.
datasets.description: A rehosted, ready-to-train version of the AI4Arctic Sea Ice Challenge dataset, repackaged into a single tarball for faster downloads with an added metadata.csv generated from a helper script. The underlying data combines Sentinel-1 SAR imagery and AMSR2 passive-microwave observations with sea-ice charts for sea-ice concentration, stage of development, and floe-size mapping in the Arctic. It was produced by the Technical University of Denmark and is widely used for benchmarking sea-ice retrieval models.

datasets.name: RSTeller Metadata
datasets.summary: Per-patch geographic and source metadata accompanying the RSTeller remote-sensing image-caption dataset.
datasets.description: The metadata table for the RSTeller remote-sensing vision-language dataset. Each row corresponds to an image patch (keyed by patch_id) and provides details such as the WGS84 latitude and longitude of the patch center along with other source and acquisition information. It is meant to be used together with the main RSTeller image-caption dataset to support geographic filtering and analysis of the patches.

datasets.name: O3 EartH
datasets.summary: Geospatial site-suitability dataset with OlmoEarth foundation-model embeddings for renewable energy infrastructure.
datasets.description: O3 EartH is a geospatial site-suitability dataset for renewable energy infrastructure assessment, built with OlmoEarth foundation-model embeddings derived from Sentinel-2 imagery. It includes about 24,866 labeled samples (latitude, longitude, energy type, label, country) plus a table of roughly 321,614 global energy plant locations compiled from EIA and OpenStreetMap. The associated benchmark reports an AUC of 0.867 under leave-one-country-out spatial cross-validation.

datasets.name: Sierra Leone Rainfall Indicators (Subnational)
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Sierra Leone aggregated by subnational administrative unit.
datasets.description: A climate dataset of dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Sierra Leone, aggregated by subnational administrative units. Indicators are computed from CHIRPS v2 satellite-plus-station precipitation estimates and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Published by the World Food Programme via HDX, it supports drought monitoring, food-security analysis, and rainfall regression tasks.

datasets.name: ChaBuD MSI
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 multispectral image pairs with burned-area masks for the ChaBuD ECML-PKDD 2023 change-detection challenge.
datasets.description: ChaBuD (Change detection for Burned area Delineation) is a Sentinel-2 dataset for delineating burned areas via change detection, used in the ChaBuD ECML-PKDD 2023 Discovery Challenge. This MSI version contains 356 images with all 13 Sentinel-2 bands at 512x512 pixels and 10 m resolution. Each pair is labeled with two classes (no change, burned area) for binary change detection.

datasets.name: Drone Building Extraction (Calgary)
datasets.summary: High-resolution drone imagery with building polygon masks for binary building segmentation over Calgary, Canada.
datasets.description: A high-resolution drone (UAV) imagery dataset for binary building segmentation, captured over a residential area in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It pairs aerial imagery with building polygon annotations split into train and test areas. The dataset is designed to work directly with GeoSeg Studio, an open-source QGIS plugin for deep-learning semantic segmentation.

datasets.name: EEA Industrial Emissions
datasets.summary: Spatial and tabular industrial-emissions reporting data assembled for the EU Space for Water project.
datasets.description: A geospatial dataset assembled for the EU Space for Water project, combining spatial and tabular industrial-emissions data. The spatial component provides GeoPackage layers (such as facility clusters and an industrial site map) with accompanying metadata, while the tabular component holds CSV tables. It is based on EEA Industrial Reporting under the Industrial Emissions Directive (2010/75/EU) and supports spatial analysis of industrial pollution sources.

datasets.name: Poland 3D Data
datasets.summary: A large 3D geospatial data archive covering Poland.
datasets.description: A geospatial 3D dataset covering Poland, distributed on Hugging Face as a single large (~8 GB) archive in imagefolder format. It is tagged as geospatial image/3D data of Poland. The dataset has limited published documentation, so detailed provenance, resolution, and collection methodology are not fully specified.

datasets.name: KAO-DIFFSAT-VHR-BENCHMARK
datasets.summary: A very-high-resolution satellite imagery benchmark for evaluating diffusion-based inpainting in remote sensing.
datasets.description: KAO-DIFFSAT-VHR-BENCHMARK is a curated collection of very-high-resolution (VHR) satellite imagery samples for evaluating diffusion-based image inpainting methods in remote sensing. It is released with the KAO (Kernel-Adaptive Optimization) research project, which combines diffusion generative modeling with kernel-adaptive optimization and token-pyramid transformers for structure-preserving geospatial reconstruction. It supports image-to-image, segmentation, and mask-generation tasks across urban and natural landscapes.

datasets.name: Mexico City Weather (SIH CONAGUA)
datasets.summary: Historical daily weather records from meteorological stations across Mexico City, collected by Mexico's National Water Commission.
datasets.description: This dataset contains historical weather records for Mexico City sourced from the Sistema de Informacion Hidrologica (SIH) of the Comision Nacional del Agua (CONAGUA). It aggregates daily measurements from multiple meteorological stations, including maximum and minimum temperature and rainfall, indexed by locality and date. The data is provided as an aggregated CSV plus per-station raw files, suitable for time-series forecasting and environmental analysis.

datasets.name: NA-SAR
datasets.summary: A large North America synthetic aperture radar pretraining corpus built from the NASA OPERA archive for self-supervised SAR foundation models.
datasets.description: NA-SAR is a North America synthetic aperture radar (SAR) pretraining dataset built from the NASA OPERA archive and aligned with digital elevation model terrain data. It is intended for self-supervised and masked-image pretraining of SAR foundation models and is released as an unsplit pretraining corpus without train/validation/test partitions. Each 128x128 sample includes multiple SAR views with co/cross polarization channels, incidence angle, interferometric phase, coherence estimates, and elevation/slope derivatives.

datasets.name: S2Agri-10pc-17
datasets.summary: A pixel-based Sentinel-2 satellite image time-series dataset for land cover classification over an agricultural region in France.
datasets.description: S2Agri-10pc-17 is a land cover classification dataset derived from Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite image time series covering a 12,100 km2 area in France (tile T31TFM). It provides ten spectral bands at 10 m resolution across 24 observations sampled roughly every 10 days from January to October 2017. This version is a 10% random subset of land parcels reorganized for pixel-based analysis with 17 land cover classes, and is distributed as part of the MONSTER time-series benchmark.

datasets.name: CVG-Text
datasets.summary: A multimodal cross-view geo-localization dataset pairing street-view, satellite, and OSM map views with natural-language scene descriptions across three cities.
datasets.description: CVG-Text is a cross-view geo-localization dataset designed to localize places from textual descriptions by retrieving corresponding visual or map-based views. It combines street-view imagery (panoramic and single-view), satellite images, OpenStreetMap maps, and scene text descriptions for over 30,000 unique locations across Brisbane, New York, and Wuhan. The full release totals about 128 GB and accompanies the ICCV 2025 paper on cross-view geo-localization with natural language descriptions.

datasets.name: Hail and Wind Damage Chips (HWDS-Multimodal)
datasets.summary: Multimodal HLS optical and Sentinel-1 SAR image chips with damage masks for segmenting hail and wind damage swaths over a 21-year climatology.
datasets.description: The hail and wind damage chips (HWDS-Multimodal) dataset provides 256x256 pixel, 30 m resolution image chips for segmenting storm damage. Each chip pairs HLS (Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2) six-band surface reflectance with OPERA RTC Sentinel-1 SAR (VV/VH) backscatter and a binary damage mask. Chips are generated from buffered regions around damage polygons drawn from the hwds_db hail and wind damage swath climatology spanning 2000 to 2020.

datasets.name: Local Weather Data (Babala)
datasets.summary: Daily meteorological time-series with NASA POWER-style climate variables for a single location, spanning from 1981 onward.
datasets.description: This dataset contains daily meteorological measurements for the Babala region (approximately 29.32N, 81.23E) spanning from January 1981 onward. It includes 25 climate variables following NASA POWER/MERRA-2 naming conventions, such as 2 m temperature (T2M, with min/max/range), humidity (RH2M, QV2M), corrected precipitation (PRECTOTCORR), surface pressure (PS), and 10 m/50 m wind speeds. The data is provided in Parquet format suitable for weather and climate time-series analysis.

datasets.name: Ukraine Forest Change Detection
datasets.summary: Paired multispectral satellite image tiles with binary change masks for forest change detection over Ukraine.
datasets.description: This dataset contains paired multispectral satellite image tiles (time points A and B) and binary change masks for detecting forest change. Each sample is a triplet of a before image, an after image, and a change-mask label for the same tile and period. The data is organized into train, validation, and test splits with a consistent directory structure.

datasets.name: SDSU MidWest Flood 2019
datasets.summary: A benchmark of true-color satellite images from the 2019 US Midwest flooding event paired with binary flood masks.
datasets.description: SDSU Midwest Flood 2019 provides a benchmark for flood detection in satellite imagery. It contains true-color satellite images captured during the 2019 Midwest USA flooding event, with each image paired with a binary mask indicating flooded areas. The dataset is designed to be robust to seasonal changes in satellite imagery and accompanies the paper 'A Novel Dataset for Flood Detection Robust to Seasonal Changes in Satellite Imagery'.

datasets.name: TreeUQ
datasets.summary: A large-scale Earth observation benchmark for tree species mapping and tree structure estimation with uncertainty-relevant targets over Bavaria, Germany.
datasets.description: TreeUQ is a multi-modal Earth observation benchmark for tree species mapping and tree structure estimation (height, density, variance) built over Bavaria, Germany on a 10 m reference grid (EPSG:25832) using 128x128 pixel patches. Each sample bundles four-season Sentinel-2 (10 bands), four-season Sentinel-1 GRD (VV, VH), a tree species raster, per-pixel height/count/density targets from the Bavarian Einzelbaeume individual-tree inventory, and DOP20 RGB orthophotos. The benchmark is designed with uncertainty quantification in mind and spans roughly 45,419 patches across train, validation, and test splits.
datasets.modality: Multi-modal remote sensing (Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, aerial orthophoto)

datasets.name: Africa CLIMADA Tropical Cyclone Dataset
datasets.summary: Tropical cyclone wind footprint hazard data at ~4 km resolution for selected countries, for disaster risk assessment.
datasets.description: This dataset provides tropical cyclone wind footprints (m/s) at 150 arcsec (approximately 4 km at the equator) resolution for disaster risk assessment. It is published by ETH Zurich (Weather and Climate Risks) via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and is available as global files and per-country subsets. Footprints cover both historically observed records and synthetically generated probabilistic events from various modelling sources for present and future climate conditions.

datasets.name: Pretrain-Where Pretraining Datasets (SatMAE)
datasets.summary: A collection of satellite imagery pretraining datasets split by spatial context, used to study the impact of geographic context on SatMAE pretraining.
datasets.description: This collection consists of seven satellite imagery pretraining datasets used to pretrain SatMAE, each containing data from a specific spatial context: Africa only, Asia only, North America only, South America only, and others. The datasets were assembled to study how the spatial context of a pretraining corpus affects downstream Earth observation performance. They are intended for self-supervised pretraining and feature extraction on overhead imagery.

datasets.name: Synthetic RCD
datasets.summary: A synthetic change detection dataset for training Referring Change Detection (RCD) models, built on top of the SECOND dataset.
datasets.description: Synthetic RCD is a synthetic change detection dataset designed for training Referring Change Detection (RCD) models such as RCDNet. It provides post-change imagery and change labels, while the pre-change images are sourced from the original SECOND semantic change detection dataset (which must be downloaded separately and symlinked). The dataset is released in multiple parts (Synthetic RCD 1 and 2).

datasets.name: Namibia Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Namibia derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Namibia, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and the CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. The indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX). It supports climate monitoring and food-security analysis at the subnational scale.

datasets.name: Gravity Wave Parameterization Dataset
datasets.summary: Input-output training pairs from ECMWF ERA5 for learning a nonlocal atmospheric gravity wave parameterization.
datasets.description: This dataset contains input and output training pairs computed from ECMWF's ERA5 reanalysis for developing a nonlocal gravity wave parameterization, released by the IBM-NASA Geospatial team. The data was computed for the years 2010, 2012, 2014, and 2015, with one validation month provided for testing. Each sample is a gridded atmospheric field over 64 latitudes and 128 longitudes, with input channels for the background atmospheric state and surface variables, and output channels for potential temperature and momentum fluxes. It was used to train the Prithvi-WxC gravity-wave parameterization model.

datasets.name: JKTSV-primary
datasets.summary: A geospatial WebDataset pairing image and text tiles with GeoPackage vector geometries for train and test splits.
datasets.description: JKTSV-primary is a geospatial dataset distributed in WebDataset format, with image, text, and geospatial modalities. It ships sharded TAR archives (train/ and test/) alongside GeoPackage (.gpkg) files holding the corresponding vector geometries for each split. The dataset is hosted on Hugging Face and falls in the 100K-1M sample range.

datasets.name: remote-sensing-VQA
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing visual question answering dataset pairing satellite/aerial images with question and answer text.
datasets.description: remote-sensing-VQA is a visual question answering dataset for remote-sensing imagery. Each record contains one or more images, a problem (question) string, and an answer string, supporting training and evaluation of multimodal models on Earth-observation imagery. It provides roughly 16,099 training examples and 1,000 test examples.

datasets.name: landcover-urban-climate
datasets.summary: A satellite imagery dataset with segmentation masks for building detection and land-cover segmentation in urban areas.
datasets.description: The landcover-urban-climate (Urban Climate) dataset contains satellite images of urban areas paired with corresponding segmentation masks for building detection and segmentation tasks. It is provided in Parquet format split into train, validation, and test partitions, with each record holding an image and its mask. The dataset is part of the broader Urban Climate project and is hosted on Hugging Face.

datasets.name: KOMPSAT-3/3A Image-Text Dataset
datasets.summary: A high-resolution KOMPSAT-3/3A satellite image-text dataset built by KARI for training multimodal models on satellite imagery.
datasets.description: The KOMPSAT-3/3A Image-Text Dataset is a high-resolution remote-sensing image-text dataset constructed by the Korea Aerospace Research Institute (KARI). It is designed to improve the accuracy and interpretability of large multimodal models specialized in satellite image analysis by bridging the gap between general-domain imagery and the physical characteristics of satellite data. Images come from the KOMPSAT-3/3A satellites and are paired with English text for visual question answering and image-to-text tasks.

datasets.name: MOSAIC-SEN2-CC Change Detection
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 multi-image change-detection dataset reformatted as before/after image pairs with prompts and answers for vision-language fine-tuning.
datasets.description: mosaic_sen2_cc_change_detection is a multi-image change-detection reformat of the MOSAIC-SEN2-CC dataset (Tuzlupinar et al., IEEE JSTARS 2025), prepared for vision-language fine-tuning. Each row is a (before image, after image, prompt, answer, schema id) tuple built from Sentinel-2 Earth-observation imagery. It provides about 29,281 training rows and 700 balanced validation rows for change-detection question answering.

datasets.name: Oil Spill Tokenized Dataset
datasets.summary: A satellite imagery dataset with segmentation masks for oil spill detection and semantic segmentation.
datasets.description: The Oil Spill Tokenized Dataset contains preprocessed satellite images and corresponding oil spill masks, prepared for an oil spill detection project. It is intended for computer vision tasks such as semantic segmentation, oil spill detection, and geospatial AI experiments. The data is organized into train, validation, and test splits, with samples that may include image, mask, filename, and tokenized fields.

datasets.name: OpenStreetCLIP Dataset
datasets.summary: Satellite imagery aligned with OpenStreetMap vector metadata for training vision-language models with patch-level semantic supervision.
datasets.description: The osm-clip-dataset (OpenStreetCLIP) contains high-resolution satellite imagery aligned with OpenStreetMap (OSM) vector metadata, designed for training and evaluating vision-language models with patch-level semantic supervision. It is organized into sharded TAR archives holding 600x600 pixel images, precomputed 7x7-grid masks, and metadata for efficient streaming. The dataset is in the 100K-1M sample range and machine-generated annotations are derived from OSM.

datasets.name: GeoVision Fountains - Laval, France
datasets.summary: A small satellite-imagery object-detection and segmentation dataset of fountain objects in Laval, France, generated via the GeoVision pipeline.
datasets.description: test-geovision-fountains-laval is a geospatial dataset of fountain objects in Laval, France, generated using the GeoVision v2.1 pipeline (SAM2 plus quality filtering). It combines OpenStreetMap geometries with IGN Geoportail satellite imagery, providing samples with object class, OSM ID, satellite image, and labels for object detection and image segmentation. It is a small demonstration subset.

datasets.name: South Korean Wildfire Episodes Dataset (300 m Grid)
datasets.summary: A geospatial wildfire-progression dataset combining NASA FIRMS fire detections with environmental layers on a 300 m grid over South Korea.
