datasets.description: wildfire-korea-episodes-300m is a geospatial dataset of South Korean wildfire progression combining NASA FIRMS (VIIRS/MODIS) fire detections with static environmental layers such as DEM, land cover, slope, NDVI, and forest structure. Tiles are preprocessed onto a 300 m spatial grid and segmented into temporal wildfire episodes, each containing a temporal sequence of 16-channel environmental feature tensors and corresponding fire-spread masks. It spans the Korean Peninsula from 2015 to 2025 and is intended for reinforcement-learning-based wildfire spread prediction.
datasets.modality: Multi-channel geospatial raster (FIRMS + DEM + land cover)

datasets.name: Bavaria Tree Benchmark
datasets.summary: An Earth-observation benchmark subset pairing DOP20 aerial orthophotos with Sentinel-1/2 stacks and tree-structure labels over Bavaria.
datasets.description: Bavaria_Tree_Benchmark is a development subset of the Bavaria EO Benchmark, containing 12 patches (9 train, 2 validation, 1 test) sampled from the full grid. Each patch includes DOP20 true-colour aerial orthophotos at 20 cm ground sampling distance alongside 10 m Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 stacks and tree-structure labels. It is distributed as WebDataset-style tensors and is intended for tree-inventory segmentation, not as a large-scale training corpus.

datasets.name: SyntheticGenV5
datasets.summary: A synthetic remote-sensing semantic-segmentation dataset built for urban-rural domain-aware learning.
datasets.description: SyntheticGenV5 is a synthetic remote-sensing semantic segmentation dataset built for urban-rural domain-aware learning. It keeps the original folder layout and uses a metadata CSV to connect each image with its semantic mask and RGB mask, covering two domains (Urban and Rural). It is useful for synthetic augmentation and domain generalization in remote-sensing segmentation.

datasets.name: CLIMADA Wildfire Hazard Dataset (HRP Countries)
datasets.summary: A MODIS-derived global wildfire hazard dataset at 4 km resolution aggregated to administrative units for disaster risk assessment.
datasets.description: africa-climada-wildfire-dataset is the Wildfire Hazard Data for Disaster Risk Assessment over Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) countries, published by ETH Zurich (Weather and Climate Risks) via HDX. It is based on MODIS satellite wildfire observations from 2000 to 2021 at 4 km resolution, with each row representing first-level administrative unit observations. The dataset supports CLIMADA disaster-risk modelling and was last updated on HDX on 2025-09-05.
datasets.modality: MODIS satellite-derived wildfire hazard (tabular by admin unit)

datasets.name: Africa Electrical Grid - Nigeria
datasets.summary: Geospatial point dataset mapping the presence of the electrical grid across Nigeria by latitude/longitude.
datasets.description: This dataset provides the distribution of the electrical grid in Nigeria based on geographic coordinates, with each record giving a latitude, longitude, and a binary indicator of grid presence (1) or absence (0). It contains roughly 56,637 ML-ready records stored in Parquet format. It is intended for infrastructure mapping and energy-access analysis across Nigeria.

datasets.name: SeafloorAI
datasets.summary: A large-scale AI-ready dataset of sonar imagery with geological segmentation masks for seafloor mapping.
datasets.description: SeafloorAI is a large-scale vision-language dataset for seafloor geological survey, comprising hundreds of thousands of sonar images paired with annotated segmentation masks across five geological layers (sediment, physiographic zones, habitat, faults, and folds). It aggregates 62 surveys covering roughly 17,300 square kilometers across multiple regions. The dataset was published in the NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks track and supports seafloor image segmentation and vision-language tasks.

datasets.name: NOAA Significant US Storms (1950-2025)
datasets.summary: A curated subset of the NOAA Storm Events database focused on major and fatal US weather events from 1950 to 2025.
datasets.description: This dataset is a curated subset of the NOAA Storm Events database, reduced from about 1.23 million records to roughly 14,770 significant events to focus on major storms. It includes F3/EF3+ tornadoes, Category 3+ hurricanes, fatal events, and storms causing $1M or more in damage, with geospatial fields such as latitude, longitude, dates, and casualties. It is intended for feature extraction and geospatial analysis of severe US weather.

datasets.name: ClimateIQA
datasets.summary: A large vision-language VQA dataset pairing global wind-gust heatmaps with natural-language questions about extreme weather.
datasets.description: ClimateIQA is a visual question answering dataset of about 254,040 samples that pairs ERA5-derived wind-gust heatmaps with natural-language queries and answers about extreme weather events such as strong gales, storms, and hurricanes. Questions cover detecting severe wind conditions (gusts exceeding 20.7 m/s), verifying weather at specific locations, and extracting geographic coordinates from heatmap visualizations across global land and ocean regions. It accompanies the paper on vision-language models for extreme weather detection with heatmaps.

datasets.name: Global Fire Hydrants Dataset
datasets.summary: A globally geotagged dataset of fire hydrant images and location metadata for infrastructure mapping and object detection.
datasets.description: The Global Fire Hydrants Dataset is a geotagged collection of roughly 14,200 fire hydrants from around the world, released by the Outerview research lab. Each record includes geospatial metadata such as ID, latitude, longitude, source, name, region, and image filename. It is designed for fire-hydrant classification, object detection and localization, infrastructure mapping, geospatial indexing, and world-model training.

datasets.name: I-MAESTRO SAR Forest Patches
datasets.summary: Sentinel-1 SAR image patches paired with forest structural attributes for multi-task forest mapping across three European sites.
datasets.description: This dataset contains processed Sentinel-1 SAR imagery and forest structural attributes derived from the I-MAESTRO synthetic forest inventory, covering three European sites (Bauges in France, Milicz in Poland, and Sneznik in Slovenia). It provides 978 patches (724 train, 145 validation, 109 test) of 64x64 pixels with dual-polarization (VH/VV) backscatter at 25 m resolution, plus targets for biomass, canopy height, and genus. It was prepared for multi-task learning of joint forest genus segmentation, canopy height regression, and aboveground biomass regression.

datasets.name: TreeCrown-MM
datasets.summary: A multimodal remote-sensing dataset of RGB, height, mask, and caption tiles for joint tree-crown segmentation and captioning.
datasets.description: TreeCrown-MM is a multimodal remote sensing dataset for joint tree crown segmentation and captioning, containing 32,787 tiles of 1024x1024 pixels with roughly 330,000 annotated crowns spanning 285 species. It covers five ecosystem types (Boreal, Tropical, Subtropical, Temperate, and Urban-Mixed) across multiple worldwide regions. Each tile provides four aligned modalities: an RGB image, a height map (LiDAR canopy height model or pseudo-depth), a segmentation mask, and a natural-language caption, split into train, validation, test, and benchmark sets.
datasets.modality: Multimodal RGB / LiDAR height / mask / text

datasets.name: Weather Report India (1990-2017)
datasets.summary: A tabular weather dataset of daily temperature and precipitation records for India spanning 1990 to 2017.
datasets.description: This dataset contains tabular weather records for India covering the period 1990 to 2017, including date and temperature metrics (average, minimum, and maximum) along with precipitation data. It comprises about 83,725 rows split into train (58,600) and test (25,100) partitions, stored in Parquet format. It is suited for time-series and climate analysis of Indian weather.

datasets.name: WildfireSpread
datasets.summary: A geospatial dataset for modeling wildfire spread.
datasets.description: WildfireSpread is a geospatial dataset hosted on Hugging Face for studying and modeling the spread of wildfires. The repository totals roughly 11 GB of data covering wildfire-related variables. It is intended for geospatial wildfire analysis and prediction tasks.

datasets.name: Daily Summaries of Precipitation Indicators for the Democratic Republic of the Congo
datasets.summary: Tabular daily precipitation-indicator records from weather stations across the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
datasets.description: This dataset contains daily summaries of precipitation indicators recorded at base weather stations across the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The four indicators included are total precipitation (TPCP), maximum snow depth (MXSD), total snowfall (TSNW), and extreme maximum daily precipitation (EMXP). It comprises about 216 rows (172 train, 44 test), sourced via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) from NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information.

datasets.name: LandScan Global Population Data
datasets.summary: A chunked HDF5 tensor packaging LandScan Global annual ambient population estimates from 2000 to 2023 at roughly 1 km resolution for geospatial and deep learning workflows.
datasets.description: This dataset repackages Oak Ridge National Laboratory's LandScan Global ambient population product into a single production-ready, chunked HDF5 file (pop_2000-23.h5) covering 24 annual time steps from 2000 to 2023. It bundles what would otherwise be 24 separate GeoTIFFs into one tensor optimized for efficient access in deep learning, geospatial analysis, and HPC pipelines. The underlying LandScan estimates model the worldwide distribution of population at approximately 1 km spatial resolution.

datasets.name: Land-Use-Cover-Remote-Sensing-Dataset
datasets.summary: A remote sensing dataset focused on land use and land cover mapping with an emphasis on agricultural land coverage.
datasets.description: This remote sensing dataset targets land use and land cover monitoring, with particular attention to agricultural land that is underrepresented in many existing benchmarks centered on urban areas. It is intended to support agricultural planning and environmental assessment in the context of global climate change and rapid depletion of land resources. The data supports object-detection style land use cover analysis tasks.

datasets.name: Central African Republic Rainfall Indicators (Subnational)
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for the Central African Republic at subnational level, derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery and station data.
datasets.description: Published by the World Food Programme via HDX, this dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for the Central African Republic aggregated by subnational administrative units. The indicators are computed from CHIRPS version 2 (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) satellite imagery combined with in-situ station data, plus CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It is intended for climate and food-security monitoring at the regional level.

datasets.name: Madagascar Rainfall Indicators (Subnational)
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Madagascar at subnational level, derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation imagery and station data.
datasets.description: Published by the World Food Programme via HDX, this dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Madagascar aggregated by subnational administrative units. The indicators are computed from CHIRPS version 2 (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) satellite imagery combined with in-situ station data, plus CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It supports regional climate and food-security analysis.

datasets.name: Cenote Atlas
datasets.summary: An enriched geospatial dataset of 1,369 cenotes in the Yucatan Peninsula aggregating ten open data sources with terrain, vegetation, and fracture-proximity attributes.
datasets.description: Cenote Atlas is a geospatial dataset cataloging 1,369 cenotes (natural sinkholes) across the Yucatan Peninsula, part of the FindMy Cenote project. Each cenote is enriched with 52 columns spanning ten categories, including base attributes (name, municipality, latitude/longitude, depth, length), terrain analysis, vegetation indices, and fracture proximity. The data is aggregated from sources such as ArcGIS Feature Services and OpenStreetMap.

datasets.name: Urban Climate Land Cover Dataset
datasets.summary: Satellite images of urban areas paired with segmentation masks for building detection and segmentation, part of the Urban Climate project.
datasets.description: This dataset, part of the Urban Climate project, contains satellite imagery of urban areas together with corresponding segmentation masks for building detection and segmentation tasks. It is provided as Parquet files split into training, validation, and test sets, with each record holding an image and its mask. It supports semantic segmentation of buildings in urban remote sensing imagery.

datasets.name: Wisconsin Large Dairy Farms (CAFOs)
datasets.summary: A geo-referenced dataset of large dairy concentrated animal feeding operations in Wisconsin compiled from satellite imagery, computer vision, and human validation.
datasets.description: This dataset provides geo-referenced locations of large dairy farms (concentrated animal feeding operations, or CAFOs) across Wisconsin. It was compiled by combining satellite imagery, computer vision, human validation, and merges to administrative and open geospatial data sources. The dataset underpins the analysis in a manuscript assessing environmental permitting coverage gaps and environmental risk among large Wisconsin dairy farms.

datasets.name: africa-deforestation-all
datasets.summary: Geolocated point observations of Nigerian forest-related data curated into an ML-ready format.
datasets.description: A collection of Nigerian forestry datasets published by Code for Africa via OpenAfrica, where each row represents a geolocated point observation with temporal coverage given by date columns. The geographic scope spans Africa (multiple countries) with a focus on Nigeria. The data was curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: Semantic-Segmentation-Aerial-Imagery-Dataset
datasets.summary: Aerial imagery of Dubai from MBRSC satellites annotated with pixel-level semantic segmentation across 6 classes.
datasets.description: This dataset comprises aerial imagery of Dubai acquired by MBRSC satellites and annotated with pixel-level semantic segmentation across 6 distinct classes. It contains a total of 72 images organised into 6 larger tiles. The data was released by Humans in the Loop as part of a collaborative project with the Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC) in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

datasets.name: africa-icpac-geonode-2015-tropical-cyclone-chapala-path
datasets.summary: A geospatial layer showing the movement path of the 2015 Tropical Cyclone Chapala.
datasets.description: This dataset shows the movement path of 2015 Tropical Cyclone Chapala, published by the IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC) and sourced from HDX. On 2 November 2015, Tropical Cyclone Chapala made landfall in Yemen, with effects also felt across the Gulf of Aden in Somalia, including extensive rainfall in the Northern Bari region in Bosaso district. The data was curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: africa-south-sudan-flood-data
datasets.summary: Reported number of flood-affected people by county and state in South Sudan.
datasets.description: This dataset reports the number of flood-affected people by county and state in South Sudan, published by OCHA South Sudan and sourced from HDX. Each row represents a subnational administrative unit observation. The data was curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: Cluj-Napoca-Weather-OpenWeather-data
datasets.summary: Hourly weather time-series for Cluj-Napoca scraped from the OpenWeather History API.
datasets.description: A weather dataset for Cluj-Napoca, Romania, scraped from the OpenWeatherMap History API. The data was collected at an hourly rate from January 1st 2008 until May 2023. It is intended for long time-series prediction tasks and is compatible with the Time-Series-Library workflow.

datasets.name: forest-plot-analysis
datasets.summary: LiDAR and hyperspectral data with tree-species ground truth for seven forest plots in the French Alps.
datasets.description: This dataset contains information related to seven forest field plots located in the Belledonne massif, Northern Alps, France. It is separated into LiDAR (a collection of 24 features computed from a 3D point cloud), hyperspectral imagery collected with the Hysper VNIR 1600 sensor, and ground truth consisting of annotations for 13 tree species. It supports remote-sensing analysis of forest composition.

datasets.name: mb_clusterreg
datasets.summary: Glacier-level data for cluster-wise regression of present-day glacier mass-balance changes.
datasets.description: This dataset contains glacier-level data used for cluster-wise glacier mass-balance regression, supporting analysis of the drivers of present-day glacier changes. The main CSV provides one row per glacier indexed by RGI ID, including selected morphological predictors, climate anomalies, location and region metadata, projected coordinates, observed mass balance, and mass-balance uncertainty.

datasets.name: africa-mauritius-cyclone-1001052
datasets.summary: Tabular disaster records for the February 2024 tropical storm cyclone affecting Mauritius.
datasets.description: This dataset documents the Mauritius tropical storm cyclone of February 2024 (ADAM ID 1001052_19), published by the WFP Advanced Disaster Analysis & Mapping team and sourced from HDX. It covers the cyclone during the period 19-23 February 2024 in the Miscellaneous (French) Indian Ocean Islands and Mauritius. The data was curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: nesteo-prototype
datasets.summary: A hierarchical, UTM-based nested grid framework for multi-scale multimodal Earth Observation workflows.
datasets.description: NestEO is a hierarchical, resolution-aligned, UTM-based nested grid dataset framework supporting general-purpose, multi-scale multimodal Earth Observation workflows. Built from diverse EO sources and enriched with metadata for landcover, climate zones, and population, it enables scalable, representative and progressive sampling for AI4EO. Grid levels range from 120000m down to 150m, with grid metadata drawn from sources such as ESA WorldCover.

datasets.name: nexrad-storm-catalog
datasets.summary: A metadata index pairing NOAA storm events with nearby NEXRAD WSR-88D weather-radar stations.
datasets.description: The NEXRAD Storm Catalog is a metadata index pairing storm events from the NOAA Storm Events Database with nearby NEXRAD WSR-88D weather-radar stations. Each row is one (event, station) pair where the station was within 150 km of the event location, scoped to 2015-2024. The catalog is metadata only, pointing at radar windows so a downstream pipeline can fetch the matching Level-2 volumes from the Unidata NEXRAD archive.

datasets.name: africa-mli-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Mali aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Mali, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and the CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units. Published by the WFP (World Food Programme) via HDX and curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: road-images-and-embeddings
datasets.summary: 34,908 geotagged Norwegian road images with geospatial metadata and Gemini image embeddings.
datasets.description: A dataset of 34,908 road images from the Trondheim region of Norway (~40km radius), captured by Statens vegvesen (Norwegian Public Roads Administration) in 2025. Each image is paired with rich geospatial metadata, nearest address information, and a 3072-dimensional image embedding from Google's gemini-embedding model. It is intended for image feature extraction, image classification, and zero-shot image classification tasks.
datasets.modality: Street-level road imagery with geospatial metadata

datasets.name: africa-comoros-cyclone-1001060
datasets.summary: Tabular records of the May 2024 tropical cyclone impacting Comoros, from WFP ADAM disaster analysis.
datasets.description: This dataset (ADAM ID 1001060_14) captures a tropical storm during May 1-4, 2024 affecting Tanzania, Seychelles, and Comoros, with geographic scope COM. Each row represents tabular disaster records produced by WFP Advanced Disaster Analysis & Mapping (ADAM) and sourced from HDX. The data was curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa for tabular classification and regression tasks.

datasets.name: africa-ken-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Kenya aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Kenya, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and the CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units. Published by the WFP (World Food Programme) via HDX and curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: olmoearth projects awf
datasets.summary: Expert-annotated land use / land cover mapping data for southern Kenya, for fine-tuning OlmoEarth-v1.
datasets.description: A geospatial dataset for fine-tuning the OlmoEarth-v1-Base model to map land use and land cover in southern Kenya. The data is annotated by experts at the African Wildlife Foundation (AWF). It combines satellite imagery and label modalities, with documentation available in the allenai/olmoearth_projects GitHub repository.

datasets.name: SkySeaLand
datasets.summary: High-resolution satellite imagery dataset in COCO format for object detection across land and sea.
datasets.description: The SkySeaLand Dataset is a high-resolution satellite imagery collection designed for object detection, classification, and aerial surveillance analysis. It is provided in the COCO (Common Objects in Context) JSON format, making it natively compatible with frameworks such as Detectron2, MMDetection, YOLO, and the TensorFlow Object Detection API. The dataset bridges terrestrial and maritime scenes.

datasets.name: soil moisture dataset
datasets.summary: Field soil-moisture measurements for Trentino, Italy, correlated with weather and satellite vegetation indices.
datasets.description: A dataset of soil moisture measurements collected from on-field tensiometers and volumetric sensors, correlated with irrigation records, weather observations, satellite-derived vegetation indices, and static soil and crop characterisation. It covers an anonymised agricultural area in Trentino, Italy, across three regional consortiums. Produced by Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) OpenIoT research unit for tabular regression tasks.

datasets.name: Orthophoto
datasets.summary: A small collection of very high-resolution aerial orthophoto imagery in imagefolder format.
datasets.description: A geospatial dataset containing very high-resolution aerial orthophoto imagery. It is a small collection of large GeoTIFF-style images (tens of thousands of pixels in width) provided in Hugging Face imagefolder format. The dataset is released under the MIT license.

datasets.name: sentinel2-lejepa-global-diverse-256
datasets.summary: A small preset-biased Sentinel-2 L2A chip dataset for self-supervised LeJEPA pretraining.
datasets.description: A small, preset-biased Sentinel-2 L2A chip dataset curated for self-supervised pretraining of a LeJEPA ResNet-18 encoder. It was built as a reproducibility artifact for the Sentinel Change Explorer proof-of-concept foundation-model change-detection feature. It is intentionally tiny (~thousands of chips) and biased toward five demo areas of interest used in the Sentinel Change Explorer app, rather than being a general-purpose Earth-observation pretraining corpus.

datasets.name: Weather-Time-Series-Forecasting
datasets.summary: Hourly meteorological observations since 1980 with 17 weather variables for time-series forecasting.
datasets.description: A weather time-series dataset containing hourly meteorological observations spanning from January 1980 onwards, designed for forecasting tasks. It provides 17 variables including temperature, relative humidity, dew point, precipitation, rainfall, snowfall, pressure (MSL and surface), cloud cover by altitude, vapor pressure deficit, wind speed and direction, and a day/night indicator. The data is provided in CSV format with hourly timestamps.

datasets.name: corine-land-cover
datasets.summary: CORINE land cover imagery for the Rhone-Alpes region of France with terrain class labels.
datasets.description: A dataset derived from the CORINE Land Cover database for the Rhone-Alpes region of France. It provides imagery with an associated set of land cover classes describing the terrain. The dataset is intended for remote-sensing land cover classification tasks.

datasets.name: TerraMesh-Masks-Eval
datasets.summary: A human-verified zero-shot segmentation benchmark for evaluating open-vocabulary segmentation models on satellite imagery.
datasets.description: TerraMesh-Masks-Eval is a human-verified evaluation benchmark designed to assess open-vocabulary segmentation models on Earth observation imagery. It provides binary segmentation masks paired with captions and input samples drawn from TerraMesh, covering diverse land cover and built-up area types worldwide. A companion training dataset, TerraMesh-Masks, is also available, and data loading code is distributed via GitHub.
datasets.modality: Satellite imagery (Sentinel-1 / Sentinel-2) with segmentation masks

datasets.name: Pabna-PlanetScope-Jan2026
datasets.summary: PlanetScope satellite imagery covering the Pabna region of Bangladesh captured in January 2026.
datasets.description: Pabna-PlanetScope-Jan2026 is a small Earth observation imagery dataset consisting of PlanetScope satellite scenes over the Pabna region in Bangladesh, acquired in January 2026. It is distributed as image samples on Hugging Face for localized remote-sensing analysis.

datasets.name: PhilEOBench-building_density_regression
datasets.summary: A simulated PhiSat-2 / Sentinel-2 dataset for regressing per-pixel building coverage density.
datasets.description: This dataset, part of the PhilEO Bench collection, contains simulated multispectral satellite imagery derived from Sentinel-2 data and modeled after outputs of the PhiSat-2 satellite. Each sample includes a single-channel floating-point label representing the estimated percentage of building coverage within each 10-meter-resolution pixel. It is intended for training and evaluating models that predict building density as a continuous regression target from satellite imagery.

datasets.name: Core-S2L2A-249k-SatCLIP
datasets.summary: A geospatial-vision embedding dataset of 248,719 Sentinel-2 L2A patches encoded with the SatCLIP model.
datasets.description: Core-S2L2A-249k-SatCLIP provides 512-dimensional image embeddings computed from the Core-S2L2A-249k subset of the Major TOM Sentinel-2 archive using the SatCLIP model (ResNet-50 with a location encoder). All 12 Sentinel-2 spectral bands serve as input across 248,719 patches of 384x384 pixels. The embeddings are distributed in GeoParquet format with WGS-84 coordinates and UTM footprints for geospatial retrieval and analysis.

datasets.name: focus_investigaciones
datasets.summary: A climate-anomaly time-series dataset for Mexican states and municipalities derived from TerraClimate data.
datasets.description: focus_investigaciones is a geospatial climate dataset covering Mexico at national, state, and municipal levels. It contains monthly climate anomaly time series including precipitation anomalies, minimum and maximum temperature anomalies, and Palmer Drought Severity Index values, paired with geographic identifiers for Mexican administrative regions. The data combines TerraClimate remote-sensing measurements with geopolitical boundaries and spans roughly 1960 to 2022.

datasets.name: global-potholes-dataset
datasets.summary: A large-scale geospatial point dataset of pothole locations worldwide with latitude/longitude coordinates.
datasets.description: The Outerview Global Potholes Dataset is a geospatial collection of pothole locations distributed globally, each annotated with latitude and longitude coordinates. This release contains a 29,000-entry subset of a larger 3M+ pothole database maintained by Outerview as part of its effort to map physical infrastructure. Data is available in Parquet, CSV, and GeoJSON formats.

datasets.name: lunar-albedo
datasets.summary: High-resolution lunar surface albedo imagery tiles derived from NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) global mosaic.
datasets.description: Lunar-albedo provides albedo (reflectance) imagery of the Moon's surface derived from NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) Wide Angle Camera (WAC) global mosaic. The images are organized as a cube-face tile pyramid projected onto a cube-sphere mapping, with precise geographic and physical metadata (corner positions, resolution) for each tile. It is intended for planetary surface rendering and geospatial analysis.

datasets.name: ADU Detection
datasets.summary: Aerial/satellite imagery dataset for detecting Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) in residential parcels.
datasets.description: ADU Detection is a geospatial imagery dataset assembled by Stanford's RegLab for identifying Accessory Dwelling Units in residential areas from overhead photography. It pairs aerial/satellite image patches (with imagery from years such as 2016 and 2020) with metadata for object detection and change-over-time analysis. The collection contains roughly 38.6k rows and is distributed in WebDataset and Parquet formats.

datasets.name: Africa Synth Agriculture - Soil Moisture Monitoring (Nigeria)
datasets.summary: Synthetic soil-moisture monitoring dataset for Nigerian agriculture parameterized from published Sub-Saharan Africa literature.
datasets.description: This is a synthetic agricultural soil-moisture monitoring dataset for Nigeria, generated using reference statistics from FAO, NBS, NiMet, and FMARD. Each record captures sensor-style readings such as soil depth, moisture percentage, and irrigation triggers, organized under a weather and climate theme. It contains about 120,000 rows in CSV and Parquet formats; because it is synthetic, the authors caution it is not suitable for empirical analysis or policy inference.

datasets.name: Groundsource Enriched
datasets.summary: Enriched version of Google's Groundsource global flash-flood event database with decoded coordinates for 2.6M flood events.
datasets.description: Groundsource Enriched is a reprocessed version of Google's Groundsource dataset, described as the largest global flash-flood event database. The original stores flood-event boundaries as binary WKB geometry blobs; this version decodes all 2,646,302 polygon geometries into human-readable latitude/longitude centroids and adds derived columns to make the data easier to use. It supports geospatial analysis and time-series forecasting of global flood events.

datasets.name: PHDataset
datasets.summary: Global remote-sensing dataset for monocular building height estimation from PhiSat-2 optical satellite imagery.
datasets.description: PHDataset is a global remote-sensing dataset built for monocular building height estimation from PhiSat-2 optical imagery. It combines globally distributed PhiSat-2 scenes with open-source building-height labels from multiple sources, followed by manual georeferencing, rasterization, masking, and patch generation. It is intended to support research on building height estimation and ordinal regression from optical satellite imagery.

datasets.name: PhilEOBench - Road Density Regression
datasets.summary: Simulated PhiSat-2 (from Sentinel-2) benchmark for pixel-wise regression of road coverage percentage.
datasets.description: This PhilEOBench task provides simulated PhiSat-2 data derived from Sentinel-2 imagery, tailored for pixel-wise regression to estimate road coverage. Each sample includes a single-channel floating-point label representing the estimated percentage of road area within each 10-meter-resolution pixel. It is part of the ESA Phi-Lab PhilEO benchmark suite for evaluating Earth-observation foundation models.

datasets.name: AORC Texas Downscaling Sample
datasets.summary: Benchmark for statistical climate downscaling (super-resolution) of NOAA AORC 1 km reanalysis over Texas (2021-2024).
datasets.description: AORC Texas Downscaling is a benchmark dataset for statistical climate downscaling, i.e., super-resolution of meteorological fields, built from NOAA's Analysis of Record for Calibration (AORC) 1 km reanalysis data over Texas for 2021-2024. It supports training and evaluating models that reconstruct high-resolution 1 km fields from coarsened low-resolution inputs at five scaling factors (2x, 4x, 8x, 16x, 32x). The data originate from NOAA AORC reanalysis products.

datasets.name: ImpactMesh-Fire
datasets.summary: Large-scale multimodal, multitemporal Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2/DEM dataset for wildfire mapping released by IBM, DLR, and ESA Phi-Lab.
datasets.description: ImpactMesh-Fire is the wildfire subset of ImpactMesh, a large-scale multimodal, multitemporal Earth-observation dataset for flood and wildfire mapping. It integrates Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical imagery, and Copernicus DEM across four temporal stages (pre-month, pre-event, event, post-event), with high-quality annotations from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service. It contains about 22,000 samples spanning more than 200 fire events globally and was developed through the FAST-EO project by IBM, DLR, and ESA Phi-Lab.
datasets.modality: Sentinel-1 SAR / Sentinel-2 optical / Copernicus DEM

datasets.name: Similar But Different
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 multispectral patches selected as near-identical in RGB but differing in NIR, as a stress-test for visible-band-only models.
datasets.description: Similar But Different is a curated set of 72,897 32x32 Sentinel-2 L2A multispectral patches (12 bands resampled to 10 m), selected because each participates in at least one pair of patches that look nearly identical in true-colour RGB but differ substantially in near-infrared reflectance. This makes it a compact stress-test for land-cover models that rely only on the visible bands, where classes such as forest versus cropland or water can be confused. The dataset is intended for image classification and representation-learning evaluation.

datasets.name: Singapore Masterplans
datasets.summary: Geospatial land-use and zoning dataset of Singapore master-plan zones with polygon geometries.
datasets.description: Singapore Masterplans is a geospatial dataset capturing Singapore's official master-plan zones, with land-use descriptions, zoning classifications, and polygon boundary geometries. It contains roughly 670,898 records covering categories such as residential, commercial, parks, educational institutions, utilities, waterbodies, and roads, along with shape-area measurements. It is distributed in Parquet format (~2 GB) for urban-planning and geospatial analysis.

datasets.name: Strange Places - Mysterious Phenomena
datasets.summary: Georeferenced dataset of 354,770 mysterious-phenomena records compiled from NASA, NOAA, USGS, OpenStreetMap, and other authoritative databases.
datasets.description: Strange Places is a georeferenced point dataset aggregating 354,770 records of phenomena across 14 categories, including meteorites, fireballs, earthquakes, volcanoes, tornadoes, storm events, thermal springs, shipwrecks, caves, ghost towns, and reported sightings. Records are drawn from authoritative government and scientific sources such as NASA, NOAA, USGS, and OpenStreetMap, with 99.9% (354,544) carrying valid coordinates. It is part of the Data Trove collection and intended for geospatial feature extraction and analysis.

datasets.name: Africa Somalia Floods
datasets.summary: Subnational flood-impact observations for Somalia curated into ML-ready Parquet from OCHA Somalia / HDX reports.
datasets.description: Africa Somalia Floods is a tabular dataset of flood-impact observations for Somalia, sourced from OCHA Somalia via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX). Each row represents observations for a subnational administrative unit, drawn from preliminary reports by the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Disaster Management, South West State, and humanitarian partners. The data were last updated on HDX on 2025-09-24 and curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: Africa Synth Agriculture - Seasonal Rainfall Patterns (Nigeria)
datasets.summary: Synthetic dataset of seasonal rainfall patterns by Nigerian state parameterized from published Sub-Saharan Africa literature.
datasets.description: This synthetic dataset describes seasonal rainfall patterns across Nigerian states, including annual rainfall onset, cessation, totals, and dry spells. It was generated using reference statistics from FAO, NBS, NiMet, and FMARD and falls under a weather and climate theme. It contains roughly 500 rows in CSV and Parquet formats; because it is synthetic, the authors caution it is not suitable for empirical analysis or policy inference.

datasets.name: M2Change
datasets.summary: Multimodal, multi-temporal benchmark for building damage assessment in conflict zones using high-resolution optical and Sentinel-1 SAR.
datasets.description: M2Change is described as the first large-scale, publicly available benchmark for multimodal, multi-temporal building change detection in conflict zones. It pairs pre-event high-resolution (1 m) optical imagery with post-event multi-temporal Sentinel-1 SAR (10 m) time series to capture structural dynamics for building damage assessment in battlefield scenarios. The benchmark targets image segmentation and change-detection tasks.

datasets.name: Flood Binary HNM Benchmark
datasets.summary: A binary flood-detection benchmark of satellite/aerial imagery labeled flood vs. non-flood, with hard-negative mining over river scenes.
datasets.description: Flood Binary HNM Benchmark is a remote-sensing dataset pairing overhead imagery with binary flood/non-flood labels for flood-detection model training and evaluation. It includes river-scene samples and is structured to support hard-negative mining. The dataset contains roughly 4,154 samples (about 7.4 GB) of variable-resolution images in a single training split.

datasets.name: AgroGate SAR2NDVI Balanced
datasets.summary: A balanced Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 NDVI tile dataset of paddy fields in Sri Lanka labeled by field health status.
datasets.description: AgroGate SAR2NDVI Balanced is a geospatial agricultural dataset pairing Sentinel-1 SAR imagery with Sentinel-2 NDVI tiles for classifying paddy-field health (bare soil, moderate, healthy, very healthy). Tiles are at 10 m resolution, roughly 1.28 km wide, centered on paddy-field locations in Sri Lanka. The balanced version provides individually labeled tiles across the four health classes, split 70/15/15 into train/validation/test.

datasets.name: HalluBench
datasets.summary: A benchmark for evaluating hallucination in vision-language models on geospatial imagery across disaster-assessment and urban scene-understanding domains.
datasets.description: HalluBench is a geospatial VLM hallucination benchmark spanning two domains: emergency (disaster assessment using pre/post-disaster temporal image pairs) and urban (single-image scene understanding). It probes recognition, counting, spatial reasoning, and report generation across RGB and SAR modalities, with imagery derived from the DisasterM3 and EarthVL datasets. The benchmark comprises 200 questions (100 emergency, 100 urban), totaling about 448 MB.

datasets.name: Multimodal Sea-Land
datasets.summary: A multimodal sea-land segmentation dataset pairing Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 SAR imagery.
datasets.description: Multimodal Sea-Land is a remote-sensing dataset combining optical images from Sentinel-2 with SAR images from Sentinel-1 for sea-land segmentation and classification. The SAR imagery was acquired in Interferometric Wide Swath (IW) mode with both VV and VH polarizations. The dataset is intended for multimodal segmentation and land/water classification tasks.

datasets.name: OSM Global Power Grid
datasets.summary: Global electricity-infrastructure (power grid) data extracted from OpenStreetMap and converted to Parquet for analysis and ML.
datasets.description: OSM Global Power Grid is a geospatial dataset of worldwide electricity infrastructure extracted from OpenStreetMap and converted to Parquet format. It includes raw OSM ways tagged power=* as well as processed transmission grid nodes and edges. The snapshot is dated 2026-03-29 and is suitable for graph-ML and network-analysis tasks.

datasets.name: Urbex SML (Real Abandoned Locations)
datasets.summary: A curated geospatial dataset of 985 real abandoned and derelict locations sourced from OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API.
datasets.description: Urbex SML is a curated dataset of 985 real abandoned and derelict locations sourced directly from OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API. Every record corresponds to an actual tagged location, intended for research and documentation purposes. The data is geospatial point/feature information drawn from OSM tagging.

datasets.name: Benin Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Benin at subnational administrative levels, derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation and CHIRPS-GEFS forecasts.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Benin aggregated by subnational administrative units, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It was published by the WFP via HDX and curated into ML-ready Parquet format. Indicators support tabular regression and climate-monitoring analyses.

datasets.name: Rwanda Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Rwanda at subnational administrative levels, derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation and CHIRPS-GEFS forecasts.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Rwanda aggregated by subnational administrative units, computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite precipitation and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It was published by the WFP via HDX and curated into ML-ready Parquet format. The indicators support tabular regression and climate-monitoring tasks.

datasets.name: Climate Global Temperature by Country
datasets.summary: A tabular climate dataset of global temperature anomalies by country spanning 1961 to 2022.
datasets.description: Climate Global Temperature by Country is a small tabular climate dataset containing yearly temperature anomaly values organized by country (e.g., China, India, Poland, United States) and a World aggregate, covering 1961 to 2022. It comprises roughly 62 rows in Parquet format. The data is suited to climate-trend analysis and comparative warming studies across geographies.

datasets.name: Cyclone Dineo Windspeeds and Rainfall
datasets.summary: Tabular records of windspeeds (and rainfall) for Cyclone Dineo over Mozambique, curated into ML-ready Parquet format.
datasets.description: This dataset captures windspeeds (in miles per hour) and rainfall associated with Cyclone Dineo over Mozambique, with each row representing a tabular climate record. It was published by the Netherlands Red Cross (510) via HDX and curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa. The data supports tabular regression and disaster/climate analysis.

datasets.name: Tanzania Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Tanzania at subnational administrative levels, derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation and CHIRPS-GEFS forecasts.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for the United Republic of Tanzania aggregated by subnational administrative units, computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite precipitation and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. It was published by the WFP via HDX and curated into ML-ready Parquet format. The indicators support tabular regression and climate-monitoring analyses.

datasets.name: IndLands
datasets.summary: A spatiotemporal multi-source remote sensing dataset for region-aware landslide-prone area analysis across several Indian states.
datasets.description: IndLands is a landslide-analysis dataset built from multi-source remote sensing imagery and machine learning techniques to characterize landslide-prone areas. It covers multiple Indian states including Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Himachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Maharashtra, and Karnataka. The repository includes the complete workflow and supporting files used to generate the labeled dataset.

datasets.name: neon-tree-crowns-dta
datasets.summary: A unified, species-labeled tree-crown polygon dataset covering 38 NEON sites, combining algorithmic and hand-annotated crowns.
datasets.description: NEON Tree Crowns (DTA edition) is a species-labeled tree-crown polygon set spanning 38 NEON sites in the United States, combining algorithmic crowns from the DeepTreeAttention (DTA) pipeline with hand-annotated bounding boxes and polygons curated by the Weecology lab. It contains 41,738 crowns for 39,702 unique individual trees across 234 species (NEON taxonID). The data is distributed as a single GeoPackage (neon_crowns_dta.gpkg) in EPSG:4326 (WGS84) with native UTM zone recorded.

datasets.name: Thermal-UAV
datasets.summary: A cross-modal thermal geo-localization dataset of UAV thermal queries referenced against satellite ortho-imagery and a digital surface model.
datasets.description: Thermal-UAV is a dataset for cross-modal thermal geo-localization introduced in the paper SCC-Loc: A Unified Semantic Cascade Consensus Framework for UAV Thermal Geo-Localization. It is designed for UAVs operating in GNSS-denied environments and addresses the modality gap between thermal queries and visible-light satellite imagery. The dataset provides 11,890 diverse thermal queries referenced against a large-scale satellite ortho-photo and a corresponding spatially aligned Digital Surface Model (DSM).

datasets.name: MONITRS
datasets.summary: A multimodal dataset of ~10,000 FEMA disaster events with temporal Sentinel-2 imagery, news-derived captions, geotagged locations, and QA pairs.
datasets.description: MONITRS (Multimodal Observations of Natural Incidents Through Remote Sensing) contains approximately 10,000 FEMA disaster events paired with temporal Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, natural-language captions extracted from news articles, geotagged locations, and question-answer pairs for disaster monitoring research. It supports tasks including event classification, temporal grounding, location grounding, and visual question answering. The dataset was published at NeurIPS 2025 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track, Spotlight).

datasets.name: ts-aims-reefscapes-satellite-segmentation
datasets.summary: A satellite imagery segmentation dataset for coral reefscapes curated by the Australian Institute of Marine Science.
datasets.description: ts-aims-reefscapes-satellite-segmentation is a satellite imagery dataset oriented toward semantic segmentation of coral reef environments (reefscapes). It is published by AIMS (Australian Institute of Marine Science) collaborators on Hugging Face. The dataset supports segmentation of marine and reef features from satellite observations.

datasets.name: WildFire-X
datasets.summary: A geospatial dataset of satellite-derived vegetation indices and climate variables for wildfire prediction and risk assessment.
datasets.description: WildFire-X is an Earth observation dataset combining satellite-derived spectral and vegetation indices (e.g., NDVI, EVI, and spectral bands) with meteorological variables such as temperature, precipitation, humidity, and wind speed. It includes fire danger indices (FWI, FFMC, DMC, DC, ISI, BUI) and burn probability targets for wildfire prediction and risk modeling. Data is provided as CSV files with spatial coordinates and temporal target dates across train, validation, and test splits.

datasets.name: dual-validation-multispectral
datasets.summary: A machine-learning-ready multitemporal multispectral satellite dataset for cloud gap imputation and stratified model evaluation.
datasets.description: dual-validation-multispectral is a machine-learning-ready, multitemporal satellite dataset designed for cloud gap imputation and stratified model evaluation. It is the foundational dataset for the framework introduced in "A Dual Validation Framework for Curating Machine Learning-Ready Satellite Datasets: A Scalable Pipeline and Stratified Analysis." The data is curated from standard Analysis-Ready Data (ARD) and includes intrinsic radiometric validation.

datasets.name: mapit-postcode-pmtiles
datasets.summary: UK postcode unit boundaries packaged as cloud-optimized PMTiles vector map tiles.
datasets.description: mapit-postcode-pmtiles provides open-data Great Britain postcode unit boundaries in the PMTiles format, a cloud-optimized vector map tile format suited for web mapping. The geometries are derived from authoritative UK sources, including Ordnance Survey, Royal Mail, and the Office for National Statistics. The dataset reflects 2020 data holdings and is approximately 850 MB in size.

datasets.name: africa-com-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Comoros aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Comoros computed from the CHIRPS satellite-plus-station precipitation dataset (version 2) together with CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Values are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include per-dekad rainfall amounts and anomalies. It is published by the WFP via HDX and curated into ML-ready format.

datasets.name: africa-somalia-flood-may-2018
datasets.summary: Subnational district-level counts of people affected by the May 2018 Somalia floods, curated into ML-ready format.
datasets.description: This dataset records the number of people affected by the May 2018 flooding in Somalia at the district (subnational administrative unit) level. Each row represents a subnational administrative unit observation, with geographic scope SOM. The data originates from OCHA Somalia via HDX and was curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: Core-S2RGB-249k-SigLIP
datasets.summary: A vision-language embedding dataset computed from Sentinel-2 L2A RGB patches using the SigLIP model.
datasets.description: Core-S2RGB-249k-SigLIP is a vision-language embedding dataset derived from the Core-S2L2A-249k collection of 248,719 Sentinel-2 Level-2A patches (384x384 px). Each patch's RGB bands (B04, B03, B02) are encoded with SigLIP (ViT-SO400M-14-SigLIP-384) into 1152-dimensional embeddings. The embeddings are distributed in GeoParquet format as part of the Major TOM ecosystem.

datasets.name: fema-nfip-flood-insurance-claims
datasets.summary: Two million-plus geocoded FEMA National Flood Insurance Program claims since 1978 with flood-zone and risk attributes.
datasets.description: This dataset contains paid National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) claims from FEMA spanning 1978 to the present, cleaned, enriched, and geocoded. Records include latitude/longitude coordinates, ZIP and county codes, flood zone classifications, base and lowest-floor flood elevations, coverage amounts, building characteristics, damage breakdowns, and derived ZIP-level risk scores. It is intended for flood risk modeling, climate finance, and real-estate analytics.

datasets.name: africa-bwa-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Botswana aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Botswana, computed from the satellite-based Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 product and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Values are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include indicators such as 10-day rainfall totals and anomalies. It is published by the WFP and sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: africa-cpv-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Cabo Verde aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Cabo Verde, computed from the satellite-based Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 product and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Values are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include indicators such as 10-day rainfall totals and anomalies. It is published by the WFP and sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: climatehackai-2023
datasets.summary: Satellite imagery, weather forecasts and PV generation data for site-level solar power nowcasting from the ClimateHack.AI 2023-24 competition.
datasets.description: The ClimateHack.AI 2023 dataset bundles over 600 GB of data used to develop machine learning models for predicting near-term, site-level solar power production in Great Britain. It includes high-resolution visible (HRV) and 11-channel non-HRV EUMETSAT geostationary satellite imagery at 5-minute resolution, Deutscher Wetterdienst numerical weather predictions, ECMWF air quality forecasts, and historical solar PV generation data from live UK systems. The competition supports the solar nowcasting research of Open Climate Fix.

datasets.name: conus-h3-land-cover
datasets.summary: Continental US land cover density (NLCD 2024) aggregated to Uber's H3 hexagonal grid at resolution 10 (~120 m cells).
datasets.description: CONUS H3 Land Cover Density is a continental United States land cover dataset derived from the USGS National Land Cover Database (NLCD) 2024 and aggregated onto Uber's H3 hexagonal grid at resolution 10 (~120 m cell edge length). Unlike NLCD's native discrete classification, each cell expresses land cover as continuous per-channel coverage fractions, so a cell on a forest-wetland boundary is represented as, e.g., 0.6 forest and partial wetland. This makes it suitable for soft, multi-channel land cover analysis over very large hexagonal grids.

datasets.name: FWISD
datasets.summary: High-resolution UAV imagery dataset for semantic segmentation of floodwaters and waterfront infrastructure after Hurricane Francine.
datasets.description: The Flood and Waterfront Infrastructure Segmentation Dataset (FWISD) is built for post-disaster assessment, focusing on the impact of Hurricane Francine (September 2024). It uses high-resolution UAV (drone) imagery to enable precise semantic segmentation of floodwaters, infrastructure damage, and environmental elements. The total dataset size is approximately 4.36 GB.

datasets.name: insar-regional-snow-mapping
datasets.summary: Sentinel-1 InSAR stacks paired with snow products and ERA5 weather variables for pixel-wise snow depth and SWE regression over the Italian Alps.
datasets.description: The InSAR Regional Snow Mapping dataset pairs Sentinel-1 InSAR stacks with IT-SNOW snow products and ERA5-derived weather variables over the Italian Alps (Trentino region). It is designed for pixel-wise regression of Snow Depth (HS) and Snow Water Equivalent (SWE). The data covers a bounding box of roughly 9.80-10.87 deg E and 45.93-46.40 deg N in EPSG:4326, with rasters of 93 x 211 pixels at approximately 500 m spatial resolution.

datasets.name: Landsat30-AU
datasets.summary: Large-scale Landsat vision-language dataset (captions and VQA) over Australia spanning 36+ years of 30 m imagery.
datasets.description: Landsat30-AU is a large-scale vision-language dataset built from 30-meter resolution imagery across Landsat 5, 7, 8, and 9 over Australia, spanning more than 36 years. It is introduced in an AAAI 2026 paper and targets low-resolution, multi-satellite, long-term global monitoring. The release includes Landsat30-AU-Cap with 196,262 image-caption pairs and Landsat30-AU-VQA with 17,725 human-verified visual question-answer pairs.

datasets.name: QFabric
datasets.summary: Multi-task urban change detection dataset combining change-type classification, change-status tracking, and neighborhood context over multi-date high-resolution satellite imagery.
datasets.description: QFabric is a labeled dataset for multi-task urban change detection, combining change-type classification, change-status tracking, and neighborhood context across a multi-date, high-resolution satellite record. It was introduced at the EarthVision workshop at CVPR 2021. The dataset supports research into how urban areas change over time from satellite observations.

datasets.name: ValaisCD
datasets.summary: High-resolution aerial change detection dataset of building changes in Valais, Switzerland (2017 vs 2023) from SWISSIMAGE 10 cm imagery.
datasets.description: ValaisCD is a high-resolution change detection dataset built from SwissTopo SWISSIMAGE 10 cm aerial imagery, covering several urban and peri-urban regions of the canton of Valais, Switzerland. It provides pairs of aerial images captured in 2017 and 2023, along with automatically generated building-change labels. It is intended for building change detection and semantic segmentation tasks.

datasets.name: virtualizarr-stores
datasets.summary: VirtualiZarr/Kerchunk Parquet catalog providing cloud-native access to the NOAA CMORPH global precipitation archive (1998-2024).
datasets.description: This dataset is a Parquet-based virtual dataset (VDS) catalog for the NOAA CMORPH (CPC MORPHing technique) global precipitation product, hosted on AWS S3. Built with VirtualiZarr and Kerchunk, it provides a single-file index over 236,688 NetCDF files spanning January 1998 to October 2024, enabling cloud-native, Zarr-style access to the entire CMORPH precipitation archive without downloading individual files.

datasets.name: world-cities
datasets.summary: Structured geospatial dataset of 5,979 world cities with population above 100,000, including coordinates, timezone, and elevation.
datasets.description: The World Cities Dataset 2026 is a structured tabular dataset of 5,979 cities worldwide with population above 100,000. Each record includes a GeoNames unique identifier, city name, ISO 2-letter country code, population, latitude and longitude coordinates, IANA timezone, and elevation. It is suitable for geocoding, mapping, and city-level geospatial analysis.

datasets.name: africa-uga-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Uganda aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Uganda, computed from the satellite-based Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 product and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Values are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include indicators such as 10-day rainfall totals and anomalies. It is published by the WFP and sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: asia-faostat-cropland-nutrient-balance-esb
datasets.summary: FAOSTAT cropland nutrient balance indicators for 44 Asian countries from 1961-2023.
datasets.description: This dataset contains the FAOSTAT Cropland Nutrient Balance domain (domain code ESB) filtered to 44 Asian countries, covering the period 1961-2023 with 151,944 rows across 12 items and 9 elements. It is published by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and provides country-level agricultural nutrient balance statistics relevant to land and cropland analysis. The data is drawn from FAOSTAT, one of the most comprehensive statistical databases on food, agriculture, and rural development.

datasets.name: ChangeChat-105k
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing change-analysis instruction-tuning dataset of ~105k vision-language samples built on bi-temporal satellite image pairs.
datasets.description: ChangeChat-105k is a remote-sensing image change-analysis (RSICA) instruction-tuning dataset containing roughly 105,000 annotated samples derived from 10,077 bi-temporal image pairs in the LEVIR-CC dataset. It pairs before-and-after satellite imagery with instruction-following conversations covering change captioning, binary classification, change quantification, spatial localization, open-ended QA, and multi-turn dialogue. Annotations are provided in ShareGPT-style conversation format and reference the underlying LEVIR-CC imagery, which is not redistributed. The dataset is associated with the DeltaVLM paper (arXiv:2507.22346).

datasets.name: global-dense-satellite
datasets.summary: Globally distributed, dense hierarchical satellite imagery tiles for evaluating hierarchical satellite-generation models.
datasets.description: global-dense-satellite is a globally distributed collection of dense, hierarchical satellite imagery designed as an out-of-distribution evaluation set for hierarchical satellite-generation models trained on Git-10M. It contains 20,608 satellite tiles across 256 sites worldwide, structured as complete parent-child quadtrees spanning zoom level 10 down to zoom level 18. Each row is one satellite tile, and every tile is guaranteed disjoint from the location set used in Git-10M.

datasets.name: mapterhorn
datasets.summary: A large geospatial collection of cloud-optimized PMTiles map-tile archives covering roughly 250 GB of tiled geographic data.
datasets.description: Mapterhorn is a geospatial dataset consisting of pyramid map-tile (PMTiles) archives, a compressed, cloud-optimized format for geographic tile data. It contains on the order of 58,000 rows totaling about 250 GB, distributed as WebDataset tar shards with an auto-converted Parquet view available. The tiles cover map data suitable for mapping, GIS, and remote-sensing applications.

datasets.name: sgw-resilience-data
datasets.summary: A per-(storm, county) feature table for predicting hurricane power-outage impact across the US Southeast and Gulf coast.
datasets.description: sgw-resilience-data is a hurricane outage feature table for predicting power-outage impact across the US Southeast and Gulf coast, built entirely from public sources. Each row pairs a landfalling hurricane with a county, the county's exposure and its proximity to the storm track, and the observed peak number of customers left without power. The dataset comprises a model table of 27,216 rows (28 storms by 972 counties) along with companion storm and county files.

datasets.name: africa-mrt-rainfall-subnational
datasets.summary: Dekadal rainfall indicators for Mauritania aggregated by subnational administrative unit, derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation data.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Mauritania computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts, aggregated by subnational administrative unit. It is published by the WFP - World Food Programme and sourced from HDX. The data was curated into ML-ready Parquet format and supports monitoring of precipitation and drought conditions.

datasets.name: Deventer-512
datasets.summary: The first public benchmark for All-Class Polygonal Vectorization, mapping all land-cover classes from aerial imagery as gap-free shared-boundary polygons.
datasets.description: Deventer-512 is the benchmark dataset introduced in the paper 'ACPV-Net: All-Class Polygonal Vectorization for Seamless Vector Map Generation from Aerial Imagery.' It is the first public benchmark for All-Class Polygonal Vectorization (ACPV), a task that generates a complete vector map from aerial imagery in a single run by producing polygons for all land-cover classes with shared boundaries and without gaps or overlaps. The data is provided as 512-pixel aerial image tiles with polygonal annotations.

datasets.name: satellite-inferno-detector-dataset
datasets.summary: A satellite imagery dataset of ~10k images for training wildfire detection models.
datasets.description: The satellite-inferno-detector-dataset is a remote-sensing dataset of satellite imagery curated for wildfire detection. It contains 10,068 images at 640x640 pixel resolution, split into 9,290 training, 391 validation, and 386 test images, distributed as Parquet files. The dataset is intended for training machine learning models to identify wildfire signatures in satellite imagery.

datasets.name: uke-mobile-network-permits-poland
datasets.summary: A GeoParquet dataset of geolocated radio permits for cellular base stations across Poland issued by the national telecom regulator.
datasets.description: This dataset contains radio permits issued by the Polish Office of Electronic Communications (Urzad Komunikacji Elektronicznej, UKE) for cellular base stations across all bands, including GSM 900/1800, GSM-R, UMTS 900/2100, LTE 420-2600, 5G 700-3600, and CDMA 420. It is a single GeoParquet file in WGS84 (EPSG:4326) with one row per permit, per station, per band, each carrying station coordinates. The dataset supports geospatial analysis of mobile network infrastructure and coverage in Poland.

datasets.name: africa-nigeria-nema-flood-affected-geographical-areas
datasets.summary: Subnational records of flood-affected people and locations across Nigeria, curated into an ML-ready format.
datasets.description: This dataset contains information on flood-affected people and locations in Nigeria, published by OCHA Nigeria and sourced from HDX. Each row represents a subnational administrative unit observation, with geographic scope covering Nigeria (NGA). The data was curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa and supports analysis of flood disaster impact.

datasets.name: BIRCH-Trees
datasets.summary: A UAV-imagery benchmark for estimating individual tree height and species across Quebec and tropical forest sites.
datasets.description: BIRCH-Trees (Benchmark for Individual tRee Characterization from drone imagery) is the official benchmark introduced in the paper 'Estimating Individual Tree Height and Species from UAV Imagery.' It bundles several UAV/drone imagery sub-datasets, including Quebec Trees, BCI, and Quebec Plantations, with annotations for individual tree height and species. The benchmark supports remote-sensing analysis of forest structure and composition from aerial drone imagery.

datasets.name: coffee-segmentation-dataset
datasets.summary: A semantic-segmentation dataset for mapping coffee plantations and eucalyptus in the Brazilian Cerrado from Sentinel-1 SAR and Planet NICFI time series.
datasets.description: The Coffee Plantation Segmentation Dataset is a semantic-segmentation dataset for mapping coffee plantations and eucalyptus in the Brazilian Cerrado using Sentinel-1 SAR time series. It accompanies the paper 'Exploiting Convolutional and Transformer Networks for Coffee Plantation Mapping in Brazil Using Polarimetric-Spectral-Temporal Data from Sentinel-1 and Planet NICFI Time Series.' The data combines polarimetric, spectral, and temporal features for land-cover segmentation.

datasets.name: Northeast-India-Districts-and-Villages
datasets.summary: Administrative geospatial index of 49,275 villages across India's eight Northeast states with state, district, and rural/urban classifications.
datasets.description: A comprehensive administrative-geography dataset mapping 49,275 villages across the eight Northeast Indian states and 132 districts. Each record provides state name, district name, village name, and a settlement category (rural, semi-urban, or urban). Sourced from the Government of India's Local Government Directory (LGDirectory), it supports GIS mapping, location entity recognition, and regional development planning.

datasets.name: UrbanBuildings-Satellite-1K
datasets.summary: A collection of 1,000 high-resolution satellite images of urban buildings for remote-sensing computer vision tasks.
datasets.description: UrbanBuildings-Satellite-1K is a satellite imagery dataset containing 1,000 images of urban buildings, each at 768x768 pixel resolution. It captures aerial/satellite views of urban structures and development patterns. The dataset is suited for building detection, urban classification, and object recognition in remote-sensing applications.

datasets.name: ArcticDEM 32m Mosaic
datasets.summary: A pan-Arctic 32 m resolution digital elevation mosaic derived from the Polar Geospatial Center's ArcticDEM project.
datasets.description: A publicly accessible digital elevation mosaic covering the Arctic region north of approximately 60 degrees N, including Greenland, Canada, Russia, and Alaska, at 32 m horizontal resolution. The data are distributed as GeoTIFFs in the NSIDC Polar Stereographic North projection (EPSG:3413) with a WGS84 vertical datum. Derived from the University of Minnesota Polar Geospatial Center's ArcticDEM initiative (funded by NSF and NGA), it supports terrain analysis, environmental modeling, and Arctic research.

datasets.name: b-FLAIR-test-spot
datasets.summary: An evaluation dataset of 1,730 SPOT-6/7 satellite image pairs with binary masks for building change detection.
datasets.description: b-FLAIR-test-spot is an evaluation dataset for building change detection containing 1,730 annotated image pairs with binary building-change masks. It is built from b-FLAIR-test by downloading SPOT-6/7 satellite acquisitions at the same dates and locations for each patch. The dataset is designed for in-domain evaluation of methods trained on b-FLAIR-spot.

datasets.name: cil-regionalization
datasets.summary: A tabular climate dataset of regional temperature projection statistics by country across three future time periods.
datasets.description: A climate-weather dataset of regional climate projections containing 492 rows of temperature-related statistics organized by country and region. It provides ISO country codes and statistical measures (mean, 5th percentile, median, and 95th percentile) for three future periods: 2020-2039, 2040-2059, and 2080-2099. Coverage is global, spanning countries, territories, and select geographic features.

datasets.name: climate-krakow-temp-monthly
datasets.summary: A monthly temperature time-series climate dataset for the city of Krakow, Poland.
datasets.description: climate-krakow-temp-monthly is a climate-weather dataset containing monthly temperature records for Krakow, Poland. It is intended for climate time-series analysis and forecasting tasks at a local scale.

datasets.name: Core-S2L2A-249k-OlmoEarth-Base
datasets.summary: Pre-computed OlmoEarth-Base foundation-model embeddings for the Major-TOM Core-S2L2A-249k Sentinel-2 L2A imagery subset.
datasets.description: This dataset contains pre-computed image embeddings for the Core-S2L2A-249k Sentinel-2 L2A satellite imagery subset (248,719 patches), generated using the OlmoEarth-Base Earth-system foundation model. OlmoEarth is trained on Sentinel-2 L2A imagery and several derived geospatial maps (OpenStreetMap, WorldCover, SRTM DEM, etc.) using a multi-modal vision transformer. The embeddings enable downstream remote-sensing tasks such as retrieval, classification, and similarity search.

datasets.name: Core-S2RGB-249k-FarSLIP
datasets.summary: Vision-language FarSLIP embeddings computed from the Major-TOM Core-S2L2A-249k Sentinel-2 RGB imagery subset.
datasets.description: Core-S2RGB-249k-FarSLIP is a vision-language embedding dataset computed from the Core-S2L2A-249k Sentinel-2 imagery (248,719 patches at 384x384 px) using the FarSLIP model, a CLIP variant fine-tuned for remote sensing. RGB bands (B04, B03, B02) are used as input to produce 768-dimensional embeddings stored in GeoParquet format. It supports remote-sensing image-text retrieval and zero-shot classification.

datasets.name: Nigeria Health Facilities
datasets.summary: A georeferenced registry of 46,146 health facilities across Nigeria, processed into an ML-ready format.
datasets.description: This dataset is a comprehensive, machine-learning-ready registry of health facilities in Nigeria sourced from GRID3 (Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development). Each of the 46,146 records includes the facility's primary name, type, ownership, operational status, and precise latitude/longitude coordinates. It supports geospatial analysis tasks such as health-infrastructure mapping, accessibility analysis, and service planning.

datasets.name: ImpactMesh-Flood
datasets.summary: A large-scale multimodal, multitemporal remote-sensing dataset for flood mapping built from Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and Copernicus DEM data.
datasets.description: ImpactMesh-Flood is the flood subset of ImpactMesh, a large-scale multimodal and multitemporal Earth-observation dataset released by IBM, DLR, and the ESA Phi-lab. It integrates Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical imagery, and Copernicus DEM with high-quality flood annotations derived from Copernicus EMS. Each sample provides four temporal snapshots (pre-month, pre-event, event, and post-event) covering 200+ global flood events, enabling change-detection and flood-mapping research.
datasets.task: Flood mapping / semantic segmentation / feature extraction
datasets.modality: Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, Copernicus DEM

datasets.name: Zamba SAT Congo Deforestation
datasets.summary: A Sentinel-2 satellite dataset of annotated bitemporal observations for detecting deforestation in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
datasets.description: This dataset focuses on detecting deforestation in the Democratic Republic of Congo using Sentinel-2 satellite imagery from three regions: Kindu (Maniema), Lusambo (Sankuru), and the Yangambi research forest frontier. Each record provides dual-temporal RGB and SWIR satellite images (t0 and t1) along with geographic coordinates, deforestation labels (detection status, change patterns, severity, clearing type), cloud-cover measurements, and analytical reasoning. It supports supervised change detection and land-use transformation analysis over time.

datasets.name: Landslide SAT All
datasets.summary: A satellite imagery dataset with segmentation masks for landslide detection.
datasets.description: This dataset contains optical satellite imagery paired with annotation masks for landslide identification and delineation. Each sample comprises a 512x512 pixel satellite image and its corresponding segmentation mask marking landslide-affected regions. It is split into train (4,040), validation (1,010), and test (1,260) subsets for semantic segmentation of landslides.

datasets.name: Mineset
datasets.summary: A high-resolution remote-sensing dataset with pixel-level annotations for open-pit mine extraction.
datasets.description: The Mineset dataset is a high-resolution remote-sensing dataset for semantic segmentation of open-pit mining areas. It provides georeferenced GeoTIFF imagery paired with pixel-level semantic annotations of mine sites. It accompanies the paper 'Height Knowledge-Guided Open-Pit Mine Extraction Network for High-Resolution Remote Sensing Imagery' published in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters.

datasets.name: NOAA Storm Events Database
datasets.summary: A georeferenced database of U.S. storm events recorded by NOAA NCEI from 1950 to the present.
datasets.description: The NOAA Storm Events Database catalogues storm and severe-weather events recorded by the NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) since 1950, spanning tornadoes, floods, hurricanes, hail, lightning, and dozens of other event types across all U.S. states and territories. Records include event type, damage estimates, injuries, deaths, begin/end latitude-longitude coordinates, state and county FIPS codes, and temporal details. This Hugging Face repository provides a 1,000-row public-domain sample of the Details table, with the full database covering 1.94 million-plus events.

datasets.name: sentinel-2-reanalysis-NDVI-EVI-TCG
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 raw bands and reanalysis vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI, TCG) aggregated over Hungarian sunflower crop fields.
datasets.description: This dataset contains Sentinel-2 raw bands together with reanalysis vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI, TCG) and valid-pixel fractions per field. Each parquet file holds multiple sunflower crop fields identified by field_id, with 36 time steps per year produced as 10-day-interval aggregations of scaled and filtered band and index values. Field polygons were sourced from Google Earth Engine project assets, covering fields in Hungary.

datasets.name: sentinel-2-rgb-captioned
datasets.summary: Cloud-filtered Sentinel-2 RGB tiles paired with CLIP-generated captions for terrain image generation.
datasets.description: A dataset of Sentinel-2 (COPERNICUS_S2_SR) RGB tiles processed by selecting low-cloud regions, taking the median composite over a fixed timespan, and normalizing RGB by per-channel min/max values. Each tile is captioned using openai/clip-vit-large-patch14 against a fixed caption set, with tiles containing black regions or overlap lines filtered out. The dataset was built for the terrain-diffusion image-generation project.

datasets.name: ship-detection
datasets.summary: A small remote-sensing image subset with bounding-box annotations for ship detection.
datasets.description: This dataset is a subset of the Ship Detection Competition data organized by Data-Driven Science. It contains 10 remote-sensing images of ships together with a JSON file giving the bounding-box coordinates of the ships present in each image. It is intended as a compact teaching/example subset for object detection in overhead imagery.

datasets.name: temporal-aerial-cityline-construction-sample
datasets.summary: A multiview temporal aerial imagery sample for monitoring urban construction and change over time.
datasets.description: A sample dataset of temporal, multiview aerial imagery capturing urban cityline construction. It is tagged for image classification, semantic segmentation, object detection, and change detection tasks. The temporal aspect supports tracking construction progress and land-cover change across acquisition dates.
