datasets.name: california-wildfire-feature-set
datasets.summary: Normalized daily geospatial feature maps over California for wildfire modeling, split temporally for training.
datasets.description: This dataset provides normalized daily feature maps used for wildfire-modeling training. Features are stored as per-row tensors with shape [C, H, W] in parquet splits (train, validation, test) with normalization statistics fitted on the training split. The temporal split policy covers training from 2012 to 2021, validation in 2022, and testing in 2023.

datasets.name: global-dense-instances
datasets.summary: Global dense satellite imagery with instance-level annotations.
datasets.description: Global Dense Satellite - Instance Annotations (v1.0) is a dataset of satellite/remote-sensing imagery paired with dense instance-level annotations. It targets classification and detection tasks over globally distributed scenes.

datasets.name: WildFire-Y
datasets.summary: A tabular geospatial classification dataset of fire / no-fire labels indexed by spatial coordinates and date.
datasets.description: WildFire-Y is a tabular wildfire classification dataset containing roughly 59,710 rows with fire/no-fire (type_class) labels keyed by target_date and spatial row/col coordinates. It is split into training (~47.5k), validation (~10.3k), and test (~1.89k) subsets. The dataset pairs with the California wildfire feature set for wildfire detection and classification modeling.

datasets.name: Core-S2RGB-249k-DINOv2
datasets.summary: DINOv2-large vision embeddings computed from 249k Sentinel-2 L2A RGB patches in the Major-TOM Core collection.
datasets.description: Core-S2RGB-249k-DINOv2 is a vision-only embedding dataset computed from the Core-S2L2A-249k collection (248,719 patches of 384x384 px). Each 384x384 Sentinel-2 L2A RGB patch (bands B04, B03, B02) is encoded with the DINOv2-large model (facebook/dinov2-large) to produce 768-dimensional embeddings. The embeddings are distributed in GeoParquet format as part of the Major-TOM ecosystem.

datasets.name: low-alt-satellite-image-dataset-5k
datasets.summary: 5,000 low-altitude satellite/aerial images with geographic coordinates and road-type labels.
datasets.description: This dataset comprises 5,000 low-altitude satellite/aerial images collected globally, each paired with metadata including latitude/longitude coordinates and highway/road-type annotations (primary, secondary, residential, etc.). The data is provided in parquet format spanning roughly 13.5 GB. It supports geospatial computer-vision tasks such as road-infrastructure classification.

datasets.name: modis-snow-coverage
datasets.summary: MODIS-derived fractional snow-cover imagery for 2013 with fused bands, cloud masks, and SPOT reference data.
datasets.description: This dataset contains imagery acquired by the MODIS sensor during 2013, organized by date. Each folder provides a fused 7-band image at 250 m resolution, a cloud mask, fractional snow cover from MODImLAB, NDSI-based fractional snow fraction, and SPOT-derived fractional snow cover resampled to 250 m at matching dates. It is suited for snow-cover estimation and validation studies.

datasets.name: Sentinel2RGBNorway
datasets.summary: Preprocessed Sentinel-2 RGB satellite tiles over Norway derived from GeoNorge / Copernicus data.
datasets.description: Sentinel2RGBNorway is a dataset of Sentinel-2 RGB satellite imagery covering Norway, built from GeoNorge (Kartverket) and Copernicus Sentinel-2 (2018) data. The tiles have been heavily preprocessed by cropping, applying gamma correction, resizing to 256x256, and additional filtering. It is distributed under CC BY 4.0 with required attribution to Copernicus Sentinel-2 data processed by Statens Kartverk.

datasets.name: v2rmp-routes
datasets.summary: A small aerial-route geospatial dataset published on Hugging Face for routing/aerial-services analysis.
datasets.description: v2rmp-routes is a compact geospatial dataset hosted on Hugging Face by Aerial Blanca Services. It is tagged as geospatial aerial-route data and is provided in JSON/Parquet form for analysis of routes. The dataset is minimal in size and is primarily distributed via the Hugging Face datasets library.

datasets.name: Tanzania Cyclone (ADAM 1001060)
datasets.summary: ML-ready tabular disaster-impact records for the May 2024 tropical-storm cyclone affecting Tanzania, Seychelles, and Comoros.
datasets.description: This dataset captures the May 2024 cyclone (tropical storm, ADAM ID 1001060_10) that affected Tanzania, Seychelles, and the Comoros between 1-4 May 2024, impacting roughly 8,846 people. The records are derived from the WFP Advanced Disaster Analysis & Mapping (ADAM) system via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and curated into a machine-learning-ready tabular format. Each row represents tabular disaster-impact records with a geographic scope of Tanzania (TZA), suitable for tabular classification and regression.

datasets.name: FireGuard Sentinel-2 Wildfire Precursor
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 multispectral false-color image sequences labeled for pre-fire vegetation-moisture and wildfire-precursor detection.
datasets.description: FireGuard Sentinel-2 Wildfire Precursor is a remote-sensing dataset for satellite wildfire-risk assessment. Each sample provides Sentinel-2 multispectral false-color composite imagery captured at multiple time points before a reference date, designed for analyzing pre-fire vegetation-moisture conditions. Samples carry binary labels (fire vs. no-fire) and are split into train, validation, and test sets for precursor-detection modeling.

datasets.name: Biele Karpaty Landslides
datasets.summary: Expert-annotated landslide segmentation dataset over the Biele Karpaty mountains in Slovakia, combining LiDAR-derived terrain layers with Sentinel-2 imagery.
datasets.description: This landslide dataset was created by the State Geological Institute of Dionyz Stur and the Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies, covering the Biele Karpaty mountain range in western Slovakia. It combines eleven geospatial layers, including a 1 m LiDAR-derived Digital Elevation Model, aspect, curvature, hillshade, NDVI, roughness, and slope, alongside Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, in both raw and processed forms. It contains 2,110 expert-annotated landslides across roughly 606 km2, organized into train, validation, and test splits for semantic segmentation.

datasets.name: Nigeria Education Accessibility Indicators
datasets.summary: Geospatial indicators of population accessibility to schools across Nigerian administrative units using travel-time isochrones.
datasets.description: Nigeria Education Accessibility Indicators provides spatial accessibility metrics for education services across Nigeria. It uses travel-time isochrones to estimate the population within distance intervals from schools, aggregated to administrative units from ADM1 to ADM4. The dataset is delivered in geospatial and tabular form with fields for region name, ISO3 country code, administrative level, and accessibility category.

datasets.name: SatelliteSegmentation (Sentinel-2 / WorldCover)
datasets.summary: Paired Sentinel-2 RGB tiles and ESA WorldCover-derived land-cover masks at 10 m resolution for semantic segmentation.
datasets.description: SatelliteSegmentation contains paired Sentinel-2 L2A RGB image tiles and corresponding land-cover masks derived from ESA WorldCover, prepared for semantic segmentation. Each example provides a 256x256 RGB image and an integer-labelled mask, aligned to the Sentinel-2 grid at 10 m resolution in EPSG:4326. Imagery is sourced from Sentinel-2 via the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog.

datasets.name: Structures Damaged by Wildfire
datasets.summary: Over 18,000 Cal Fire damage-assessment photos of California structures damaged by wildfire (2020-2022), labeled by damage severity.
datasets.description: This dataset contains over 18,000 images of structures damaged by wildfire in California between 2020 and 2022, captured by the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (Cal Fire) during damage assessment. It spans more than 18 wildfire events, including the 2020 August Complex Fire. Images are labeled by damage class (e.g., affected, destroyed, inaccessible) for image classification and damage-assessment tasks.

datasets.name: Mapillary Vistas (HF sample)
datasets.summary: A Hugging Face sample of street-level imagery from Mapillary Vistas for scene parsing and segmentation.
datasets.description: This dataset is a Hugging Face image-folder distribution of street-level imagery in the style of the Mapillary Vistas dataset, intended for image segmentation and classification. The street-level photographs support semantic scene parsing of road environments. This particular mirror provides a small sample split of the imagery.

datasets.name: MMRS-1M
datasets.summary: A million-scale multimodal remote-sensing instruction dataset (optical, SAR, infrared) used to train the EarthGPT model.
datasets.description: MMRS-1M is a large-scale multimodal instruction-following dataset for remote sensing, comprising on the order of one million image-text samples across multiple sensor modalities including optical, synthetic aperture radar (SAR), and infrared imagery. It was constructed to train and evaluate EarthGPT, a unified multimodal large language model for remote-sensing comprehension across diverse tasks. This Hugging Face release packages the data (as WebDataset archives) sourced from the original EarthGPT repository.
datasets.modality: Remote sensing / multi-sensor imagery (optical, SAR, infrared) + text

datasets.name: Land Cover — Asia (FAOSTAT)
datasets.summary: FAOSTAT Land Cover domain (code LC) for all available Asian countries, repackaged as an ML-ready tabular dataset.
datasets.description: This dataset contains the FAOSTAT Land Cover domain filtered to 45 Asian countries spanning 1992–2023, totalling roughly 30,240 rows across 13 land-cover items and 4 elements. FAOSTAT is FAO's statistical database on food, agriculture, forestry, and land. The data has been repackaged into a clean Parquet/tabular format for machine-learning use.

datasets.name: Git-10M Instance Annotations (v1.0)
datasets.summary: 101.6 million polygon-level object annotations (building footprints and OSM area features) anchored to Git-10M satellite tiles.
datasets.description: Git-10M Instance Annotations provides about 101.6 million polygon-level instances across 72 geographic regions, anchored to Git-10M satellite tiles at zoom levels 10–18. Each instance is a polygon (building footprint or OpenStreetMap area feature) with structured OSM tags, projected into the pixel frame of its deepest containing tile. This is an annotations-only release; the satellite imagery itself lives in lcybuaa/Git-10M and must be downloaded separately.

datasets.name: HydroRIVERS Europe
datasets.summary: HydroRIVERS v10 Europe river-network vector data delivered as an ESRI Shapefile bundle and a converted GeoParquet export.
datasets.description: This dataset packages the HydroRIVERS v10 river network for Europe, including the source ESRI Shapefile bundle, a converted GeoParquet export, and the upstream technical documentation PDF. HydroRIVERS is a global hydrographic river-network product derived from the HydroSHEDS database, representing river reaches as vector line features. The GeoParquet output is used for downstream geospatial analysis.

datasets.name: Historic and Projected Rainfall and Runoff for 4 Lake Victoria Sub-Regions
datasets.summary: Tabular historic and projected rainfall and runoff records for four Lake Victoria sub-regions in Uganda.
datasets.description: This dataset provides historic and projected rainfall and runoff for the four Lake Victoria sub-regions: Lake Victoria, Simiyu, Kagera, and Victoria Nile. Each row represents a tabular hydrological record covering the Ugandan portion of the basin. Sourced from the Flood and Drought Portal via OpenAfrica and last updated 2021-10-21.

datasets.name: Land Use — Asia (FAOSTAT)
datasets.summary: FAOSTAT Land Use domain (code RL) for all available Asian countries, repackaged as an ML-ready tabular dataset.
datasets.description: This dataset contains the FAOSTAT Land Use domain filtered to 45 Asian countries spanning 1961–2025, totalling roughly 71,200 rows across 45 land-use items and 8 elements. FAOSTAT is FAO's statistical database on food, agriculture, forestry, and land. The data has been repackaged into a clean Parquet/tabular format for machine-learning use.

datasets.name: Bridgedeck — NLCD Land Cover at Bridge Locations (2021)
datasets.summary: NLCD 2021 land-cover characterization sampled at US bridge locations for infrastructure and urbanization analysis.
datasets.description: Bridgedeck pairs US bridge locations with National Land Cover Database (NLCD) 2021 land-cover information at those sites. The tabular dataset links bridge infrastructure records to surrounding land-cover classes, supporting analysis of urbanization and the land-cover context of bridge assets across the United States.

datasets.name: FineAir
datasets.summary: Fine-grained airplane detection and classification dataset built on 30 cm high-resolution multi-band satellite imagery.
datasets.description: FineAir provides finest-grained airplane annotations on high-resolution optical satellite imagery (RGB + Near-Infrared, 16-bit, 30 cm resolution) from WorldView-2, WorldView-3, and GeoEye, covering 29 airports over roughly 50 km². It contains 5,520 annotated airplanes, of which 1,350+ carry finest-grained labels across 20 fine-grained classes (from coarse 'airplane' down to specific models such as A320-200). It targets fine-grained object detection and classification in remote-sensing imagery.

datasets.name: US Disasters Mashup
datasets.summary: A unified catalog of 48,592 US disaster events combining aviation accidents, shipwrecks, severe storms, and earthquakes from federal government sources.
datasets.description: US Disasters Mashup merges four major US disaster categories into a single public-domain dataset: NTSB aviation accidents, NOAA shipwrecks, NOAA severe storms, and USGS earthquakes. Each record captures the event with associated attributes and, where available, geographic information. The dataset is intended for cross-domain analysis of natural and human-caused hazards across the United States.

datasets.name: South Sudan Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for South Sudan derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation data, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and the CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by South Sudan subnational administrative units for each 10-day period. Published by the WFP via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: Zambia Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Zambia derived from CHIRPS satellite precipitation data, aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and the CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by Zambia subnational administrative units for each 10-day period. Published by the WFP via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and curated into ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: AquaVeritas Water Stress Dataset
datasets.summary: Classification labels for 1,656 Sentinel-2 satellite observations across 20 global freshwater and saline sites for on-board satellite water monitoring.
datasets.description: AquaVeritas provides classification labels for 1,656 Sentinel-2 satellite observations spanning 20 monitored water bodies worldwide, covering both freshwater and saline sites. Each observation includes structured labels for a 15 km x 15 km core zone and surrounding context. The dataset was built for the Liquid AI x DPhi Space Hackathon to fine-tune a vision-language model for on-board satellite freshwater monitoring.

datasets.name: Daily Summaries of Precipitation Indicators for Bahrain
datasets.summary: Daily precipitation, snow depth, and snowfall indicators for base stations across Bahrain compiled by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information.
datasets.description: This dataset contains daily summaries of precipitation indicators for base stations across Bahrain, including total precipitation (TPCP), maximum snow depth (MXSD), total snow fall (TSNW), and extreme maximum daily precipitation (EMXP). The indicators are compiled by the National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI). Distributed via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and curated into ML-ready format.

datasets.name: Core-S2L2A-249k-Clay-v1.5
datasets.summary: Pre-computed Clay v1.5 foundation-model embeddings for ~249,000 Sentinel-2 L2A satellite image chips from the Major TOM Core dataset.
datasets.description: This dataset contains pre-computed image embeddings for the Core-S2L2A-249k Sentinel-2 Level-2A satellite imagery subset, generated with the Clay v1.5 Earth-observation foundation model. Each record includes a 1024-dimensional embedding vector along with spatial metadata such as coordinates, timestamps, and geometry polygons. The embeddings support cross-modal retrieval and downstream geospatial analysis without re-running the model.

datasets.name: DisasterView
datasets.summary: A large-scale aerial/drone imagery dataset with pixel-level segmentation annotations across earthquake, flood, tornado, and wildfire disaster scenes.
datasets.description: DisasterView is a disaster-scene semantic segmentation dataset comprising 32,233 annotated UAV/drone frames drawn from 842 videos and covering four disaster types: earthquake, flood, tornado, and wildfire. It provides pixel-level polygon annotations across 10 semantic classes including buildings, debris, fire/smoke, roads, vegetation, vehicles, and water/floods. The dataset uses video-disjoint train/validation/test splits to prevent temporal leakage.

datasets.name: ImageConfounding
datasets.summary: Replication data integrating georeferenced satellite imagery with household-survey and aid-project records for causal inference research.
datasets.description: ImageConfounding is the replication dataset for research on integrating Earth observation data into causal inference. It links individual-level observational survey data (with approximate geo-referenced longitude/latitude) to geo-referenced satellite images via a unique image key per observational unit, alongside treatment and outcome variables. The dataset is designed to study confounding when combining remote-sensing imagery with observational data.

datasets.name: Wildfire Dataset
datasets.summary: Global remote-sensing imagery of topography, vegetation, and weather variables at 1 km resolution for wildfire risk assessment.
datasets.description: This dataset compiles remote-sensing imagery and environmental variables (topography, vegetation, and weather) at 1000 m per-pixel spatial resolution across multiple continents, including Africa, Australia, Asia, Europe, South America, and the US. It was created for an MSc thesis building a CNN model to assess wildfire risk globally. The dataset contains roughly 1,554 samples totaling about 2.77 GB.

datasets.name: Wolof-Agri-Captions (AgriWolof)
datasets.summary: Bilingual (English/Wolof) caption dataset pairing 256x256 satellite imagery with land-cover descriptions for agricultural remote sensing.
datasets.description: Wolof-Agri-Captions (AgriWolof) pairs 256x256 satellite image patches with descriptive captions in both English and Wolof, describing land-cover and landscape features for agricultural monitoring. It also includes crop-disease imagery with health/disease annotations. With about 20,700 training rows, it targets image captioning for satellite imagery and crop mapping in a low-resource language setting.

datasets.name: Cameroon Rainfall Indicators (Subnational)
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators and anomalies aggregated by Cameroon's subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset provides 10-day (dekadal) rainfall indicators for Cameroon, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include rainfall totals and anomalies. It is published by the World Food Programme (WFP) and distributed via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: ASAP Agricultural Production Hotspots (Monthly)
datasets.summary: Monthly satellite-based agricultural production anomaly hotspot alerts for early warning of crop and rangeland stress across many countries.
datasets.description: The Anomaly Hotspots of Agricultural Production (ASAP) dataset is derived from the JRC early-warning decision support system, which uses satellite vegetation and rainfall monitoring to flag agricultural production anomalies. This monthly product provides country-level hotspot classifications for crop and rangeland conditions, supporting food security crisis prevention and response planning. It is developed by the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission and distributed via HDX.

datasets.name: POI-based Land Use 3-Class
datasets.summary: Global POI-based land-use classification into residential, non-residential, and open-space classes at 500 m resolution.
datasets.description: This dataset classifies land use into three classes (residential, non-residential, and open space) at a 500-meter spatial resolution, covering all countries and regions except the US and Greenland. It was generated using points-of-interest and OpenStreetMap land-use polygons by the Geospatial Science and Human Security Division at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. It is intended for land-use mapping and human-security geospatial analysis.

datasets.name: Atlantic Forest Sentinel-2 Forest Segmentation
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 Level 2A imagery of Brazil's Atlantic Forest biome with pixel-level forest/background masks for semantic segmentation.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 605 Sentinel-2 Level 2A satellite images from the Atlantic Forest (Mata Atlantica) biome with pixel-level forest/non-forest segmentation masks. Each image is stored as a four-band (B2/B3/B4/B8) GeoTIFF at 512x512 pixels, split into 485 training, 100 validation, and 20 test samples. It is a Hugging Face conversion of the Zenodo dataset from Bragagnolo et al. (2021) for forest semantic segmentation.

datasets.name: Louisiana Florida Parishes LiDAR
datasets.summary: LiDAR elevation survey browse imagery covering Louisiana's Florida Parishes from a 2021 USGS aerial survey.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 1,500 LiDAR browse images (300x300 px JPGs) from the USGS Orthoimagery and Positional Accuracy Research (OPR) project covering Louisiana's Florida Parishes region. The tiles visualize elevation/terrain data from the LA_2021FloridaParishes_C24 aerial survey, with tile IDs and S3 references to official USGS 3DEP repositories. It is suited for LiDAR/elevation visualization and geospatial analysis.

datasets.name: Mars Global Geo-Localization (MarsRetrieval Task 3)
datasets.summary: A planetary-scale geospatial retrieval benchmark localizing Martian landform concepts within a global CTX orbital imagery mosaic.
datasets.description: This dataset is Task 3 of MarsRetrieval, a retrieval-centric benchmark for evaluating vision-language models on Mars geospatial discovery. It localizes scientific concepts within the global CTX (Context Camera) mosaic of over 1.4 million orbital tiles, with ground-truth reference points compiled from published catalogues of five Martian landforms (alluvial fans, glacier-like forms, landslides, pitted cones, and yardangs). It supports image-to-text and text-to-image planetary retrieval evaluation.

datasets.name: Bavaria Weather Data
datasets.summary: Station-based meteorological time series for Bavaria covering precipitation, temperature, wind, pressure, and related variables since 1995.
datasets.description: This dataset contains meteorological observations for Bavaria, Germany, including precipitation, sea-level pressure, temperature, wind speed/direction and gusts, snow depth, and sunshine duration, along with station identifiers and timestamps. Records span from 1995 onward (~765 MB) and are intended for weather time-series forecasting. The data is in German.

datasets.name: FireEdge Sentinel-2 Wildfire
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 false-color imagery paired with spectral indices and analysis prompts for wildfire detection.
datasets.description: This multimodal dataset pairs Sentinel-2 satellite images (using SWIR-based false-color composites where active fire appears bright red/orange) with expert analysis prompts for wildfire detection. It includes 300 samples (210 train / 45 validation / 45 test) with geographic coordinates, temporal metadata, and spectral indices such as NBR2 and SWIR2.2 values. The task is binary classification of wildfire presence.

datasets.name: Grenoble & Zanzibar Satellite Time Series
datasets.summary: Landsat and Sentinel-2 satellite time series (2020-2024) over Grenoble, France and Zanzibar with derived vegetation, water, urban, and temperature indices.
datasets.description: This dataset contains Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery acquired over Grenoble (France) and the Zanzibar region as a time series spanning 2020 to 2024. It includes clipped areas-of-interest, raw multispectral patches, land surface temperature, and derived indices such as NDVI, LST, NDBI, NDWI, and EVI, plus animations of index evolution. Totaling roughly 61 GB, it supports Earth-observation temporal analysis and monitoring.

datasets.name: MuScaRi Multi-Scale Species Richness Data
datasets.summary: Companion dataset bundling ~350k European vegetation plots, regional plant inventories, and gridded environmental predictors for species richness estimation.
datasets.description: muscari-data is the companion dataset for MuScaRi (Multi-Scale species Richness estimation), introduced in Boussange et al., "Multi-scale species richness estimation with deep learning." It bundles ~350,000 anonymized European vegetation plots (EVA), 184 independent regional plant inventories (GIFT), and gridded environmental predictors. It enables development and evaluation of deep-learning methods for plant species richness estimation from vegetation surveys and continental environmental features.

datasets.name: Open Soil Nutrient Dataset – Ukraine
datasets.summary: Open soil nutrient maps for Ukraine (2000, 2010, 2020) provided as GeoTIFF rasters at ~250 m resolution.
datasets.description: The Open Soil Nutrient Dataset for Ukraine contains 15 archives, each providing a nutrient map in GeoTIFF format with previews, metadata, and documentation. It covers the years 2000, 2010, and 2020 at roughly 250 m spatial resolution. Variables include Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), Potassium (K), Organic Carbon (OC), and pH. The dataset was prepared and maintained by Siora and is openly licensed for research and applications.

datasets.name: PASTIS Embed
datasets.summary: Pre-computed pixel-level and pooled patch-level embeddings of the PASTIS-R Sentinel-2 agricultural dataset, derived from three geospatial foundation models.
datasets.description: PASTIS Embed provides pre-computed embeddings of the PASTIS-R panoptic segmentation dataset, which contains 2,433 Sentinel-2 time-series patches covering France with instance-level annotations of ~85,000 agricultural parcels across 18 crop classes. Pixel-level embeddings are derived from three geospatial foundation models (AlphaEarth Foundation, OlmoEarth-Nano, and Tessera), plus pooled parcel-level representations using 14 pooling strategies. It accompanies the paper 'From Pixels to Patches: Pooling Strategies for Earth Embeddings' (Corley et al.). The dataset supports crop classification and embedding-pooling research.

datasets.name: PFM-1 Kriging VNIR Hyperspectral Dataset
datasets.summary: UAV-borne VNIR hyperspectral imaging dataset over a test field with PFM-1 landmine and UXO targets for mine-detection benchmarking.
datasets.description: This remote-sensing dataset contains Visible and Near-Infrared (VNIR) Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) data collected over a test field with 143 landmine and UXO targets. It spans 398–1002 nm across 270 spectral bands at a ground sample distance of ~1.29 cm, acquired with a Headwall Nano-Hyperspec sensor mounted on a UAV at ~20.6 m altitude. The dataset includes the hyperspectral cube, header files, binary ground-truth masks, and reference spectral signatures. It supports landmine-detection benchmarking and is associated with two arXiv papers.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Land-cover Captioning Dataset (S2LCD)
datasets.summary: A remote-sensing image captioning dataset of 1,533 Sentinel-2 L2A image patches covering diverse temperate land-cover types.
datasets.description: The Sentinel-2 Land-cover Captioning Dataset (S2LCD) is designed for deep learning research on remote sensing image captioning. It comprises 1,533 image patches, each 224 × 224 pixels, derived from Sentinel-2 L2A imagery. The dataset ensures diverse representation of land cover and land use types in temperate regions, including forests, mountains, agricultural lands, and urban areas, each with textual captions. It targets vision-language modelling for Earth observation.

datasets.name: Nigerian Road Network Dataset (ML-Ready)
datasets.summary: Multi-scale road network data for Nigeria processed for machine learning, including a high-resolution OCHA/OSM version with 468,407 road segments.
datasets.description: This dataset contains multi-scale road network data for Nigeria, processed for machine learning workflows. It features both a baseline 1:1,000,000 scale dataset and a high-resolution version sourced from OCHA. The high-resolution file (nga_roads_high_res.parquet) holds 468,407 road segments with attributes such as State Name, Road Class, OSM Class, Surface Type, Smoothness, and Length (km). It is derived from OCHA and OpenStreetMap sources.

datasets.name: Senegal: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Senegal aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators for Senegal, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall and anomaly metrics. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and supports drought and food-security monitoring.

datasets.name: Manavgat 2021 Wildfire Hotspots
datasets.summary: NASA VIIRS satellite thermal-anomaly detections (~31,000 records) of the 2021 Manavgat wildfire in Turkey with fire intensity measurements.
datasets.description: This dataset contains NASA VIIRS satellite thermal anomaly detections capturing the devastating July 2021 Manavgat (Antalya, Turkey) wildfire. The cleaned dataset includes approximately 31,082 records with geospatial coordinates, brightness temperatures, and Fire Radiative Power (FRP) measurements indicating fire intensity. It accompanies a spatial analysis evaluating density-based clustering algorithms (FN-DBSCAN and variants) for identifying fire clusters from satellite thermal data.

datasets.name: Cloud4D
datasets.summary: A multi-perspective stereo-camera and synthetic dataset for estimating cloud properties at high spatial and temporal resolution.
datasets.description: Cloud4D is the dataset for the NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight paper 'Cloud4D: Estimating Cloud Properties at a High Spatial and Temporal Resolution'. It contains real-world stereo camera captures of clouds from multiple perspectives, with camera intrinsics, extrinsics, and stereo calibration metadata, alongside synthetic cloud renders from Terragen and large eddy simulation (LES) models. The dataset enables reconstruction and estimation of 4D cloud properties for atmospheric science. It is authored by Jacob Lin, Edward Gryspeerdt, and Ronald Clark.

datasets.name: Nigeria Hospitals Accessibility Indicators
datasets.summary: Travel-time-based spatial accessibility indicators to hospital services across Nigerian administrative units, stratified by population group.
datasets.description: This dataset provides spatial accessibility indicators to hospital services across Nigeria. It uses travel-time isochrones to calculate the population within time intervals away from hospital facilities, broken down by demographic groups (adults, elderly, school-age children, under-5, women of childbearing age, and total population). Records cover ADM1–ADM4 administrative units with accessibility percentages by travel-time threshold. It is published by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: SCM GeoSmart Use Case
datasets.summary: A small geospatial image dataset combining geospatial and image modalities for a GeoSmart use case.
datasets.description: The SCM GeoSmart Use Case dataset combines geospatial and image modalities using an imagefolder format. It is a small dataset (10 image rows totalling 446 MB) hosted by the GeoSmart organization on Hugging Face and intended for geospatial and remote-sensing applications. It is provided as a use-case example for the GeoSmart project.

datasets.name: Amazon Sentinel-2 Forest Segmentation
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 multispectral GeoTIFF tiles of the Amazon biome labeled for binary forest / non-forest semantic segmentation.
datasets.description: This dataset provides 512x512 four-band (Red, Green, Blue, NIR) Sentinel-2 Level-2A GeoTIFF image tiles covering the Amazon biome, paired with binary masks distinguishing forested from non-forested areas. It contains roughly 619 samples split into train, validation, and test sets and is intended for training and evaluating semantic segmentation models. The data was derived from the Zenodo release accompanying Bragagnolo et al. (2021) on Amazon and Atlantic Forest segmentation datasets.

datasets.name: Archaeological Sites (CAA UK 2025)
datasets.summary: Multi-channel remote-sensing tiles combining Sentinel-2 imagery, FABDEM terrain, and spectral indices for detecting archaeological sites.
datasets.description: This dataset provides 11-channel representations of 1x1 km grid cells at 10 m resolution, stacking 6 Sentinel-2 spectral bands, 3 derived spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI, BSI), and 2 terrain features (elevation, slope) from FABDEM. It is designed for training machine-learning models to classify and detect archaeological sites such as geoglyphs, including positive, negative, and augmented samples. The data was assembled on Google Earth Engine from ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2, University of Bristol FABDEM, and publicly available archaeological compilations.
datasets.modality: Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery with terrain features
datasets.size: 11 channels per 100x100 px (1x1 km) tile at 10 m resolution

datasets.name: Outerview Global Road Sign Index
datasets.summary: A global geospatial index of road signs and traffic signage with latitude/longitude derived from street-level imagery.
datasets.description: This dataset is a large-scale geospatial index of road signs and traffic signage, where each record represents a real-world sign observed at a specific location with latitude, longitude, region, and source attribution. The released subset contains 15,000 entries drawn from a larger system spanning millions of locations, available in Parquet, CSV, and GeoJSON formats. Detections were generated by Outerview computer-vision models applied to large-scale street-level imagery from Mapillary.

datasets.name: Great Plains Multisource NDVI-Climate Time Series (2000-2024)
datasets.summary: An 8-day aligned multivariate time series fusing MODIS NDVI with CHIRPS precipitation and ERA5-Land climate variables over the US southern Great Plains.
datasets.description: This dataset integrates 2000-2024 multi-source observations over the drought-sensitive grassland region of the US southern Great Plains (about 105W-95W, 32N-40N). It combines MODIS Terra 8-day NDVI, CHIRPS daily precipitation, and ERA5-Land surface soil moisture, 2 m air temperature, and potential evapotranspiration, aligned to an 8-day NDVI time step for unified modeling. It is intended for drought monitoring, NDVI-climate response analysis, and time-series forecasting tasks such as ARIMA, LSTM, and encoder-decoder models.
datasets.modality: MODIS NDVI and climate reanalysis time series

datasets.name: Mars-Analog-Dunes-10
datasets.summary: High-resolution satellite imagery of Earth's sand dunes labeled into 10 fine-grained dune types as Martian morphological analogs.
datasets.description: Mars-Analog-Dunes-10 is a curated remote-sensing dataset of 1,000 high-resolution (600x600 px) satellite images of Earth's sand dunes selected from regions (e.g., deserts in China and Africa) that morphologically resemble Martian features. Images are labeled into 10 fine-grained classes including sand sheets, dome, crescentic, linear, star, parabolic, network, obstacle, and nebkha dunes plus a non-dune class. It is intended for image classification supporting Earth-Mars comparative planetology, rover navigation, and orbital mapping.

datasets.name: Sao Tome and Principe Subnational Rainfall Indicators
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Sao Tome and Principe aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators computed from CHIRPS v2 satellite-and-station precipitation imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts, aggregated by subnational administrative units of Sao Tome and Principe. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange and repackaged in ML-ready form on Hugging Face. It supports tabular regression and climate/rainfall monitoring tasks.

datasets.name: UNOSAT Tropical Cyclone Man-Yi (2024) Philippines Web Map
datasets.summary: UNOSAT satellite-based flood-impact assessment data for Tropical Cyclone Man-Yi (2024) in the Philippines.
datasets.description: This dataset provides satellite-derived flood-impact assessment data for Tropical Cyclone Man-Yi (UNOSAT code TC20241117PHL, GDACS ID 1001124) affecting the Philippines, published by the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT) via the Humanitarian Data Exchange. It captures impact and affected-area information produced from satellite imagery analysis during the cyclone response. It is repackaged in tabular form on Hugging Face for classification and disaster-impact analysis.

datasets.name: Landslides Object Recognition
datasets.summary: Labeled aerial/satellite images with bounding-box annotations for detecting landslide-related features.
datasets.description: This dataset contains 282 labeled images with object-detection annotations (bounding boxes, category IDs, and area measurements) across multiple categories for recognizing landslide-related features. Images are provided at sizes such as 480x480 and 512x288 pixels, totaling about 33.5 MB, in a single training split. It is intended for object detection and recognition of landslides in imagery.

datasets.name: FAOSTAT Land Cover - Africa
datasets.summary: FAOSTAT land-cover area statistics for 52 African countries from 1992 to 2023, derived from satellite land-cover products.
datasets.description: This dataset contains the FAOSTAT Land Cover (domain LC) statistics filtered to 52 African countries over 1992-2023, with 34,220 rows reporting land-cover area (in 1000 ha) across 13 land-cover items and 4 elements. The underlying land-cover classifications are derived from satellite Earth-observation products including CGLS, MODIS, ESA CCI Land Cover, and WorldCover. It is sourced from FAO's FAOSTAT and repackaged in ML-ready Parquet form by Electric Sheep Africa.

datasets.name: Asia Cyclones - UNOSAT Live Web Map (Tropical Cyclone WIPHA-25)
datasets.summary: Satellite-based impact-assessment records for Tropical Cyclone WIPHA-25 in Lao PDR and Viet Nam, curated from UNOSAT via HDX.
datasets.description: This dataset captures UNOSAT (United Nations Satellite Centre) live web-map impact assessments for Tropical Cyclone WIPHA-25 affecting Lao PDR and Viet Nam (UNOSAT code TC20250722VNM, GDACS ID 1001181). Each row holds tabular records describing satellite-derived impact information for the affected areas. It was sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and last updated on 2026-02-17, with geographic scope covering Viet Nam.

datasets.name: S2 MultiSenGE GT (zarr)
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery paired with merged MultiSenGE ground-truth labels for land-cover analysis, in zarr format.
datasets.description: S2 MultiSenGE GT contains Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite imagery with corresponding ground-truth labels derived from the MultiSenGE benchmark dataset. It is designed for remote-sensing and machine-learning applications including land-cover classification, segmentation, and environmental monitoring. The imagery and merged ground truth are distributed in zarr format for efficient array-based access.

datasets.name: USDA Crop Insurance Indemnities + Weather Anomaly (1989-2023)
datasets.summary: County x crop x year crop-insurance indemnity records pre-joined with NOAA county-level drought, precipitation, and temperature anomalies.
datasets.description: This dataset combines 2M+ county x crop x year x cause-of-loss indemnity records from the USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA) Cause of Loss database - covering every federally insured US crop loss paid since 1989 - with NOAA nClimDiv county-level drought (PDSI), precipitation, and temperature anomalies. It supports tabular regression and analysis of climate impacts on agricultural losses. The Hugging Face repository contains a 1,000-row public-domain sample, with the full multi-table dataset (CSV + Parquet) hosted externally.

datasets.name: Africa - Libya Rainfall Indicators (Subnational)
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Libya aggregated by subnational administrative unit, curated from WFP via HDX.
datasets.description: This dataset provides dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Libya, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite product and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts, aggregated by subnational administrative units. Indicators include 10-day rainfall totals and related anomaly measures for tracking drought and precipitation patterns. It was published by the World Food Programme (WFP), sourced from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), and last updated on 2026-04-03.

datasets.name: Climate Global Temperature Anomaly
datasets.summary: Tabular series of global average temperature anomalies relative to the 1961-1990 baseline with 95% confidence bounds.
datasets.description: This dataset records global average temperature anomalies measured relative to the 1961-1990 baseline, together with the upper and lower bounds of their 95% confidence intervals and a timestamp for each observation. It is a compact tabular climate dataset of roughly 519 rows spanning historical records from 1850 onward. It supports analysis of long-term global warming trends and climate change.

datasets.name: EVChargeStations USA
datasets.summary: Nationwide georeferenced point dataset of US EV charging stations with coordinates and station metadata.
datasets.description: EVChargeStations USA is a geospatial point dataset of electric-vehicle charging stations across the United States, optimized for analytics, geospatial fusion, and AI applications. Each of the 58,350 entries includes the station/network name, latitude and longitude, official website, user ratings and review counts, full address, country code, and phone number. It is distributed in CSV and Parquet formats for use with pandas and the Datasets library.

datasets.name: GEO-Bench v1 VHR (m-pv4ger Tortilla Mirror)
datasets.summary: Reformatted GEO-Bench v1 m-pv4ger subset of VHR RGB aerial imagery for binary solar-PV detection.
datasets.description: This is a reformatted (tortilla-format) container of the m-pv4ger subset from GEO-Bench v1, the remote-sensing benchmark from the paper 'Toward Foundation Models for Earth Monitoring'. It provides 320x320 RGB aerial PNG imagery for binary image classification - detecting whether a tile contains a rooftop-mounted photovoltaic system. The data derive from the PV4GER dataset of German aerial imagery and comprise 13,812 samples (~788 MB) split into train/validation/test.

datasets.name: Large Meteorites (1kg+) - NASA Catalog
datasets.summary: Georeferenced catalog of 4,871 significant meteorite specimens weighing at least 1 kilogram, filtered from the NASA meteorite catalog.
datasets.description: Large Meteorites is a subset of the NASA meteorite catalog filtered to substantial specimens weighing 1 kilogram or more. It contains 4,871 meteorite records - rare, scientifically valuable specimens often held in museum collections worldwide - with associated geospatial and descriptive attributes. It is intended for geospatial feature extraction and analysis and ships with a demo notebook for data exploration.

datasets.name: MODIS Water Lake Powell Raster Dataset
datasets.summary: MODIS surface-reflectance raster dataset with derived indices and binary water/not-water labels over Lake Powell.
datasets.description: The MODIS Water Lake Powell Raster Dataset comprises MODIS surface-reflectance bands together with calculated spectral indices and a binary water/not-water label for each sample. Data fields include MODIS surface-reflectance bands (e.g., sur_refl_b01 through b04) and the water label, supporting surface-water classification and mapping. It was produced by the NASA CISTO Data Science Group for remote-sensing water-detection research.

datasets.name: RS-Dataset-Latents
datasets.summary: Latent representations of remote-sensing images encoded with seven pre-trained image VAEs.
datasets.description: RS-Dataset-Latents provides VAE-encoded latent representations of remote-sensing imagery (e.g. UCMerced) produced as part of the VAEs4RS project. It includes latents from multiple pre-trained encoders such as FLUX1-VAE, FLUX2-VAE, Qwen-VAE, SANA-VAE, SD21-VAE, SD35-VAE and SDXL-VAE. Each archive holds .npz files containing float16 latent arrays, intended for generative and representation-learning research on Earth-observation data.

datasets.name: thermal-drone-imagery
datasets.summary: A small collection of thermal imagery captured from drone/aerial platforms.
datasets.description: thermal-drone-imagery is a compact dataset of thermal (infrared) imagery acquired from drone-based aerial platforms. It is intended for remote-sensing and aerial imagery analysis tasks. Documentation is minimal and the collection is small in size.

datasets.name: WiDS 2023 Competition Weather Forecasting
datasets.summary: Sub-seasonal temperature forecasting dataset combining weather and climate features across US locations.
datasets.description: Prepared for the WiDS Datathon 2023, this dataset targets forecasting sub-seasonal temperatures (averaged over a two-week period) across a number of US locations. It bundles weather and climate information for various start dates together with forecasted temperature and precipitation from several weather models. It is structured for time-series and tabular regression forecasting tasks.

datasets.name: Africa Synthetic Climate Drought & Flood Impact (All)
datasets.summary: Synthetic dataset of drought and flood events, severity, impacts and recovery metrics across Sub-Saharan Africa.
datasets.description: This is a synthetic climate dataset documenting drought and flood events across 15 Sub-Saharan African countries, including event severity, impacts and recovery metrics. It was parameterized from published Sub-Saharan-Africa literature rather than from real observations, so it is not suitable for empirical analysis or policy inference. It is provided for modeling and tabular regression experimentation on climate-hazard impacts.

datasets.name: Alps EuroDEM
datasets.summary: A ~60 m resolution Digital Elevation Model covering the European Alps, cropped from EuroDEM.
datasets.description: Alps EuroDEM is a Digital Elevation Model covering the European Alps at roughly 60 m resolution, extracted from the EuroDEM dataset. Coverage spans approximately 4.5 E to 17.0 E longitude and 42.75 N to 48.5 N latitude. It was prepared for terrain analysis and ski-slope design in a Ski Resort Planner application.

datasets.name: Thailand NDVI at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal MODIS-derived NDVI vegetation indicators for Thailand aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: Published by the WFP, this dataset contains dekadal NDVI indicators computed from NASA's MODIS collection 6.1 (Aqua and Terra) aggregated by Thai sub-national administrative units. Included indicators per dekad cover 10-day NDVI, NDVI long-term average and NDVI anomaly. It is sourced from HDX and is suitable for vegetation-condition and tabular regression analysis.

datasets.name: Uzbekistan Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Uzbekistan aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: Published by the WFP, this dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite-and-station precipitation imagery plus CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts, aggregated by Uzbek subnational administrative units. Per-dekad indicators include 10-day rainfall and related anomaly metrics. It is sourced from HDX and is suitable for precipitation monitoring and tabular regression analysis.

datasets.name: BridgeDeck-STATSGO
datasets.summary: Geospatial join of US bridge locations with STATSGO2 soil properties for bridge-deck deterioration analysis.
datasets.description: BridgeDeck-STATSGO links every unique NBI bridge location in the contiguous US with soil properties from the STATSGO2/SSURGO national soil database, queried via the NRCS Soil Data Access REST API using point-in-polygon operations. Each record carries latitude/longitude plus soil attributes such as corrosion potential, drainage class, hydrologic group, silt percentage and frost susceptibility. It supports bridge-deck deterioration modeling and soil characterization tasks and is provided in CSV/Parquet format.

datasets.name: DOTA v2
datasets.summary: Large-scale aerial/satellite imagery dataset for oriented bounding box object detection.
datasets.description: DOTA v2 is a benchmark for object detection in aerial and satellite imagery, here provided with oriented bounding box (OBB) annotations in the form distributed via the Ultralytics documentation. Imagery includes Google Earth scenes along with GF-2 and JL-1 satellite images from the China Centre for Resources Satellite Data and Application. It is released for academic, non-commercial use and is widely used for evaluating oriented object detection in remote sensing.

datasets.name: Hierarchical Geospatial Reasoning
datasets.summary: Image-and-text question-answering benchmark for multi-level spatial reasoning over aerial/satellite imagery.
datasets.description: Hierarchical Geospatial Reasoning is an image-plus-text question-answering dataset for spatial reasoning over high-resolution aerial and satellite imagery. Questions range from fine-grained urban analysis (e.g. cars within a buffer of tree canopy at 0.05 m/pixel) to landscape-scale land-use queries (e.g. forest area within a distance of water bodies at 0.3 m/pixel), requiring understanding of buffers, overlaps and containment. It contains 545 question rows in JSON format.

datasets.name: Iran Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Iran aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: Published by the WFP, this dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite-and-station precipitation imagery plus CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts, aggregated by Iranian subnational administrative units. Per-dekad indicators include 10-day rainfall and related anomaly metrics. It is sourced from HDX and is suitable for precipitation monitoring and tabular regression analysis.

datasets.name: Thailand Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite-derived rainfall indicators for Thailand aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: Published by the WFP, this dataset contains dekadal rainfall indicators computed from CHIRPS version 2 satellite-and-station precipitation imagery plus CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts, aggregated by Thai subnational administrative units. Per-dekad indicators include 10-day rainfall and related anomaly metrics. It is sourced from HDX and is suitable for precipitation monitoring and tabular regression analysis.

datasets.name: Kazakhstan IBTrACS Tropical Storm Tracks
datasets.summary: Best-track tropical cyclone records for the Kazakhstan region drawn from the IBTrACS global archive.
datasets.description: A subset of the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) covering tropical storm tracks relevant to Kazakhstan. IBTrACS merges recent and historical tropical cyclone data from multiple agencies into a unified best-track dataset that improves inter-agency comparisons. Each record includes a storm identifier (SID), timestamps, geographic position (latitude/longitude/basin), and storm characteristics such as wind speed and pressure. Curated into ML-ready Parquet format from HDX.

datasets.name: Kyrgyzstan IBTrACS Tropical Storm Tracks
datasets.summary: Best-track tropical cyclone records for the Kyrgyzstan region drawn from the IBTrACS global archive.
datasets.description: A subset of the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) covering tropical storm tracks relevant to Kyrgyzstan. IBTrACS merges recent and historical tropical cyclone data from multiple agencies into a unified best-track dataset for improved inter-agency comparison. Records include storm identifiers, observation times, geographic positions, and storm intensity fields. Curated into ML-ready Parquet format from HDX.

datasets.name: Thailand IBTrACS Tropical Storm Tracks
datasets.summary: Best-track tropical cyclone records for the Thailand region drawn from the IBTrACS global archive.
datasets.description: A subset of the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) covering tropical storm tracks relevant to Thailand. IBTrACS merges recent and historical tropical cyclone data from multiple agencies into a unified best-track dataset. The dataset contains roughly 216,000 observations across 12 columns, including storm identifier (SID), ISO time, latitude/longitude, basin/sub-basin, storm nature, wind speed, and central pressure. Curated into ML-ready Parquet format from HDX.

datasets.name: Cambodia 4W Flood Response
datasets.summary: Tabular 'who-what-where-when' flood response coordination records for Cambodia.
datasets.description: A humanitarian flood-response dataset for Cambodia (geographic scope KHM) capturing 4W (who, what, where, when) coordination records in the natural-hazards and disaster-risk domain. Each row represents a tabular record describing flood response activities, organized by location. Published by OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific and curated into ML-ready Parquet format from HDX.

datasets.name: EuroSAT Dataset with Image
datasets.summary: RGB Sentinel-2 satellite image patches labelled across 10 land-use and land-cover classes.
datasets.description: A version of the EuroSAT benchmark (Helber et al., 2019) for land-use and land-cover classification from Sentinel-2 imagery. It contains over 27,000 RGB image patches of 64x64 pixels split into training and validation sets, spanning 10 classes such as Annual Crop, Forest, Herbaceous Vegetation, Highway, Industrial, Pasture, Permanent Crop, Residential, River, and Sea/Lake. The images are provided as PNG files for image-classification tasks.

datasets.name: Guinea Rainfall Data
datasets.summary: Rainfall/climate measurement data for Guinea.
datasets.description: A geospatial climate dataset containing rainfall measurements for Guinea. The data is intended for weather analysis, climate research, and rainfall-pattern studies focused on the Guinea region. The dataset is relatively small (around 2.3 MB) and hosted on Hugging Face.

datasets.name: PG S2S-Crop Development
datasets.summary: Geolocated crop-type records across Western Europe for crop classification.
datasets.description: A geospatial crop-classification dataset containing geolocated records with latitude/longitude coordinates and crop-type labels over a Western European region (approximately 47-49 degrees N, -2 to +5 degrees E). It comprises about 41,800 rows (around 39k train and 2.9k test) spanning eight crop varieties including barley, wheat, maize, sunflower, rapeseed, faba bean, and sorghum. Intended for agricultural crop-type classification.

datasets.name: 2015 Tropical Cyclone Megh Path (ICPAC)
datasets.summary: Geospatial track of the 2015 Tropical Cyclone Megh affecting the Horn of Africa region.
datasets.description: A geospatial layer showing the movement path of 2015 Tropical Cyclone Megh, which originated in the Arabian Sea following Tropical Cyclone Chapala and produced maximum wind speeds around 110 knots. The storm brought heavy rains to parts of the Bari region in Puntland and Somaliland. Published by the IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC) and curated into ML-ready Parquet format from HDX.

datasets.name: Somalia Drought Response 2022
datasets.summary: Subnational drought-response records for Somalia in the natural-hazards and disaster-risk domain.
datasets.description: A humanitarian drought-response dataset for Somalia (geographic scope SOM) covering the 2022 drought, with each row representing observations at the subnational administrative unit level. The data sits in the natural-hazards and disaster-risk domain and describes drought response activities by location. Published by OCHA Somalia and curated into ML-ready Parquet format from HDX.

datasets.name: Cambodia Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Cambodia aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Cambodia, computed from Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall totals, long-term averages, and anomalies. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Iran NDVI at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal MODIS-derived NDVI vegetation indicators for Iran aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) NDVI indicators for the Islamic Republic of Iran, computed from NASA's Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) collection 6.1 on the Aqua and Terra satellites. Values are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day NDVI, long-term averages, and NDVI anomalies. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Japan NDVI at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal MODIS-derived NDVI vegetation indicators for Japan aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) NDVI indicators for Japan, computed from NASA's Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) collection 6.1 on the Aqua and Terra satellites. Values are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day NDVI, long-term averages, and NDVI anomalies. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Timor-Leste Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Timor-Leste aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Timor-Leste, computed from Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall totals, long-term averages, and anomalies. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Turkiye Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS-derived rainfall indicators for Turkiye aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Turkiye, computed from Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall totals, long-term averages, and anomalies. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Brunei IBTrACS Tropical Storm Tracks
datasets.summary: Geolocated tropical cyclone best-track observations for Brunei Darussalam from the IBTrACS archive.
datasets.description: This dataset provides geolocated tropical cyclone best-track observations covering Brunei Darussalam, drawn from the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS), the most complete global collection of tropical cyclones. IBTrACS merges recent and historical cyclone data from multiple agencies into a unified, publicly available best-track dataset. It is provided as a machine-learning-ready Parquet conversion via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: UNOSAT Tropical Cyclone Mocha 2023 Population Exposure
datasets.summary: Satellite-derived population exposure analysis for Tropical Cyclone Mocha in Bangladesh and Myanmar.
datasets.description: This dataset provides a population exposure analysis for Tropical Cyclone Mocha (UNOSAT code TC20230510BGD, GDACS ID 1000970), which formed over the southern Bay of Bengal on 11 May 2023 and tracked toward western Myanmar and southern Bangladesh. The analysis, based on satellite observations, estimates the population exposed to the cyclone as of 13 May 2023. It is published by the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT) via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: UNOSAT Tropical Cyclone Yagi 2024 Population Exposure
datasets.summary: Satellite-derived population exposure analysis for Tropical Cyclone Yagi in Viet Nam.
datasets.description: This dataset provides a population exposure analysis for Tropical Cyclone Yagi (UNOSAT code TC20240905VNM, GDACS ID 1001090), the second-most powerful storm of 2024, which formed in early September, made landfall in the Philippines, and moved toward China and Viet Nam. The analysis, based on satellite observations, estimates the population exposed to the cyclone in Viet Nam as of 7 September 2024. It is published by the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT) via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: Climate-1day Weather Forecast Dataset
datasets.summary: Next-day weather forecast prediction dataset built from National Weather Service-style text forecasts.
datasets.description: Climate-1day is a weather/climate sequence-prediction dataset where models forecast the next day's weather given the previous day's information. Each record contains a date and a National Weather Service-style forecast description covering temperature anomalies, precipitation patterns, and atmospheric circulation features over the continental United States for January to March 2014. It is provided with train, validation, and test splits in Parquet format.

datasets.name: Cloud vs Temperature Data
datasets.summary: Satellite-derived meteorological table pairing cloud and atmospheric measurements with temperature observations.
datasets.description: This is a satellite meteorology dataset containing atmospheric and cloud measurements paired with temperature observations, derived from instruments including INSAT and CSAT satellites. Each record includes latitude/longitude coordinates, brightness temperatures, albedo, cloud thickness, multi-layer cloud properties, solar and satellite elevation angles, land-sea classification, and a binary cloud classification target. It supports cloud classification and temperature analysis tasks.

datasets.name: NYC Floods Street Level
datasets.summary: Fine-grained spatiotemporal records of urban flood events across New York City street segments from 2020 to 2024.
datasets.description: This dataset provides street-level flood event data for New York City, USA, mapping flood reports to road-network edges with geospatial coordinates and street attributes. It integrates publicly available sources including the NOAA Storm Events Database, NYC 311 flood-related requests, FloodNet sensor data, and MyCoast NY flood watch records. Each row corresponds to a spatiotemporal flood segment defined by distinct street nodes, length, elevation, road classification, and event timestamps. It is suited for urban flood analysis and table-question-answering over geospatial flood events.

datasets.name: Burkina Faso Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
datasets.summary: Dekadal CHIRPS satellite rainfall indicators for Burkina Faso aggregated by subnational administrative units.
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal (10-day) rainfall indicators for Burkina Faso, computed from the Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) version 2 satellite imagery and CHIRPS-GEFS short-term rainfall forecasts. Indicators are aggregated by subnational administrative units and include 10-day rainfall, rolling 1-month and 3-month aggregations, and percentage anomalies against long-term averages. It is published by the World Food Programme via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) and is intended for climate monitoring and tabular regression tasks.

datasets.name: Bahrain IBTrACS Tropical Storm Tracks
datasets.summary: Geolocated tropical cyclone best-track observations from IBTrACS covering the Bahrain region and surrounding basins.
datasets.description: This dataset contains tropical cyclone tracks from the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS), the most complete global collection of tropical cyclone data, repackaged for machine learning. It merges recent and historical storm data from multiple agencies for the Bahrain region and the North Indian Ocean basins (Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal). Fields include storm identifiers (SID), timestamps, geographic coordinates, basin classifications, storm nature, wind speeds, and pressure measurements. The source data is provided via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

datasets.name: HyperspectralCollections
datasets.summary: A large collection of open-source hyperspectral and multispectral remote-sensing images for training deep learning models.
datasets.description: HyperspectralCollections aggregates open-source hyperspectral and multispectral Earth observation imagery into a single large-scale corpus for remote-sensing research. The data is packaged in WebDataset format combining image and text modalities. It is intended for training and evaluating deep learning models on hyperspectral and multispectral imagery. The collection totals roughly 86 GB across tens of thousands of samples.

datasets.name: Mapillary Metropolis
datasets.summary: A curated subset of Mapillary street-level imagery of metropolitan urban scenes labeled for classification.
datasets.description: Mapillary Metropolis is a geospatial street-level imagery dataset derived from the collaborative Mapillary platform, focusing on metropolitan urban areas. The collection contains street photographs organized in image-folder format with standardized dimensions and a class label spanning four classes. It is suited for street-level scene and urban feature classification tasks.

datasets.name: Nigeria Primary Healthcare Accessibility Indicators
datasets.summary: Spatial accessibility indicators to primary healthcare services across Nigerian administrative units using travel-time isochrones.
datasets.description: This geospatial dataset provides indicators of spatial accessibility to primary healthcare services across Nigeria. It uses travel-time isochrones and distance ranges to estimate the population within given travel intervals of healthcare facilities, broken down by demographic groups including adults, elderly, school-age children, under-5s, and women of childbearing age. Each record is associated with administrative units (ADM1-ADM4) identified by ISO3 country code and unique IDs. It is suited for analyzing healthcare access gaps and geospatial accessibility modeling.

datasets.name: Soil Spectral Analysis
datasets.summary: A synthetic soil reflectance spectroscopy dataset for predicting nutrient content from spectral bands.
datasets.description: Soil Spectral Analysis is a synthetic dataset for precision agriculture that captures the relationship between soil reflectance spectra and soil chemistry. It covers eight Central European soil types with 24-band reflectance spectra spanning 350-1500 nm, paired with measurements of nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, organic matter, and pH. Each sample also includes metadata on soil type, region, depth, texture, land use, and crop. As the data is synthetic, it is intended for model training and experimentation rather than real agronomic decisions.

datasets.name: Africa Electrical Grid Distribution
datasets.summary: Geolocated electrical grid distribution points for the Democratic Republic of Congo with binary grid-presence labels.
datasets.description: This dataset maps the distribution of the electrical grid in the Democratic Republic of Congo based on geographic coordinates. Each row contains a latitude, a longitude, and a binary grid_status indicator (1 for grid presence, 0 for absence). It is provided as ML-ready Parquet data and is suited for infrastructure analysis and energy-access mapping in Central Africa.

datasets.name: Africa South Sudan Flood Locations
datasets.summary: Tabular geospatial records of flood-affected first-level administrative locations across South Sudan as of late October 2019.
datasets.description: This dataset documents flood-affected locations in South Sudan as of the end of October 2019, sourced from OCHA South Sudan via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX). Each row represents a first-level administrative unit observation, with geographic identifiers, administrative boundaries (state/county PCodes), temporal fields, and displacement-related attributes. It was curated into an ML-ready Parquet format by Electric Sheep Africa for tabular analysis of flood impact and forced displacement.

datasets.name: Image Mapillary Street-Level
datasets.summary: A large collection of crowdsourced Mapillary street-level imagery for geospatial vision and geo-localization tasks.
datasets.description: This dataset contains street-level imagery sourced from Mapillary, a crowdsourced street-view platform, totaling roughly 102 GB of images. It is intended for geospatial computer-vision tasks such as image geo-localization and street-scene understanding, and has been used to train geo-localization and image-to-image models. The imagery captures real-world ground-level scenes tied to geographic locations.

datasets.name: RS Video Beach (OPAZ)
datasets.summary: Prototype Earth-observation video sequences acquired by Airbus OPAZ over Barcelona at 18 cm resolution.
datasets.description: This dataset provides example/prototype optical video sequences from OPAZ (Optical Advanced EO System for Zephyr), acquired by Airbus during a flight test campaign over Barcelona, Catalonia in April 2016 at 18 cm resolution. OPAZ is a dedicated Earth Observation system being developed for Zephyr, the Airbus High Altitude Pseudo Satellite (HAPS), aiming to provide persistent surveillance over regional areas at roughly 20 cm optical resolution. The data is useful for remote-sensing video analysis and persistent-surveillance research.

datasets.name: Changen2-S1-15k
datasets.summary: A building change-detection dataset of 15k bi-temporal remote-sensing image pairs with two change types at 0.3-1 m resolution.
datasets.description: Changen2-S1-15k is a building change dataset containing 15,000 bi-temporal image pairs and two change types, with RGB bands at 0.3-1 m spatial resolution. It was generated as part of the Changen2 generative change modeling work for remote-sensing change detection and segmentation. The dataset supports training and benchmarking of building-change detection models.

datasets.name: Delhi Sentinel-2
datasets.summary: Multispectral Sentinel-2 satellite imagery over the New Delhi metropolitan region for segmentation and feature extraction.
datasets.description: This dataset comprises multispectral satellite imagery acquired by the Sentinel-2 mission over the New Delhi metropolitan region. Sentinel-2 is part of the European Space Agency's Copernicus Programme and is designed for high-resolution monitoring of land surfaces, urban areas, and environmental processes. The dataset is intended for geospatial tasks such as image segmentation, feature extraction, and bi-temporal change analysis.

datasets.name: Precompute of S2 MultiSenGE GT (Zarr)
datasets.summary: Precomputed Sentinel-2 imagery with merged MultiSenGE ground truth, filtered, normalized, and patched into 224x224 tiles in Zarr format.
datasets.description: This dataset contains precomputed Sentinel-2 imagery combined with merged MultiSenGE ground-truth labels, derived from the S2_MultiSenGE_GT_zarr source. The precomputation pipeline applies filtering, normalisation, and custom patching to a fixed 224x224 patch size, stored in Zarr format for efficient streaming. It is intended for remote-sensing land-cover analysis and training geospatial foundation models, with the processing methodology documented in the author's GitHub repository.

datasets.name: Satellite-512
datasets.summary: A small collection of labeled 512x512 satellite images for computer-vision tasks.
datasets.description: Satellite-512 is a compact dataset of satellite imagery stored in Parquet format, with around 304 training samples containing pixel values and labels. Images are 512x512 pixels and intended for satellite image classification and related computer-vision experiments. The dataset is small and suited to prototyping geospatial vision models.

datasets.name: UEX-PVSeg
datasets.summary: A benchmark for photovoltaic panel segmentation in remote-sensing imagery spanning multiple spatial resolutions.
datasets.description: UEX-PVSeg is a comprehensive benchmark for photovoltaic (PV) panel segmentation in remote-sensing imagery, established to enable rigorous evaluation of computer-vision models on PV interpretation tasks. It aggregates three stratified sub-datasets (PV-SegA, PV-SegB, PV-SegC) with over 562,000 positive samples at spatial resolutions ranging from 0.1 to 20 m, covering rooftop installations, utility systems, and large-scale solar farms. It is a key contribution of the PANEL domain-specific vision-language model work for zero-shot and few-shot PV tasks in remote sensing.

datasets.name: US Oil & Gas Well Permits
datasets.summary: A normalized 2.2M+ record geospatial dataset of US oil and gas well permits across 27 states from 1864 to present.
datasets.description: This dataset aggregates over 2.2 million US oil and gas well permits across 27 states, spanning 1864 to the present. Public-domain data from state regulators (including TX RRC, CA CalGEM, ND IIC, NM OCD, AK AOGCC, and 22 others) is normalized into a single schema with consistent API-number primary keys, including well location and permitting attributes. It is a frozen point-in-time snapshot dated 2026-04-17 for geospatial, tabular, and time-series analysis of energy infrastructure.

datasets.name: WildFire VQA
datasets.summary: A multimodal visual-question-answering dataset pairing UAV RGB and thermal aerial imagery with questions for wildfire detection, classification, and response planning.
datasets.description: WildFire VQA combines RGB aerial images captured from UAV platforms with co-registered radiometric thermal imagery and temperature summaries to support visual question answering for wildfire assessment. Questions span presence/detection, classification, distribution and segmentation, localization and direction, cross-modal reasoning, and flight planning. Imagery is captured at roughly 50-100m altitude with nadir viewing angles, drawing on the Flame 3 computer vision dataset.

datasets.name: Global Drillhole Database
datasets.summary: A worldwide compilation of nearly 4 million geolocated drill holes, boreholes, and mineral occurrences aggregated from national and provincial geological surveys.
datasets.description: The Global Drillhole Database compiles 3,958,882+ drill holes, boreholes, rock samples, and mineral occurrences from geological surveys across Western Australia, Canada, South Africa, South Australia, Greenland, and Tasmania. Each record includes an ID, name, WGS84 latitude/longitude, region, country code, depth, year drilled, and target commodity. Data is provided in Parquet and JSON formats.

datasets.name: OpenEarthMap Paris
datasets.summary: A Paris-region subset of the OpenEarthMap land cover benchmark, providing RGB aerial/satellite images with annotated land cover labels.
datasets.description: OpenEarthMap Paris is a subset of the OpenEarthMap Land Cover Mapping benchmark restricted to the Paris region. It contains RGB images paired with pixel-level annotated land cover components, split into training, validation, and test partitions. The full dataset is available on Zenodo and described in the OpenEarthMap WACV 2023 paper.

datasets.name: Ship Classification 2024 2025
datasets.summary: A binary remote-sensing image classification dataset of cropped scenes labeled ship versus no-ship, built for a ship detection project at Grenoble-INP ENSE3.
datasets.description: This dataset contains remotely sensed scenes cropped into small (32x32 pixel) boxes for a ship detection project at Grenoble-INP ENSE3 (2024/2025). Boxes are organized into ship and no_ship folders for binary classification. It was created as an educational remote sensing project.

datasets.name: US EV Charging Locations
